RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Showed some ability on recent debut at Leopardstown; plenty of improvement required.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Towards the rear in two 1m2f maidens at Leopardstown; will need a handicap mark to have any chance of winning a race.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Has won only one of her 25 races over hurdles, placed six times, currently rated 95; never close enough to challenge in a 1m7f maiden at Leopardstown 13 days ago on her only Flat start.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Ran green first time out at Dundalk in May; Shane Foley prefers stablemate Altura now.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Last of nine in a Naas maiden also contested by stablemate French Blond; can be ruled out.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Tailed off on debut in a Cork maiden in which Cosmetic finished fifth; stable outsider with Shane Foley on Altura.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Ninth foal; Jim Bolger-bred half-sister by Teofilo to winners Sometimesadiamond (6f inc 2yo/Listed), Level Pitch (7f-1m2f ) and Speiriuil (hurdles); dam a middle-distance winner by Galileo; tongue-tie for debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Poor form in bumpers/hurdles; last of ten on AW on her only Flat outing.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Clear of the rest when second to the promising Arapaho Gold on his 5f course debut and made no mistake over 6f at Redcar (good) 16 days later, making all; wandered around under pressure at Redcar but was well on top and should improve again.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Failed to take a step forward from his AW debut when beaten over 6l into third at Hamilton (6f, good) 45 days ago but remains open to progress; hooded first time.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Flashed his tail but stuck on to prevail by 1l in novice event at York (6f, good) on debut; only seventh of 13 when sent off 5-2 favourite for the Woodcote at Epsom (6f, good to soft) 12 days later but likely to have a big say back in calmer waters.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Half-brother to winners Diligent Resdev (6f/7f including 2yo; RPR 92) and Nammos (7f AW/1m turf; 75); best watched on debut unless the betting suggests otherwise.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 80-1, always behind in the Rous seller at York (6f, good) on debut 19 days ago.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: £35,000 breeze-up 2yo who is the third foal of an unraced half-sister to Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint winner Starlust; the stable has yet to have a 2yo winner this season but he still needs monitoring in the betting.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 32,000euros half-sister to winners Feyha (1m2f AW 2yo/1m4f; RPR 71), Martinus (German 7f) and Corazon Blanco (Czech 1m1f); her stable has a couple of useful 2yos this year so she's worth a second look in the betting.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Gelded son of Dream Ahead who went through the ring for 1,000gns as a foal; a watching brief is advised on debut unless the betting strongly hints otherwise.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 4,000euros yearling, resold for 5,000euros; gelding by Arizona; fifth foal; brother to 7f/1m AW winner Glyndwr (including 2yo; RPR 86) and half-brother to two Italian winners; best to look elsewhere on debut unless the market speaks favourably.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Weakened quickly to finish remote last of seven on 7f Wetherby debut 16 days ago.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Half-brother to five winners, including Third Time Lucky (7f-1m1f; RPR 108) and Baba O'Riley (French 6f-1m including 2yo; 96); would enter the reckoning if the market speaks in his favour.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Pulled 2.5l clear of a next-time-out winner Kodiak Breeze (runs in first division) when overcoming inexperience to make a very promising winning debut over 5f here (good to firm) at the start of May; it's taken a bit of time to get him back to the track but 6f should suit even better and he looks more than good enough to defy a penalty.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Showed pace before fading in well-contested York seller on debut (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; may last longer this time.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Made some late headway when fourth of seven on Ripon debut (6f, good) a fortnight ago; entitled to improve.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Space Blues colt who is a half-brother to a couple of very useful winners abroad; needs a betting check for a stable which has had a couple of first-time-out 2yo winners this year.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Finished over 8l behind the reopposing Travellers Girl on her 6f Ripon debut two weeks ago.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 5,000 euros yearling; sister to 1m winner Alabama Calling (RPR 82) and half-sister to four other winners; stable hardly noted for first-time-out juvenile success.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 66-1 and hooded, hinted at ability amidst greenness when fifth of nine on 6f Redcar debut (good) 11 days ago; may do better.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 9,000euros yearling closely related to 7f AW winner River Chorus (RPR 70) and half-brother to winners Sioux Spirit (5f 2yo/6f; 90) and Biloxi Boy (5f 2yo; 76); dam 12.5f winner (including AW; 73); the betting should guide to expectations on debut.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: £1,000 yearling who is the first foal of a mare who was placed 7f-1m (RPR 76); most from the stable are better for a run but the betting should provide more clues.

RaceName: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 28-1 when last of eight on Carlisle debut (5f, good to soft) 22 days ago.

Fairly useful form when placed on first four starts, notably second of nine on 7.5f Beverley handicap debut (good to soft) in May; his run of consistent efforts came to an abrupt halt at Nottingham last time and cheekpieces are reached for on the back of that; shouldn't be far away if back to his best but still likely vulnerable to an improver.

OwnerName: RC Syndicate X and Gary Gillies
Spotlight: His dam was a German 1m Group 3 winner; left summer's AW debut well behind when second to the promising Portcullis in 1m York novice (good) on reappearance in May, keeping on in a style which suggests he's sure to win races.

It took this 87,000euros 2yo breeze-up buy a while to get to the track but he looks capable of making up for lost time after a promising opening run at Carlisle (9f, soft) 22 days ago, finishing well from the rear for a never-nearer third of 12; that doesn't obviously point to this sharper test suiting but he could just be a lot more clued up second time out.

150,000gns yearling; fourth foal; sister to 7f winner Rajala (RPR 75), half-sister to winners Vento D'Estate (Italian 7.5f-8.5f) and Ikigai Star (2m/2m3f hurdle); dam 7.5f 2yo Listed/1m Italian 1,000 Guineas winner (102); tongue tied for debut but Tom Marquand booked and she needs checking out in the betting.
6yo mare who hinted at ability on her 6f Redcar debut in May 2024 but not seen again until trailing home at Carlisle (1m, soft) 23 days ago.
In good hands but no promise when remote sixth over 1m on AW and 7f on good to firm this spring.

Third on both starts nine months apart (gelded in between), actually bettering the form of his debut in a ten-runner race when last of three at Nottingham (extended 1m, soft) three weeks ago; cheekpieces worn there are left off now.
150-1 when tailed off on recent Southwell debut.

Won three sprint handicaps last spring and he is now 9lb lower than for the last of them; 2026 had been a struggle until he emerged from the doldrums with a good second at Ripon (6f, good) two weeks ago; now has something to build on.
6f AW winner as a 2yo but her losing run stands at 15 and this year's efforts don't suggest it will be ending any time soon.

C&D winner last summer; landed a 5f handicap at Catterick off a 2lb higher mark in April but he hasn't come close to replicating it in six runs since; capable if breaking on terms but he carries some risk.
Failed to progress for Hugo Palmer but his two turf runs for this yard in May were both encouraging; edging down the weights and he should appreciate a strong pace at this trip.

OwnerName: The Good Racing Company Ltd & Partner
Spotlight: Ran well on her stable debut at Wolverhampton last October but only run to that level once from four starts this year; returns to sprinting with the tongue-tie discarded; dangerous mark but others appeal more.
6f AW winner for Kevin Ryan; second of ten in a 5f classified event at Southwell on his seasonal/stable debut 13 days ago; no problem with conditions and he's one to take seriously.

OwnerName: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner but 0-14 on turf; his last two runs on grass have offered hope that he can win a small race on fast ground though and he is one for the shortlist.

OwnerName: R Chapman, G J Daly & R J Parks
Spotlight: Won twice last July, including when beating 17 rivals in the corresponding race (good ground; 2lb lower today); arrived in better form last year but she can't be discounted.

Just one win to his name from 21 attempts but he has finished second in two of his three runs this year and is still on a workable mark; new blinkers could spark something extra (ran well in one attempt in cheekpieces) and he's more appealing than many.
Two AW wins over this trip but he wasn't at his best when last seen in March; his three turf starts are all excusable to some degree and he could prove as effective on grass in time.

OwnerName: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing
Spotlight: Beaten a nose by Mrs Trump in this race last year when rated 5lb higher; not at his best this year but his Redcar fourth in May offered hope he could add to his 11 wins.
6f AW win in November (visored first time) and placed on a few occasions subsequently; neither start since returning from a four-month break has been near that level though.
She has run some good races in big-field handicaps over C&D and this is her level; not far off her recent best at Carlisle 16 days ago; each-way shout if getting it right at the start.
Regressive 17-race maiden; too much to prove for comfort.

OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: 0-10 but she has snippets of form that give her a squeak; last week's fifth of seven at Catterick wasn't as bad a run as the distance beaten suggests (hampered at a crucial stage) and she's not out of it.

Unplaced all eight starts; got a bit closer to the target when fifth of 12 in a 5f handicap at Newcastle six weeks ago (blinkered first time); suspicion he'll do better at some stage but he is not the obvious answer this time.
Unplaced in all ten starts; whiff of promise at Nottingham in April but he is opposable on balance.
No improvement for handicapping (6f, good and 1m, soft) in May; tongue-tie and cheekpieces added but he has plenty to prove.

OwnerName: Nick Bradley Racing 16 And Jmr Partners
Spotlight: Won a Beverley maiden on her second start but 0-12 since; more realistically handicapped again now and she ran a sound race at Pontefract (6f, good; cheekpieces first time) last month; soft ground excuses latest lesser effort; not discounted down into a 0-70.
Creditable efforts in three Newcastle maidens in February/March (6f twice and 5f); while she still has time to do better, that AW form is not strong and improvement is essential.

Two wins in 6f handicaps in May; beaten favourite in 5f handicaps at York and Thirsk on his last two starts but has left the impression there is still a bit more to come; return to 6f will help and he's a major player.

Off the mark at the 11th attempt when gamely landing a 6f handicap at Ripon (good ground) in April; beaten at short odds when fourth to Simba's Pride at Hamilton shortly afterwards and his form then dipped at Pontefract (5f) four weeks ago; returning to 6f should help; cheekpieces worn last time are quickly discarded.

OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing D Turner B Roberts
Spotlight: Started his 3yo campaign with a 6f win at Chelmsford in March and he followed up at Yarmouth (5f, good) one month later; beaten favourite but performed with credit at Nottingham (5f) and Wolverhampton (6f) since; sneaking up the weights but likely to give another good account.

Promise in his sole 2yo start (6f, good to firm); no progress in two runs this year but he has been sent off a single-figure price on each start and could take a step forward now handicapping at a realistic level.
Off the mark at the eighth attempt with a ready win at Redcar (6f, good) 11 days ago, strong at the finish; up 5lb in a higher grade but he's not fully exposed just yet.

Yet to win but he has finished second three times in novice/maiden company; cheekpieces have been worn for his three handicap runs and he has finished unplaced, albeit a bit of mid-race interference didn't help his cause over C&D four weeks ago; now drops into a 0-70 and could yet come good.
0-10 and she has yet to shine for her new stable, beaten 14l behind Simba's Pride at Ripon five weeks ago; lots to prove.
His two runs this year have both threatened better and this well-bred 3yo moves into handicaps with some potential; he could do with settling better if he is to fulfil it though.

OwnerName: J Raybould N Skinner D Jenkins
Spotlight: The addition of a visor saw him break his duck in a 5f handicap at Newcastle in May; always on the back foot after an awkward start at York 19 days ago; this is weaker and he should be fine back at 6f but others appeal as being better treated.
Front-runner who landed three 1m handicaps last autumn, the last two at Newcastle (Tapeta); twice placed at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) earlier this year but recent efforts less encouraging.

Brother to 7f-1m2f winner Al Mubhir (RPR 115); has made steady progress in his three starts, finishing 4l second to a useful prospect in 1m3f Hamilton maiden (good to soft) three weeks ago; makes handicap debut; should continue to improve.
Best effort when third on 1m4f Newmarket handicap debut (good) 12 days ago, staying on in a style which suggests there could be more to come as his stamina is drawn out.
Consistent form when runner-up in all three novice events and third of nine on handicap debut at Chester (1m2f, good to soft); rallied last time as if 1m4f could help.

Failed to progress for a switch to handicaps when fourth of nine at Epsom (1m2f, soft) on Derby day but stuck on in a style which suggests this step up to 1m4f could unlock some improvement; likely to go well.
Dropped into Class 3 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago and ran a good race for second, edging left in the closing stages but keeping on well regardless; still has handicapping scope up 1lb.
He has run well over C&D in the past, including in May, and he didn't run badly when third of six in a Class 3 handicap at Pontefract (6f, good) ten days ago; each-way shout.
Got up late to win a 6f handicap at Pontefract on his stable debut in April; no impact in a 7f handicap at Epsom on Oaks day; others bring stronger credentials.
6-21 on AW but still seeking a first turf win after 14 attempts; ran okay at York last month without suggesting he was the answer today.

OwnerName: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover
Spotlight: Back to form with a bang when seeing off 19 rivals at York (6f, good) in May; similar form when fourth of 21 back at York 18 days ago; should remain competitive.
Well handicapped on 2025 best; ran a fine race for third on his seasonal return at Ripon in April but two heavy defeats have followed (behind Novello Lad latest); needs a full revival.

Won his first two starts in maiden/novice company; second of nine at Windsor (6f, good to firm) on his handicap debut last June but it has been tougher going since; latest third at Ripon was a promising enough return to action though and he should give a good account.

Progressive sprinter in 2025 (following wind surgery) and he has carried on the good work this year, winning 6f handicaps at Doncaster in May (good to soft) and June (good to firm); up 4lb in a stronger race but he may not have finished progressing just yet.

He had dropped a long way in the weights before ending a losing run at Newcastle (5f) in March; added a C&D win in April and he has run well in defeat in both runs since; creeping back up the weights and had a 53-day break but he has the ability to go well.
Fine servant down the years but he hasn't won over 6f since August 2022; on a good mark and can pop up soon but would like to see more from him before getting involved.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: It took him 17 attempts to put his head in front, finally opening his account in a 6f maiden at Newcastle in March; solid second in a 6f Southwell handicap one month later; absent for 81 days and although he isn't on a bad mark, he does have to prove his stamina for 7f.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: He has run a string of good races in 2026, winning for the second time when comfortably seeing off five rivals at Beverley (7.4f, good) last week; that effort was backed up by the Topspeed figure and he can't be discounted under a 5lb penalty.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 7f handicap at Redcar (good to firm) last summer off 2lb lower; not at her best over 1m this year; cheekpieces discarded today.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Low-key run at Newmarket (6f, good) 12 days ago; return to a longer trip is in his favour but others are more appealing for win purposes.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Over two years since his sole success and well held in two starts this year; on a dangerous mark but that has been the case for some time; returning to 7f not enough to tempt.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden over C&D last summer; back to form with a front-running second of seven in a fillies' handicap at Catterick (7f, good to firm; tongue tied first time) nine days ago; on a dangerous mark and one of two solid contenders for David O'Meara.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Still to add to her 2yo novice win; finished second of eight at Redcar (7f, good) in May but not in the same form in either run since; opposable.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden; solid effort over 1m at Ayr (soft) 12 days ago but that was a Class 6 and he is facing different conditions here.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
OwnerName: Buist, Shields, Thompson And Mrs R Carr
Spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; ran his best race for new connections when staying on over 6f at Doncaster 11 days ago; stays 7f but he may need a drop into Class 6 to break his duck.

RaceName: William Hill Summer Cup Saturday 1st August Book Now Handicap
Spotlight: 7lb below his last winning mark but that was back in October 2024; retains ability and he has been placed in all three C&D runs; should give his running.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Irish point win in 2025 was followed by two bumper successes in Britain; failed to win over hurdles since though and he hasn't looked about to score over fences of late either; probably needs more weight off his back.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won maiden hurdle in 2024; best effort for a long time when third of 11 here (2m7f, good; closely matched with Pike Road) in June but he was beaten too far in one previous chase start under rules, at Taunton last November, to have confidence now back over fences.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Career has had its ups and downs but he won two chases (3m1f and 3m6f) in March 2025 and ran one of his better races of the year when second of five at Stratford (3m4f, good to firm; blinkers replaced cheekpieces) in May; capable of going well over this lesser test if holding his form.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Successful handicap hurdle debut at Wetherby (about 2m5f, good) last October; no match at all for the winner on chase debut at Bangor (about 2m4f, good) in April but the return to this longer trip can help; first-time visor replaces cheekpieces; yard runs two.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Consistent either side of two wins at about 2m4f last December (good to soft and heavy) but there's nothing eyecatching about his mark now and he needs to find extra for the new trip.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has had some modest results since going close on yard debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, heavy) before Christmas; others much higher up the list.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Two hurdle wins in 2025, at about 3m on good and soft, and his recent second here was a return to form; has lower chase mark but hard to assess back over fences, having weakened on chase debut then unseated rider three out at Ludlow (still led sole remaining rival) that month; shade to prove.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Two hurdle wins, most recently in February, but she's been out of luck in three chase runs, including when a remote last of four at Uttoxeter (about 3m, good) in June; has it to prove for now.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bumper winner on debut in 2023; finally off the mark over hurdles (2m7f, good) last September but she's run to an ordinary level back in handicaps on last two starts and goes chasing with something to prove.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Had a spell in the doldrums for previous yard, so was well treated on debut for this one at Hereford (2m5f, good) in May when having a match in safe keeping from a fair way out; that form amounted to little (second well below best then and since) but this one has gone back up just 2lb and should stay this first attempt beyond 2m5f under rules.

RaceName: Perrigo Consultant Tax Saving Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Three chase wins since April 2025, at 2m and 2m4f, but he was pulled up in two of his last three starts for Olly Murphy and has a stamina query over the new trip on first run since January.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Maiden hurdler who is already doing better over fences, having stayed on well to win at Warwick (3m, good) in June on his second chase start; had run well over a similar trip to today's the time before and, although back up 5lb, he should have more to come.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Lightly raced; tenacious winner of 2m5f chase at Newton Abbot (good) last June but soft ground may have counted against her next time and she wasn't seen after July; a long way back on her recent yard debut but there's still hope for her at this level on anything like her old form.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: The Galloping Dentist At 45 The Green
Spotlight: Hurdle winner here (2m7f, good) last August for previous yard but he's had a rocky ride for this one, including on last two chase starts (the latest following wind surgery); hard to be confident of a revival.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Very modest hurdle form but she went chasing off a career-low mark at Southwell (2m4f, good) in June and took a healthy step forward, keeping on well against one in a good run of form; back up 2lb; can threaten.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Has shown promise in a bumper and over hurdles but he's been pulled up on his last two starts, over hurdles and on chase debut, and returns from his second wind surgery since the autumn with plenty to prove.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Better known as a pointer, adding two more in the spring, and her challenge didn't last long over C&D three weeks ago; up against it from out of the weights.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Four chase wins include two here, one in this race last year; creditable return from a break at Fontwell in April but he's struggled in two Warwick runs since, the step up to 3m seemingly not the main issue last time; just below his latest winning mark though so hard to dismiss.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Looked a potential improver when convincing winner on second chase start, over C&D (good) last June; hasn't delivered on that promise since and was right off her game at Ffos Las in April; at least this is easier.

RaceName: Brookes Wedding Feast & Fair Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Useful chase strike-rate, winning three of six completions (at up to about 2m3f; good to soft and good) since October; well below best over C&D latest but overall form suggests he could soon put that behind him.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair bumper winner; yet to add to that over hurdles but she has made the frame on all her six runs, a non-staying fourth in 2m4f Fakenham novice in May on latest; needs considering back in trip for her chasing debut.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Modest maiden hurdler; yet to offer much in two runs in this sphere, hooded when a well-held third of four in 2m4f handicap here 25 days ago; lots more is required from 2lb out of the handicap.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair winning 2m hurdler who wasn't discredited when fifth in 2m5f handicap at Market Rasen in May; much respected now going chasing.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Much improved for Tom Lacey last season when a three-time 2m hurdles winner; off six months and made a promising start in this sphere with third of five in 2m1f handicap at Stratford 32 days ago, running on late under a patient ride; one to be interested in off a 2lb lower mark.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Cut little ice in a handful of runs over hurdles but this Irish point runner-up was much improved on his chasing debut when a 28-1 winner of nine-runner handicap over C&D two weeks ago; up 5lb but open to progress, so he's a player.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Ended his time over hurdles for Dan Skelton under something of a cloud; not disgraced on yard/chasing debut with third in 2m4f handicap here but pulled up in 2m7f handicap chase back here 20 days ago; has something to prove now.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made light of a five-month absence when gaining a third chasing win in his last four runs in 2m Warwick handicap in May; up 5lb but not taken lightly.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Gained a first chasing success at Doncaster (2m) last February; infrequently raced since and he came in a well-held fourth of five in 2m5f Fakenham handicap 31 days ago; needs to take a big step forward.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Martyn & Elaine Booth & The Maiden Over
Spotlight: Fair maiden hurdler; yet to offer much in three runs sent chasing though, undergoing wind surgery before pulled up in 2m7f handicap chase here 25 days ago; blinkers and tongue strap go on here.

RaceName: Worcestershire Ambassadors Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Signed off for Charles and Adam Pogson with 2m5f Fakenham chasing win last May; has failed to complete on all his five runs for his current stable however, tried in cheekpieces when pulled up at Leicester (2m4f) in February last time.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Quite useful on the Flat for the Crisfords over 1m4f on turf and at staying trips on AW; returned from a year off with an encouraging hurdle debut over C&D (good) in June for new yard, settling well and mostly jumping soundly behind two who had won on the Flat in France; looks sure to improve.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Placed on good to soft in all three bumper starts but she dropped out after making the early running on hurdle debut at Fontwell (about 2m1f, good; 16-1) in May; handicaps look more likely than a maiden win.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Returned from two years off to win a Ludlow bumper in 2025; up against it on first two hurdle starts but he ran better when third of eight finishers at Bangor (about 2m3f, good) in March and wasn't far away, though held, when falling at the last at Warwick since; in contention.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Flat winner at 1m2f in May 2025; refused to race in May this year but he came nearest to a first hurdle win when close up in an ordinary handicap at Southwell (2m, good) three weeks ago; shouldn't be far away.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Early promise in a bumper in May 2025; has hinted at some ability over hurdles and this is easier than when a remote fourth over C&D in June but he will be eligible for handicaps after today.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Out of a half-sister to Group 3 and Listed winners; has run respectably in two of three bumpers, most recently behind two newcomers here in May on yard debut; others may be too sharp for him now he's hurdling.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Runner-up in a Galway bumper; has run with credit against some good prospects in first two hurdle starts at Downpatrick and Cartmel (both 2m6f on good) in May but he was struck into when pulled up at Southwell since; has a part to play if this much shorter trip doesn't count against him.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Bred to come into his own over further than 2m but he's shown plenty of pace at Exeter and Uttoxeter (both on good) in his last two bumpers, getting worn down only late on; likely contender now hurdling.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: 300-1, pulled up on belated debut over C&D last month.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Nearly won a bumper here last summer and later close up in two runs over hurdles; no improvement when beaten 10l here 20 days ago but he did race freely after a break; entitled to be in the thick of it.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: 1-14 on the Flat, the win coming over about 1m3f at Yarmouth (good; fair form) in April; beaten 14l into second in a six-runner maiden hurdle at Huntingdon a month ago; likely to need more here.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-6 on Flat for the Gosdens; not beaten all that far in two of his three races over hurdles, latterly at Bangor in this new headgear combination; should have some role to play.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Winning pointer; runner-up for a second time over hurdles (0-6) when rallying over C&D 20 days ago; none too consistent and may ideally prefer further, but he boasts some of the best form among these.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: The winner of a weak good-ground bumper at Exeter; raced freely in his two runs over hurdles; weakening when falling in the first but then finished clear of the third behind a long odds-on winner at Warwick (2m, good) and that's something to build on.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Only 1-12 in points and 50-1 when tailed off on hurdle debut at Uttoxeter.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Half-brother to high-class jumper Any Second Now; beaten 20l in a bumper and even further in a maiden hurdle here two weeks ago when again easy to back; in a top yard but has no obvious form claims and looks one for further down the line.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: The winner of two from 11 points; can only be watched on this hurdling debut.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Closely related to high-class 2m hurdler Labaik; had wind surgery prior to running in a bumper here when he faded late on (wore a tongue-tie); sent off one of the favourites that day and should be capable of better.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Raced freely when tailed off in his first bumper; hooded for the second at Hereford (2m, good) and stayed on encouragingly from well off the pace to be about 15l off the winner; an unlikely winner of this but might be one to keep an eye on.

RaceName: Jane Newman Financial Planning Ltd Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Minor form under rules for Tom Lacey; has since gone 2-7 in points; others are much preferred.

RaceName: Warrens Hall Riding School Champions Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Winless since 2024 but he signed off for James Moffatt with a fair sixth of 13 in 2m1f Cartmel handicap in May; not out of things for his new handler.

RaceName: Warrens Hall Riding School Champions Handicap Hurdle

OwnerName: Zhao Guoming, Xiao Bing, Annie An Ran & Tan Meng Sha
Spotlight: Belied huge odds when fourth over C&D in April, his second Hong Kong start, but was unable to land a telling blow here last month; swaps cheekpieces for blinkers today.

OwnerName: David Philip Boehm & Anthony Cheung Hin Shun
Spotlight: Signed off in Ireland with two 7f wins in April 2025 but has been soundly beaten on all three Hong Kong starts this season (7f-1m).
Won off much-reduced mark at Happy Valley (6f) in February and is also suited by this C&D but recent efforts have been underwhelming and younger rivals have much more appealing profiles.

OwnerName: Yue Yun Hing & Anita Yue Lam Chik Sun
Spotlight: Won 7f maiden on second of his two appearances in Brazil but struggled on first two Hong Kong starts (both C&D).

Improving 4yo who has collected three 6f wins (one here) this season and made good late headway to take third off today's mark at Happy Valley last month; probably needs to take another step forward today, though.

OwnerName: Mr & Mrs Chan Hou Bo & Chan Jenny Chun Lai
Spotlight: Dual 5f course winner last year; made nothing better than a satisfactory reappearance over that trip last month but remains unexposed over 6f and lightly raced in general; contender if that recent outing brought him on.

OwnerName: 25/26 Frankie Lor Fu Chuen Trainer Syndicate (2)
Spotlight: Scored by a neck over C&D on debut in May and ran well in defeat here last month; probably still has potential; high on the list.
Made quite promising Hong Kong debut when fourth over C&D in February but we haven't seen him since a lesser effort the following month and he's poorly drawn today.
Won over 5f in Australia last year and made promising Hong Kong debut when third over that trip here last month; drawn wide for first 6f attempt but still enters calculations.

OwnerName: Dr Edwin Lam Chi Wan & Jason Lam Che Man
Spotlight: Generally progressive 4yo who posted a good effort when placed behind Tycoon Resources at Happy Valley last month, after a break; competes off same mark here but has much tougher draw this time.
Won twice in lower-grade company at Happy Valley (6f/5f) in early part of this season but has lost his way a bit since; others in this line-up have much stronger claims.
Yet to make a splash after four runs in Hong Kong and seemingly in need of a drop in grade.

OwnerName: HK Association Of Lady Horse Lovers Syndicate
Spotlight: Not at his best this year but handicapped accordingly now and was close up from a double-digit draw over C&D last month; can make his presence felt again.
Three-time C&D winner; much more exposed than some of his rivals but has been back in good form in recent months and Nichola Yuen's 10lb claim gives him some wiggle room; considered each-way.
Smart 2yo when based in Ireland but a down-the-field outsider on all six Hong Kong starts.
Exciting 3yo who won comfortably when upped to 6f at Happy Valley last month and is now 3-3; another 9lb higher for first run here but it's hard to gauge the limit of his ability.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Thunder Moon filly caught the eye when beaten 0.25l behind Cashel Queen in fourth on debut at Leopardstown three weeks ago; stable among the winners and improvement is likely; in the mix.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Stuck to her task well when landing Naas barrier trial in May; solid debut effort at Leopardstown (7f, soft) when beaten 5l, finishing ahead of Celtic Moon, Cloughleagh Bridge and Caoch The Piper; sets the standard and the promise of better ground should suit.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; 35,000gns 2yo; half-sister to Italian 7.5f/1m winner; dam 7f AW winner, out of half-sister to winners Tipsy Creek (5f Group 2), Abunawwas (7f Group 3) and Magic Cove (1m Listed); stable won three of last six runnings of this; shortlisted.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: First foal; dam placed 6f 2yo, half-sister to winners Oh Purple Reign (Listed-placed 6f-1m) and Warsaw Road (7f); dam placed 6f 2yo (70); stable 0-39 with 2yos; best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Paul J Nolan/Walerc Limited/M J Wasylocha/Tony Cantwell
Spotlight: Sixth foal cost 20,000euros as yearling; half-sister to winners Lady Of Inishfree (7f 2yo; RPR 94) and Chukotka (KSA 1m2f); dam 1m2f turf/1m4f AW winner (83), out of 12.5f Group 2 winner; stable 0-4 with 2yos this year; hooded.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Slowly away on 6.5f debut at Listowel but it was a respectable fourth behind the winner Beibhinn who finished third in a Group 2 subsequently, while runner-up Big Negotiator won at York before midfield in the Queen Mary; could improve up in trip.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Cheap purchase was well beaten in Naas barrier trial but better than bare result on 6f debut at Fairyhouse, weakening late on after forceful tactics early; needs to find more but hood may help.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal cost 37,000euros; looked in need of the experience when fifth of eight on 7f Leopardstown debut three weeks ago, weakening late on; behind Cashel Queen and Celtic Moon on that occasion so needs to improve.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Behind some of these on debut at Leopardstown and poor effort at Down Royal; work to do.

OwnerName: E D Delany & Mrs Lisa Delany
Spotlight: Down the field in turf/AW contests last year; long-priced C&D winner (soft) in April on first attempt at the trip before solid third at Gowran (7f, soft) from 9lb higher; would probably want rain but holds every chance.
Second runner for yard; never better than fourth in 12 outings; not a bad effort when fifth of 14 at Ballinrobe (1m2f) ten days ago but will need to pull out more to win this.

Soundly beaten in maidens; 66-1 for handicap debut when sixth of 14 at Down Royal (7f, good), not far behind Fontaine Khaled and Beau Army; failed to build on that at that venue on soft 13 days ago but could bounce back if the ground is good.
Third placing in a Ballinrobe claimer was a step in the right direction; not without her backers in first two handicap outings but has failed to deliver; tongue-tie is now reached for.

Has won over 6f/7f at Dundalk; ran her best race on turf when fourth behind the progressive Meriden at Down Royal on penultimate (one place behind Fontaine Khaled); nowhere near that level at Limerick since but player if at her best.

OwnerName: David Daly & Gerard Shevlin & D Battersby
Spotlight: Second runner for local yard; maiden went closest when chasing home a progressive type over 6f at Dundalk in April; has a tendency to miss the break; short of room and hampered 2f out when behind third-placed Fontaine Khaled at Down Royal on latest; not discounted.

OwnerName: Dan Kiely & C O'Neill & Apollo Thoroughbreds
Spotlight: Well held first two handicap starts but not beaten far at Naas in April and solid third of 14 at Down Royal (7f, good) on latest; the winner Meriden has gone on to win three more on the bounce (now rated 97) and three further winners have come out of the race; shortlisted up in trip.
Soundly beaten in three 7f maidens; failed to land a blow on 6f Fairyhouse handicap debut last month; Colin Keane booked stepping up in trip; watch the market for clues.
Penultimate Roscommon run his best yet, good fourth after not clear run in first-time tongue-tie; wide draw and testing ground valid excuses for poor effort at Leopardstown; better run expected here.
Second runner for yard; weak turf form last season; maiden's best form is on the AW; has plenty to find judged on two latest efforts at Gowran and Ballinrobe; new headgear combination.
Weak form in maidens; given a positive ride but ultimately faded out of things on Gowran handicap debut (9.5f); cheekpieces; others look more likely.

OwnerName: Ms Denise McCourt & Stephen Sweeney & Maire Bailey
Spotlight: Out the back in three maidens over trips ranging from 7f-1m4f; handicaps have likely always been the plan so worth a market check for local trainer.

First five runs this year on the AW, best effort on 7f handicap debut when beaten around 5l into fifth; finished last next time and no better on turf debut at Fairyhouse in May; new headgear combination; others preferred.

Won 7f Dundalk nursery on AW debut last November when trained by Donnacha O'Brien; didn't quite see out the stiff mile when close fourth at Dundalk on yard debut; completely tailed off over 6f at the Curragh on latest; headgear combination is back on eased in grade.
Triple-figure prices for all three maiden runs when well beaten; cheekpieces on for handicap debut at a more realistic level now handicapping; market will reveal expectations.

No wins in 11 but only his second run in this headgear combination when bang there at Cork (1m, yielding) last September; something amiss next time under Colin Keane at Dundalk; has been off the track since.
Weak form for Josh Halley; best run for Andy Slattery on yard debut when third in 7f claimer at Dundalk; regressive since; first run for Eoin Griffin; best watched.

Four wins at up to 1m but 0-19 for this yard; good effort despite racing keenly when close fourth of 14 at Down Royal (7f, good) on penultimate; dwelt over 6f at Fairyhouse on latest; worth a market check for local handler with Colin Keane booked.

Dual winner, including over C&D (good to yielding) last August off 3lb lower; best effort in three runs this year when close third at Limerick (7f, yielding) last month; slow break costly at that track a day later; could bounce back.

Last turf win came at Naas in August 2024 (7f, good); signs he could capitalise on sliding mark when close third at Killarney (1m, good) in May but disappointing favourite at Listowel next time; failed to see out 1m1f on soft at Leopardstown on latest but definite player at his best.
Shaped quite well at Galway last August on third maiden start; not a great deal of promise in handicaps, no better than seventh in four attempts; returns from 239-day absence.
Second runner for local yard; best run was at an early stage of last season; a long way below that standard this year; leap of faith required.
Dual AW winner is 0-27 on turf; middling effort at the Curragh last time and overall record on this surface is concerning.
Winner over 1m1f on quick ground in Britain; built on Limerick second last month when scoring decisively at that venue (1m, soft) nine days later; up 6lb but no reason why he can't go well again.

Second runner for yard; six-time winner in Britain; only glimpses of peak form since second in a claimer early last season, including third over C&D off 9lb higher; seventh of 16 over 1m at Gowran on seasonal debut; place chance.

OwnerName: P E Ryan & J G Shanahan
Spotlight: Sole run at this track resulted in C&D win (good) in April 2025 off 9lb higher; posted a couple of good efforts on the AW early this year; well held next two starts at Leopardstown; step in the right direction there last time when sixth of 14 after a slow break.

OwnerName: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney
Spotlight: Third runner for local yard; four-time winner; last turf win in 2023 over 8.5f at Galway (soft); two AW wins since; hard to fancy on this year's form but has placed multiple times over C&D, including when runner-up at this festival last year from a stone higher; can't dismiss.
Seven-time AW winner in Britain for Mick Appleby; no success since 2024; has shown nothing in 15 outings on the Flat and over hurdles for current yard.
Fourth runner for local yard; still a maiden after 18 starts, placed four times; had a good spell on AW early in the year; market can separate stable's runners.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Resold £36,000 yearling who didn't show much on sole start for Archie Watson at Nottingham (6f, good) four weeks ago; market will guide on Irish/stable debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; £2,500 yearling; half-sister to winners Jer Batt (5f inc AW; RPR 100) and Buddy Batt (5f inc 2yo/AW); dam 5f winner, half-sister to winners Another Batt (Turkish 6f 2yo Listed) and Iva Batt (5f/6f); market can guide.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sets a solid standard judged on his four maiden efforts to date, with marginally the best effort at Fairyhouse on penultimate (6f, good); not as good dropped to this trip at Down Royal (soft) 13 days ago but likely to be on the premises again.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Eclipse T'bred Partners/Gaynor Bloodstock LLC/F Gallagher
Spotlight: Second in Naas barrier trial in May; made a satisfactory debut five days later when third at Listowel (6.5f, good; the winner and runner-up ran at Royal Ascot subsequently); this opposition looks less demanding and she should have the speed for this trip.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; 4,000euros yearling; sister to winners Marty Hopkirk (5f AW; RPR 91) and Commander Straker (5f 2yo; RPR 88), half-sister to Nuevo Slovo (5f 2yo); dam 7f/1m AW winner (81), half-sister to 6f Listed winner Katia; best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Hung right when not beaten far behind Bit Of A Buzz on 5f Cork debut; well beaten behind Hip Hop Chrissy when upped to 6.5f at Listowel; debut effort offers some hope.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Not a bad effort on 5f debut at the Curragh when remote fourth, green before making modest late gains; ran to a similar level next time at Cork; perhaps may improve on better ground but will need to.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Cheap purchase; third in Naas barrier trial in May; slowly into stride and never a factor on racecourse debut at Fairyhouse (6f) last month; stable also runs Hip Hop Chrissy who holds stronger credentials.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Earthlight filly cost 20,000euros; wasn't far off Santo Parvenue when seventh of 10 on 5f Cork debut in May; likely improver; worth monitoring in the market.

Speedy AW winner is 1-8 on turf; finished last season in fine form on AW but soundly beaten both starts this term, including on return to handicap company in the Epsom 3yo Dash last time out; eased 3lb and Keane an eyecatching booking; could make a bold bid from the front.

Failed to win as a 2yo but put that right when making all in a Navan maiden (5f, yielding) on his penultimate start in first-time cheekpieces; not beaten far on handicap debut back there in blinkers on latest (5f, good) and 1lb lower now; in the mix with cheekpieces back on.

Prominent racer a three-time winner at 6f on good to yielding and soft/heavy; mixed form since scoring at the Curragh on seasonal return in March off 1lb lower; C&D form figures of 343 so considered but may need softer ground than this.

Won a fillies' maiden at Navan (6f, good) last September; okay runs in defeat in handicaps this season including when fifth at 6.10 Fairyhouse Wednesday (joint-favoiurite); will be suited by a strongly run race at this distance and likely to get that here; chance

Mostly campaigned (without success) in Listed company since winning off 77 at Chepstow (5f, gd-sft) last August; remains 10lb above that last success but a repeat of her 3l Cork fourth on penultimate would give her a squeak back in handicap company and she'll be suited by a strongly run race.
Four wins on the Flat but hasn't won on turf since June 2024; 4lb below that last success but recent form hasn't indicated that a return to winning ways is imminent; others preferred.

Gained reward for a string of solid efforts when always well positioned and winning at Navan (1m5f, good) 25 days ago; 6lb higher now but rider's 2lb claim partly negates that; consistent sort is a big player again.

Maiden hasn't run that badly in two of her three starts in handicaps; kept on well enough over 1m4f at Limerick on latest; dam closely related to 2m winner so may appreciate this longer trip but needs more to get her head in front.
Dual-purpose veteran; winner of nine races across both codes; bolted up at Sligo in May (1m6f, yld-sft) off 6lb lower; struggled the last twice however, and previous runs here have not been his best.
Maiden has shown glimmers, including when a 5.25l fifth at Navan on latest (1m5f, good); weakened late having led that day so still has stamina to prove in first-time tongue-tie.
Best run yet for this yard on seasonal return at Leopardstown where a 2.5l fourth of 19 (1m5f, good); same mark here and should strip fitter now so enters calculations.
Lightly raced 4yo didn't show a whole lot in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; always behind when beating just one rival home at Down Royal latest (2m, good); hard to fancy for now.

OwnerName: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Synd'/D O'Leary/J McNally
Spotlight: Just 1-21 on the Flat but not beaten far the last twice; closely matched with Kevin The Great on Navan running earlier this month; didn't quite see out 2m2f at Down Royal latest; goes well here and big chance back down in trip off last winning mark for local yard.
Much-improved effort on debut for this stable at Navan (1m5f, good) 25 days ago when keeping on for a 1.25l fourth of 16; should go well again off 1lb higher if in the same mood.

Hasn't won since 2023 and was struggling for form but took a step in the right direction when not far behind a couple of these at Navan last time; best form on easy ground, however, so could do with some rain.
Maiden ran well when a 3.75l fourth of 16 at Roscommon in May for this rider but hasn't backed that up; beaten 15l when down the field at Fairyhouse (1m4f, good) on latest.

A couple of her runs in 2024 suggested she could win a race but missed almost all of 2025 and heavy defeat on return from long layoff at Down Royal last month; cheekpieces go on and she's on a dangerous mark on her best form so check the market.

Useful jumper made a bright start on the Flat, winning this race at skinny odds last July then following up in another Q.R. race over 1m6f at Listowel; soundly beaten in Curragh handicap on seasonal return latest but this is easier and he's best treated by race conditions; obvious chance.

OwnerName: Michael J Mulligan & Patrick G Walsh
Spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at Ballinrobe (2m, good) on debut for this yard in late May off a mark of 105; now makes Flat debut and probably up against it on these terms.

OwnerName: Thomas Cox/Nap Racing Syndicate/James M Nolan
Spotlight: Two-time Flat winner when trained in France; has run a couple of decent races for this yard and one of his better efforts came when beaten just 2.5l by Lark In The Mornin when third in this last year; 10lb better off now and should strip fitter for his okay comeback run at Navan; chance.

OwnerName: Mrs Sheila O'Ryan & John F Doyle & Grant Leon
Spotlight: Dual-purpose sort has been running well on the Flat; two solid efforts in Curragh handicaps to sign off last season; okay effort in Q.R. race at Listowel in May and advertised wellbeing with good second in Curragh charity race last week; player.

Talented over jumps; rated 137 over hurdles and a five-time winner in that sphere; has struggled in chases on last few starts and has been off since March but returns with local yard among the winners and he bolted up in a bumper here back in 2023; check the market.
A winner of six races (four over hurdles and two on the level); however, a Flat rating of just 40 leaves him with heaps to find on these unfavourable terms.
Rated just 34 on the Flat and no win of any description since 2020; up against it.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 110,000gns yearling by New Bay; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Harold Shand (7f 2yo; RPR 85) and Unpresuming (Hong Kong 7f; 71); dam unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Toormore and 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Estidhkaar; hooded newcomer from a leading yard and the market should guide.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Won novice at Newcastle (7f, AW) in April on belated debut and better form when close fourth in C&D novice five weeks ago, both under 7lb claimer; plenty in this field have a form chance and he is one of them.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Not beaten far on debut at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last November and reappeared with good second in slowly run race there (8.6f, AW) one month ago; refused to enter stalls at Salisbury (7f) three weeks ago; if there's no repeat of that, she's one of the several leading form contenders.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Plenty of ability when taking minor honours at this track in a 7f novice in March and 1m maiden (close from the front) in April; in the mix.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 5-4 favourite when only fifth of six on debut at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; always-prominent second of 11 at Southwell (6f, AW) two weeks later, however, and that makes her a contender.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Failed to justify market prominence at Newbury (6f, good) last August on sole run as 2yo; a bit better there (7f, good) on May return but weakened into eighth of 15 and others in this line-up have accomplished more.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Close third over C&D last August, which requires some respect even though it came in between two heavy defeats (back here latest); gelded since; market can guide for his first run in 300 days.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Two runs on turf, finishing a lot closer at Brighton (6f, good to firm; made most) last time but he was only fifth of six and it was modest form; the equipment he wore that day (hood and cheekpieces) is dispensed with.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 450,000gns yearling; New Bay half-brother to five winners including Romantic Warrior (6f-1m2f including multiple Group/Grade 1s); slowly away when always behind in novice at Salisbury (7f, soft) three weeks ago but he was the 5-2 favourite, so he's presumably thought capable of much better; tongue tied this time and it will be interesting to see if his backers return.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Not far away on last three starts, particularly when second at Southwell (7f, AW; set pace) and Catterick (6f, good to soft; beaten a neck) three weeks ago; one of the form picks and another bold show should be on its way.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 9-1, finished 9l behind the pretty useful winner in maiden at Lingfield (7f, AW) in November but beat the other eight; gelded this May; could be a marked improver.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Half-brother to winners Sajir (5.5f-7f including 2yo/AW/Group 1; RPR 121) and First Kingdom (1m including AW; 92); about 13l sixth of ten in C&D novice (12-1) five weeks ago was modest form on debut, fading, but he could be better with that under his belt.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Third twice over C&D last autumn and same again when close up at Southwell (6f, AW) on reappearance; best form was on second start (before wind surgery) and he kept on stoutly last time, suggesting a return to 7f would suit; gelded since; firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 125-1 and hooded, slow-starting last of eight in maiden at Newmarket (1m, good) in April when trained by Des Donovan.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 220,000gns yearling; late foal; brother to two useful 7f winners, but this 3yo was beaten 18l over C&D (33-1) in April and just over 10l at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; 22-1) in early June; modest form.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Triple-figure odds when showing low-level form at Lingfield in September (7f, AW) and two weeks ago (6f, good); hooded in the latter, having refused to enter stalls at Nottingham (300-1) in April; no claims yet.

RaceName: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Speedy pedigree but no chance in novice at Yarmouth (6f, soft; 16-1) three weeks ago after badly blowing the start; hooded this time.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Encouraging fourth on debut here (6f) in May but he's taken two backward steps since and was tailed off at Leicester (7f, good) last month; still early days but he weakened quickly last time and has something to prove on nursery debut.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: 75,000gns yearling; hasn't lived up to market expectations in two turf runs but her latest third of six at Doncaster (6.5f, good to firm) was a step forward from her debut effort; should continue to improve with time and distance and she's in the mix on nursery debut; stablemate of Indian Land.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Civ & B R Millman
Spotlight: Won a Beverley novice (5f, good to soft) on her second start but she's finished down the field in both subsequent runs; had tough task in the Chesham at Royal Ascot but she's untried on AW and this looks competitive on her nursery debut; others preferred.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Ran green on Bath debut in May but he's shown clear promise with his placed efforts at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and Leicester (7f, good) in last two runs; gave it a good shot from the front when runner-up last time and he's an interesting contender on nursery debut.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Struggled in her three qualifying runs (5f), with a best RPR of 34; this new trip should be a better fit on pedigree but she's 9lb out of the weights on her nursery debut; passed over.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: D Kilburn, C Wright, F Mahony & Partner
Spotlight: Oscar Performance filly; ran green on her debut at Wolverhampton (6f) in May but she's finished in rear again in both subsequent runs; now steps up to 7f on nursery debut but she needs plenty of improvement.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Beat only one rival on his Leicester debut but he left that form a long way behind when scoring at Wolverhampton (6f, AW); that form is hard to weigh up but he finished well for a last-gasp success and is open to more progress on this step up to 7f; needs a close look in his first nursery.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: No progress in maiden/novice events but he did show promise with his debut fourth here (6f) in April; half-brother to a 2yo winner over this trip and he needs watching in market on nursery debut.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: C&D win last summer on his second start; similar form in defeat on his next two starts but he ended 2025 with a lesser effort and there was no revival on his reappearance at York (1m1f, good; first run since gelded; well backed) 19 days ago; dropped another 3lb and could benefit from the return to AW; still of interest.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Ready 7f AW win in January; upped to 1m for the first time at Lingfield in March and produced career-best form, finishing off best behind a winner who was red-hot at the time; absent since but could have more to come at this trip.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Dropped down the weights last summer and he has rediscovered his spark this time around, following third-placed efforts here and at Goodwood with a comfortable Salisbury success (all over 7f); probably stays this far but he has yet to be placed in his six 1m starts so it will be breaking new ground for him to win today.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
OwnerName: J Machale, S Tucker & S Jewell
Spotlight: Ran well over C&D last October and he was well backed when winning over 7f back here five days later; below his best at Chelmsford one day later; history doesn't suggest coming back from a break is the time to catch him.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Easy win at Lingfield (7f, good) on debut before pitched into Group 2 company for his second start; unsurprisingly came up short there but he was quickly back on track when defying a penalty at Southwell (7f) last October; bred to stay 1m and there should be more to come this year.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Won his first two starts for Karl Burke last year but he hasn't kicked on from his handicap debut second (1m, good to soft) last September (RPR 95); sold for 22,000gns in April; drops in class but not a solid option.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Three good runs over the winter (two of them from five runs in Bahrain) but he has struggled in two 7f runs back in Britain since April; handicapper slow to relent and this step up to 1m isn't sure to spark a revival.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Dual winner for Aidan O'Brien in his early days; his three wins this year have all been in claimers at Dundalk (6f-1m) but he travelled smoothly before winning with plenty in hand last time; with another new yard now but he remains well treated on old form and is not ruled out back in a handicap.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Won at Nottingham (8.3f, good to soft) and Southwell (1m, AW) in his first two starts, but he's struggled in three of his four handicaps including when last of ten at Chester (10.3f) last month; has looked stretched in both attempts at that trip but he needs a major revival back on AW; first-time visor replaces cheekpieces.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Ex-French gelding who made the breakthrough when landing the odds on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m, AW) in May; flopped in his follow-up bid at Leicester but that was at 1m2f and the tacky ground may have been an issue; now drops back in trip and it wouldn't be a surprise if this unexposed 4yo resumes his progress.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Triple turf winner who is 0-10 on AW but she returned after 202 days off with a respectable fourth over C&D in May; didn't get the best of runs in that race and has possibilities if she can build on that; regular hood is removed.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: Dual course winner who scored twice at Wolverhampton (8.6f/7f) in March; hasn't threatened in his last four runs but he was respectable fifth over C&D on Monday; this is a quick turnaround but his last win was off this mark and he could be dangerous if he gets the breaks; cheekpieces reapplied.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Eight-time AW winner who has finished runner-up over C&D in his last three starts including a close call on his penultimate run; should give it another good shot and he's respected.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Won over C&D in April and he went close on Polytrack and turf in his next two starts; didn't really fire at Newmarket (1m, good) last time but he still looks on a workable mark and has claims if he can get back near best.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Won AW handicaps at Kempton (7f) and Southwell (1m) last August and he's been in good form in the UAE this winter, including when runner-up at Abu Dhabi (1m, good) on his penultimate run; returns after 111 days off but he's strongly respected back on Polytrack.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Record of 4232 in novice/maiden events and was a good second on her handicap debut at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in October; looks interesting on that form but she's struggled in both subsequent runs (1m, good/soft) and needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late G Kennington
Spotlight: All three wins have been at Kempton and latest was over C&D last June; now 1lb lower than for that success but he's been up and down since and was quiet on his reappearance here in May; comes with risks attached.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Winner of a bumper and three novice hurdle races, most recently a Grade 2 here in February 2025; chasing didn't work out but he mostly ran with credit in defeat back over hurdles and three Flat races have been thrown in (1m3f here latest) in which he's shown some ability; it's not clear what his ideal Flat trip is but he's now qualified for a Flat handicap mark and it's a highly attractive one compared to his hurdles figure.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: R A Pegum And Paul Anthony Henry
Spotlight: Won last September on first two starts for yard; disappointing favourite at Newmarket (1m4f, good) on return but second of 13 over C&D (Bulletin fourth) five weeks ago was his best form yet; up 3lb but this race looks less competitive.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two wins from six starts since joining Hayley Burton, both over 1m4f on Lingfield Polytrack; dictated the pace on second occasion and he's not been in quite such good form on either start since, albeit with 2m looking a stretch on latest; probably on the premises.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Extraordinarily consistent sort who is yet to finish out of the frame in 16 starts; Master Vintner and two others proved too strong for him late on over C&D two starts back but that rival is 3lb worse off at today's weights, so they are very closely matched.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: A fairly useful dual winner (about 1m1f) in France for Andre Fabre in 2025, latterly on Polytrack; sold for 40,000gns in October and gelded; not seen since and needs to hit the ground running on debut for new yard.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Well treated judged on peak form (AW in spring 2025) but it's a serious concern that his latest start (five weeks ago; made most) so seriously damaged his record of going well when back from a break; that was the first time he's been tongue tied (as he is today) and also his first race at Kempton.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Dual Kempton winner in 2023 and he's very well handicapped judged on form as recent as one year ago; Bahrain last winter did not go well for new connections, however, and although there was a whiff of his old form when seventh of 13 over C&D on his British return in May, he tailed off at Epsom ten days later; soft ground might excuse that but there are questions to answer.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Made a winning debut in a newcomers' race at Deauville (6.5f, AW) last October, but well held in three starts on turf since; still unexposed but he was withdrawn after getting upset in the stalls at Newbury last week and others are preferred; equipment removed.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won a 5f maiden at Catterick last summer but he's been expensive to follow in handicaps this year; now 9lb lower than for his opening mark but he's been well held in last three runs and needs blinkers to make a difference.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Promising fourth on Lingfield debut in December before a last-gasp win over 6f at Chelmsford (7-2) the following month; well held in final run during the winter but he raced wide in that 7f novice; returns after 162 days off but he's still unexposed and needs a close back in trip on handicap debut.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Showed some promise in her qualifying runs including when fourth of 11 at Chester (7f, good) in May; has shaped as though this drop back in trip could suit and she needs watching in market on handicap debut.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Encouraging return when third of ten in a C&D maiden in May and although only third of four at Windsor (6f, good to firm) three weeks later, the winner and fourth have won since; opening mark is no gift but it's still early days and he should have more to offer.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Maiden winner (7.5f, good) for Jessica Harrington last August but he's finished down the field in three subsequent runs including on handicap/stable debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; still lightly raced but he needs to raise his game.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Six-race maiden for two different yards but he ran into some trouble when a fair third in Ffos Las handicap (5f, good to soft) last month; dropped another 2lb and he could be dangerous on this step back up in trip.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding; dead-heated in a Chelmsford maiden (6f, AW) on second run for current yard but he's been well held in two handicaps since; has bit to prove again and overall record record is now 1-7.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Suited by the drop to 6f when scoring on handicap debut at Windsor (good to firm) in May; only 2lb higher here but he lost his action and was pulled up at Windsor two weeks ago; needs to bounce back after that and he still has a bit to prove on AW.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won a Yarmouth maiden (6f, good to firm) for William Haggas last August; has mixed record since but she got back near her best when third at Newcastle (6f, AW) in May; 1lb lower after a short break and she's a player if she can back that up.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won a Newcastle maiden (6f, Tapeta) for George Boughey last October, but he's struggled in four runs for new yard this year; continues to drop down the weights but he needs a major revival back on AW; blinkers removed.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner (made all both times), including when beating Travel Agent in April; below his best on turf next time but he's been placed on the AW in both starts since; contender.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: C&D winner in January off a 1lb higher mark than today's and he's posted some good efforts since, including when fifth of 18 in a 0-80 at Ascot in May; beaten about 3l when sixth at Goodwood (7f, soft) 25 days ago and now drops in grade.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: C&D winner early last year when trained by Phil McEntee and his other success came on the AW at Southwell in October; reported to have lost both shoes when fifth at Newbury (6f, good to firm) nine days ago and may come on for that first start since January; cheekpieces added.
