OwnerName: Rotary Club Of Kwai Chung Syndicate
Spotlight: He's proving fairly consistent at 6f without looking ahead of his mark but the handicapper is slowly relenting; should have a race in him.

Won over 7f in New Zealand; 0-7 in Hong Kong but some signs that he's dropping to a realistic mark, for all that he failed to make the anticipated progress returned to 7f (from 6f) last time; drawn wide.
Won twice here in early part of this season and back in prime form when close third under Zac Purton here last month; another turn looks near.
Now 0-14 but he's produced five competitive performances on the bounce, all here at 5f and mostly 6f; his mark hasn't moved so he's entitled to be in the thick of it once more.
Beaten in trials; has finished closer in each of his official races, last time beaten 3.5l at Sha Tin (5f); should have more to offer but perhaps one for another day from stall 11.

OwnerName: Siu Chak Wai, Siu Wai Chung & Siu Wing Kin
Spotlight: In three of his four runs over C&D he's been beaten under 2l, last time only a length off the winner under a positive ride; still lightly raced so may do better again.

OwnerName: Mr & Mrs Stephen Ho Wai Man, F Ho Ka Chun & D Ho Ka Chung
Spotlight: Dual winner in Britain and added a 6f handicap at Sha Tin in March when only 3lb lower; has continued to run well and has form here, but his draw is a negative.

OwnerName: Chan Ngan Chi & Chen Yung Hung
Spotlight: All three wins have come over C&D and latest defeat was at a mile; has some solid runs to his name this year at this trip.
Had plenty of racing in trials but has failed to win one and he'd be a surprise winner on official debut.
Some of this year's runs have been respectable but not any of his last four; bit to prove right now.

OwnerName: Ma Pak Hung & Man Pui Kwan
Spotlight: Won readily over C&D in May, his third run for Danny Shum, and ran at least as well when keeping-on third to Forerunner here last month; better drawn today and Zac Purton takes over; could still have more to offer.

OwnerName: Ng Tai Wing, Anson Or Yiu Wah & Henry Yeung Mun Kin
Spotlight: In good form in recent months, most notably when winning over C&D two starts ago; had to settle for fourth off new mark at Sha Tin 17 days ago but is well drawn again here and has each-way claims at least.
Placed on consecutive C&D starts in April/May, latterly from stall 12, and was denied a clear run when only fifth here last month; remains of interest but is back in the outside box today.
Won from inside stall over C&D in May but was unable to land a telling blow off new mark last month; might find others better handicapped again.

OwnerName: Wilson Chu Kwok Yiu, Paul M F Cheng Et Al
Spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in Hong Kong with comfortable C&D win in April, his 22nd attempt, but was below that form on his last two appearances and his favourable draw is not enough to earn him the vote.

OwnerName: Janet Wong Hoi Shan, John Yuen Se Kit Et Al
Spotlight: Runner-up over C&D on two of his last three outings but his only win from 19 starts came in lower-grade company and he's not ideally drawn today; will probably find at least a couple in this field too strong.
Didn't fire over 1m last time but went close over that trip in April and can cope with today's drop back to 6f; has form in higher-grade company this season and can't be ruled out.

OwnerName: Jason Chow Hei Shing & Chow Yuk Yin
Spotlight: Came good with C&D win in February and made the frame here on next two outings; latest run is probably best overlooked (lost action and was pulled up) but wide draw asks quite a lot of him.
Now only 1lb higher than when winning over C&D in February but has gone off the boil lately and is poorly drawn; refitted blinkers the headgear of choice today.

Delivered on earlier promise when scoring narrowly over C&D in April, his sixth start, and quickly rebounded from a poor run when third here last month; not quite so well drawn today but not yet fully exposed; shortlisted.
Dual Class 5 winner this year, latterly when clinging on by a nose over C&D five weeks ago; looks vulnerable in this higher grade, though.
Unexposed after only four runs but yet to build upon his encouraging debut at Sha Tin in March; others preferred.
Low-mileage 5yo who won twice in Class 4 last year (5f/6f); has found things tougher since upped in grade, though, and was safely held at Sha Tin a week ago.
Made the frame over C&D on last four appearances, most recently when third from stall 1 six weeks ago; not so well drawn this time but new jockey Jerry Chau claims 2lb; probably won't be far away.

OwnerName: Chu Tak Wing, Casey Chu Yin Ling & Ronald Chu Tak Wah
Spotlight: Progressive 5yo who has collected three C&D wins this season and posted another career-best performance when close third here a fortnight ago; outside draw the obvious negative today, though.

OwnerName: Edmund Ho Kwok Shing, Joe Fong Fu Yuen Et Al
Spotlight: Won off reduced mark in 5f Class 4 event at Sha Tin in April and put in good front-running shift when sixth (just behind Dragon Four Seas) over that C&D in this higher grade a week ago but others appeal more all the same.

Dual 6f course winner in December and placed on three of his four starts this year; didn't run badly from wide stall when last in action (March) and shows enough early zip to be of interest back at 5f.

OwnerName: Dr Alan Lee Wai Kin, Dr Kelvin Chong Man Yuk Et Al
Spotlight: Well down the field on first three stable starts but took big step back in right direction and outran huge odds when close fifth at Sha Tin a week ago; now needs to build on that effort.
Came from off the pace to take fifth from stall 10 over C&D on stable debut a fortnight ago and has the option to revert to more positive tactics from more favourable draw today; interesting.
Scored off 2lb higher over C&D in December but recent efforts have been disappointing; needs to turn a corner.
Absent since disappointing 6f run in February but was placed twice over C&D at start of this year and will be dangerous from stall 1 if fully tuned up after his break.
1-4 when based in Australia, the win gained in a 6f maiden; makes Hong Kong debut after ten-month absence, though, and probably best watched.
Ex-Australian 4yo; launched Hong Kong career with three low-key C&D runs and has much tougher draw today; look elsewhere.
Caused 21-1 surprise over C&D in April, opening his Hong Kong account at the tenth attempt, but safely held since and not easy to predict.

Off the mark in Hong Kong at seventh attempt, finishing strongly from the rear for cosy C&D success last month; it's hard to predict whether this race will pan out in the same way but a recent 7lb rise looks manageable.
Largely consistent 4yo who was placed over today's trip at Sha Tin in May; not quite in same form over 1m there last month but recent 2lb drop is helpful; considered each-way.

Close third to Le Zonda off today's mark over C&D last month and an obvious contender if judged on that performance but has very mixed record this year and needs to bounce back quickly from a poor dirt run.
Won 1m2f Group 2 in Australia last April but is yet to be placed after four Hong Kong starts and is seemingly in need of some help from the local handicapper.

OwnerName: Mr & Mrs Edward Hung & Doris Hung
Spotlight: Won over C&D in early part of this season and seemed to have emerged from a dip in form when keeping-on third at Sha Tin (1m2f) last month; remains on a good mark; in the mix.

OwnerName: Daniel Yeung Ngai & Gwenny Wu Pui Kwan
Spotlight: Gamely made all over 1m2f at Sha Tin in April, his sixth Hong Kong start, and probably bettered that performance when close second over that C&D in May; ran as though something was amiss last time and Zac Purton now jumps ship but he's a contender if back on song.

OwnerName: Peter Lau Pak Fai & Suki Tang Xianfang
Spotlight: Progressive 4yo who made all in 1m4f Group 3 handicap at Sha Tin in May and was placed in Group 3 handicap over today's trip there 17 days ago; needs to be taken very seriously.
Regressive 7yo who ought to have been suited by the return to dirt when safely held in first-time blinkers at Sha Tin 11 days ago; has usual cheekpieces back on for this turf return; revival needed.
Made all over C&D in May and posted another career-best performance when close second here last month; evidently in prime form; respected.
Dual 1m course winner this season; split Le Zonda and Glittering Legend when creditable second over C&D last month but is effectively 5lb higher from out of the weights today.
Dual course winner this season (1m1f/1m) but not quite at best on recent outings and still on a fairly tough mark; others have more pressing claims.

Placed twice over 1m since winning over that trip here in April and this extra furlong suits him; nudged up 2lb to new career-high mark and has awkward draw to contend with but still enters calculations.
Posted sound effort when fifth over C&D in April and has another good draw today but this is his first run for 11 weeks ago and he has not been firing on all cylinders this season.
Took form to new level when scoring over C&D last month and is now 2-8 in Hong Kong; latest 8lb rise asks quite a lot of him but he still commands respect.
Came good in Hong Kong at fifth attempt, with C&D win in April, but has been safely held twice since (albeit from wide draws) and needs to kick on again.

OwnerName: Mr & Mrs Simon Ng Kar Ming
Spotlight: Just held on from King Profit to exploit much-reduced mark over C&D last month and remains well handicapped on older form but he's getting long in the tooth and others have more appealing profiles.
Kept on for fourth over C&D on last month's stable debut and remains on a workable mark but double-digit draw dents his appeal; usual cheekpieces left off.
Dual 5f winner in Australia; has shown clear promise over that trip in Hong Kong but is yet to be placed after four local runs and has tough draw for this first attempt at 6f.

Progressive for new stable this season, winning twice (once over C&D) and making the frame six further times; gave another good account when fifth from stall 12 here last month and is much better draw today; ought to be right in the thick of things.

OwnerName: Mr & Mrs William Y W Lai, Stanley Y C Hong & Sammy Y C Long
Spotlight: Steadily progressive 5yo who won readily over 5f here in May and lost out only by a short head to Power Koepp over C&D last month; Zac Purton takes the ride today; likely contender.
Four wins this season, the latest over in April; posted sound effort when fifth over C&D last month but will need to find something extra to overcome this career-high mark.
Made respectable stable debut over 6f at Sha Tin in May but finished last over 5f here a few days later and looks opposable from stall 11.

Has twice made all in Class 4 this season (once over C&D) but was reeled in fairly comfortably when back up in this grade last month and, although much better drawn this time, may remain vulnerable at this level.

OwnerName: Arthur Antonio Da Silva, Betty Da Silva & Teresa Da Silva
Spotlight: Won consecutive C&D races in March/April and rebounded from a duff effort when second over C&D a fortnight ago; deserted by Zac Purton today and not ideally drawn but still enters calculations.

TrainerName: B V Van Den Troost right

Spotlight: Daughter of Wootton Bassett who built on debut promise with a running-on second of nine in 7.5f maiden at Ffos Las on her return 16 days ago; capable of better still and a big player here for yard well among the winners.

Underwent wind surgery before shaping well when a debut third of 12 in novice at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 25 days ago; the hood is left off today; this daughter of Kingman seems sure to do better.
Territories gelding who has shown fair form when placed in novices at Wolverhampton (8.5f) and Newcastle (7f) this summer; may do better still so must enter calculations on his turf debut.
Sent off 50-1 but made a promising start with second of 13 in 1m novice at Southwell three weeks ago; this son of Knicks Go should build on it here.
50-1, debut seventh of 11 in 7f novice at Newcastle 13 days ago; lots more is required from this Bated Breath colt.
80-1, eighth of ten in 7f novice at Newcastle on his debut in November; this son of Night Of Thunder needs to take a major step forward.

RaceName: Molson Coors EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 12-1, shaped well when a debut third of nine in novice at Newmarket (7f, good) 20 days ago; this Sea The Stars filly seems sure to build on it.

RaceName: Molson Coors EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 15-2, encouraging fourth of five in maiden at Catterick (7f, good) on her debut four weeks ago, keeping on late; this Sioux Nation filly can take a step forward here.

RaceName: Molson Coors EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 11-4, made a promising debut when fourth of nine in 7f novice at Kempton last month; that form has been franked so this Dubawi filly merits serious consideration.

RaceName: Molson Coors EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Minzaal filly who took a big step forward from her debut fourth when a clear second of six in 7f Wolverhampton novice in May; capable of better still.

RaceName: Molson Coors EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 14-1 and green when a never-dangerous seventh of nine in maiden at Haydock (6f, good) on her debut in May; this daughter of Advertise can improve a fair bit for the experience.
Winless since his debut in 2024 and he arrives below par, only sixth in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap last time; also has his stamina to prove.

Ex-Irish maiden who was quick to make her mark for Daragh Bourke, landing 1m5f classified event at Ayr before following up in 1m4f Musselburgh handicap later in June; posted another good effort under a penalty with fourth at Ayr (1m5f) last time; major player.
Finally gained a first win in 9.5f classified event at Wolverhampton in February; not proved easy to catch right since and beat one in 1m6f Redcar handicap last time; others are preferred.

OwnerName: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing
Spotlight: In good form until a below-par sixth of eight in 1m7f handicap at Ayr 20 days ago; the sort to bounce back.

Gained sole victory at Leicester (1m2f) last June and back in good form of late, beaten a neck when runner-up in 1m4f Leicester handicap two weeks ago; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb in a headgear change.
He's 0-17 and came in last of 13 in 1m2f classified event at Newcastle last time; not easy to make a case for.
Had some fair form for Richard Hannon last season; running creditably for current stable without really threatening; now drops into a Class 6 and he is one to note for market confidence.
He hasn't run badly in Class 6 handicaps on his last two starts but is still operating below his best; likely to run well all the same.

Game effort to win a 5f handicap at Thirsk (good ground) last month; dropped away having made the running at Newcastle 13 days ago; has run well at Carlisle before but over 5f and this test might be stiffer than ideal.
Eight-time winner, the latest over C&D (good to soft) 14 months ago off a 5lb higher mark; capable at this level but slower ground would have been preferable.
Ran okay on her seasonal return in April but she hasn't built on it in four runs since; had 17 runs at 6f+ and she has been unplaced in all of them.

Three 6f AW wins for Iain Jardine in the spring; also ran well on turf at Hamilton in May but his form has dipped since; not on a bad mark and his stable is going well but he does need to raise his game again.

OwnerName: David Tate, Danny Lawson & Kevin Broadley
Spotlight: It took him a long time to get off the mark but he has won three of his last six starts and two of his last three; form of latest Pontefract (6f, good) success couldn't be working out much better (second, third and fourth all won next time) and a 3lb rise is no issue; obvious chance.

6f AW win for William Haggas in January (blinkered first time); struggled in three runs for Martin Dunne in the spring and she has finished out the back in two runs for new connections; new headgear tried but risky.
Whiff of promise in three novice/maiden runs but she was well beaten on her handicap debut at Redcar (1m, good) 19 days ago; drops in trip with a point to prove.

Ended his time with James Owen with a couple of lesser efforts and he could only manage a midfield finish here (7f, soft) on last month's stable debut; dropping down the weights but others are stronger.
Still to add to his debut win in 14 subsequent outings and it has been tough going so far for this stable; now drops into a Class 6 and a revival wouldn't be out of the question.

Highly tried after her wide-margin maiden win last summer and she has come up short; perhaps stretched by 7f here (good to firm; cheekpieces first time) on her seasonal/handicap debut two weeks ago; dropped 3lb and still has time to dip back into her early promise.
Won twice as a 2yo and she has run well for second in a couple of stronger fillies' handicaps (6f, good) on her last two starts; Ethan Tindall's claim helps matters and she is high on the shortlist.
A hood has helped in recent starts, winning at Newcastle (6f) in March and running creditably in turf handicaps (6f/5f, both good ground) twice last month; needs more to come out on top here.
On a competitive mark and ran well for fourth in a good handicap at Ayr (6f, good) on Monday; one to take seriously back against her own sex.
Hold-up mare who hasn't found her best form yet this season; slipping down the weights and she's likely to come good again soon, albeit her record suggests that might be on AW.
Sprung a 66-1 shock on her seasonal return at Hamilton (6f, good) in May; two heavy defeats have followed and others are safer.

Off the mark at the fourth attempt (blinkered first time) when making all in a 6f fillies' novice at Yarmouth (soft) in May; only midfield on her handicap debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago and she needs to leave that behind; well bred and in excellent hands so that's not out of the question.
Of interest on her 2yo best but neither handicap run has been convincing; she should be sharper with her recent reappearance behind her but not the most solid of options.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: Solid in-frame efforts on her last four starts; a stiff 7f should be fine for her now but drying ground perhaps not ideal.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: Back to his best when finishing second of nine in a 7f handicap at Musselburgh 17 days ago; runs off the same mark today and another big run should be forthcoming.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: Won a 7f Dundalk maiden on his second start but beaten 14 times since; went close at Musselburgh (7f, good) last month though and a subsequent lesser effort can be partially excused by him getting upset in the stalls.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
OwnerName: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr
Spotlight: Both wins have come over 6f on AW; two good runs at Carlisle this summer, second in May and third on Saturday, but they were over 6f and his stamina for this trip is the obvious concern.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: Hold-up performer who is thrown in on his 2025 form; yet to get going this time around, typically blowing the start, but it wouldn't be a bolt from the blue were he to bounce back in this company.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: 12-race maiden; last of eight at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) 13 days ago when cheekpieces (now absent) were tried; others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: 6f AW win last summer; began this campaign with good handicap runs at Haydock (6f, good to firm) and over C&D (soft); two lesser efforts have followed but he will be dangerous if back to the C&D form.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: His first four starts came over 7f but he showed improvement dropped to 6f when a close third at Thirsk last month; a slow start did him no favours dropped to 5f at Newcastle a fortnight ago; now returns to 7f with cheekpieces fitted; stable also runs Homestrait.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: Showed some ability in three starts on the AW during the winter but he was a well-beaten 66-1 shot on his handicap debut at Newbury (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago; this is weaker but he still has a point to prove.

RaceName: Dalston 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; sixth in two 7f fillies' handicaps for new yard, the latest at Doncaster last week; improvement required to defy this mark.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sea The Stars colt who cost 700,000euros as a yearling; first foal out of a French 1m 2yo Listed winner (RPR 100); he does look the stable second string on jockey bookings.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 200,000gns yearling and a No Nay Never brother to two winners; up with the pace throughout and hung around for a close third over slightly shorter at Newbury (good to soft; 11-1); that was a likeable start.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: At 6-1 he was a shorter price than Amir Lehbab when they clashed at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) and this £60,000 yearling wasn't beaten far into fifth after a troubled run; improvement would appear a formality.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 85,000euros foal; 17-2 at Goodwood (6f, soft) where he was strongest at the finish to be close up in third; raised in trip on drier ground, he's open to significant improvement.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Frankel colt who cost 2,200,000gns at last year's Tattersalls October Book 1 sale; half-brother to winners Ottoman Fleet (8.5f-1m2f; Grade 2; RPR 121), Inverlochy (1m/8.6f; 86) and Ottoman Empress (1m 2yo; 83); dam French 1m1f/9.7f winner; runs here in preference to a strong Newmarket maiden on Saturday; hood fitted.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 550,000gns yearling and brother to 1m3f/1m4f winner Thunder Kiss (Group 3; RPR 113); dam Listed-placed 1m4f-2m AW winner (100); holds a Group 1 entry in Ireland and has to be of strong interest.

RaceName: Betfred Champagne Trial EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Never got involved when eighth of 13 over C&D last month (good to firm) and this is probably a stronger race.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: No wins in four but he's useful and beat all bar subsequent Queen's Vase fourth Point Of Law over 1m2f at Newbury in mid-May; led that day and should put up another bold show.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Beaten in small fields this season, latterly at odds-on behind a well-bred filly who has since finished third off a BHA mark of 82; he'll need more to win this but he's seemingly held in some regard and has been gelded.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; made a promising debut over this trip at Leopardstown and then won at the Curragh (first-time tongue-tie) when perhaps inconvenienced by the drop back to 1m2f; can pick holes in that form but he's a promising colt who looks a stayer in the making.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Runner-up in both his races and beaten only a neck in the latest (1m4f, good), but appears to have the weakest form claims of those with experience.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Given every chance when going down narrowly in a 1m4f Newmarket handicap 20 days ago; that form entitles him to a second look here (in new cheekpieces) but he is 0-6 and others should have greater potential.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: Had the run of things up front when flooring an ex-Irish 1-3 chance at Redcar (1m2f, good) but he posted a useful RPR for a newcomer; hard to dismiss.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: 52,000gns yearling by Wootton Bassett; first foal out of a 1m-1m4f maiden (RPR 73), sister to 1m Listed winner Sir John Lavery; stable's newcomers are usually best watched.

RaceName: Betfred St Leger Trial Novice Stakes (Winner Gets Free Initial Entry To St Leger) (GBB/GBBPlus)
Spotlight: By Wootton Bassett and out of a sister to Oaks winner Was, he fetched 4,300,000gns in 2024; he can be forgiven his no-show in last month's soft-ground Derby and his previous second at Haydock (first-time cheekpieces retained since) was behind a stablemate who went on to finish close up in the Queen's Vase; respected.

RaceName: Betfred Supports Jack Berry House Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win was in 2024 and hasn't been at her best in four races for current yard; she was never that threatening when third of six last time (1m4f); steps up in trip.

RaceName: Betfred Supports Jack Berry House Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed 8yo but he was returning from 264 days off when winning by 3.5l at Ffos Las nine days ago (2m, good), despite pulling hard; Zoe Lewis rides again with a 4lb penalty; if as good again he'll be tough to beat.

RaceName: Betfred Supports Jack Berry House Handicap
Spotlight: Seven defeats include four handicaps, the best of which was a close third on good to soft at Yarmouth last September (1m); didn't convince stamina-wise over 1m2f last time and now has a good deal further to travel.

RaceName: Betfred Supports Jack Berry House Handicap
Spotlight: Still a maiden and latest close third at Catterick (2m, good to firm) came in a field of four, so that form looks a tad dubious.
Consistent since raised to this sort of trip in handicaps and was nicely on top late on at Redcar (good) the last time; still looks well handicapped off 4lb higher.

First time over this far and his first handicap when winning by a neck at Newbury (1m2f, good; 2lb lower); finished last at Sandown where he hung left-handed throughout; better expected returned to a left-handed track.

0-4 for Clive Cox but 2-3 for this yard after narrow wins at Ripon (1m, good to soft) and over C&D (good to firm); came from off the pace a month ago to collect by a half-length off 5lb lower; well bred, he might well have more to offer.

Successful handicap debut at Musselburgh in April when making all off 4lb lower; below that level since, including when able to lead at Lingfield last time (1m1f, good to firm) on the back of a gelding operation.
Won twice last year on good ground, latterly over 1m2f; close to best form when second at Hamilton in June but has disappointed either side of that.

TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: Initially promising but hasn't kicked on in handicaps (0-3; 7f-1m) and blinkers are removed after last time; bit to prove, though getting back on fast ground is a likely plus.
Good and bad in five runs for this yard, but wasn't beaten far the last time at Newcastle (1m) and on the evidence of that run this far is worth exploring.
His standout run is the middle one when beaten a neck at Kempton (1m AW); possibilities on handicap debut if tapping into that promise on the back of wind surgery; market informative.
Did a bit of hanging but was only 2.5l away on handicap debut at Wetherby (1m, good to firm); might be learning on the job and progress further.

First run for this yard when third in a Class 5 at Newmarket (1m) and then comfortably justified odds of 8-11 in a Class 6 at Brighton (7f, good to firm); 5lb higher here even with a 6lb penalty and probably the one to beat.
Second at Thirsk before nosing home at Redcar (1m, good; 3lb lower) and not the first time she's been below par at Ripon a month ago; could easily bounce back from that.
0-11 but was in first-time blinkers when second at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) and he might well have won had he not blown the start; considered.
Having her 39th race and still seeking first win away from Beverley; has run some fair races this season but not last time and others appeal more.

TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: Lightly raced and beaten in the region of 3l in his two handicaps, over 7f on the AW and good ground; down 4lb for those and best RPR came over 8.6f on debut; can run well.
Did well last season at about 1m but yet to get overly competitive in four handicaps, from 1m2f to 1m4f; perhaps this drop in trip can halt the slide.

6f maiden winner on the AW; wore a tongue-tie on handicap debut but that was soon discarded and he ran well behind one completing a hat-trick at Nottingham; tries 7f for the first time and that could trigger something.
Formerly with William Haggas and Willie Mullins; consistent for this yard and deserved his battling win over C&D latest; can run well again off just 3lb higher.
Keen-goer who has been hooded for his last two races; up with the pace and ridden out to win on handicap debut at Musselburgh (7f, good); just 3lb higher and by no means exposed.

OwnerName: G Libson And Mrs P Sly
Spotlight: Only contested seven handicaps and won four; would have gone close in Alpha Capture's race here last time had he broken on terms; chance.
All four wins at Newcastle but nothing wrong with latest second at Chester, especially as he missed the break; good chance off 1lb higher.
Had a good season already and Toby Moore's claim is welcomed when he might be a shade high in the weights now; beaten 2l at Chester last time, just behind King's School whom he beat the time before.
Won over C&D in March of 2025 off 11lb higher; 0-12 in the meantime and quiet so far this term.
Won two 7f novices last year; no better than seventh in three handicaps and needs to step up.
Newbury novice winner over 6f and ran in a Listed race on final run last season; a disappointing return on handicap debut leaves her with questions to answer; unraced beyond 6f.
Second course win when beating 11 rivals here last month, but only fifth on her return visit; back down 1lb.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd
Spotlight: All four wins were over 6f for two Newmarket yards; 0-11 for current one and others are in better form.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Veteran who has returned from a break in fine form and won by a length over this far at Wetherby (good to firm); back up 4lb but had dropped to a good mark.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Having his 50th career start and reliable in the main; close up last week at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) after racing up with the pace; each-way chance.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs S Hibbert, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Both turf wins have been over 6f at York, the latest last summer off 1lb lower; found some trouble in running when third at Pontefract last time and has another big effort in him.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Only fifth in a field of six last week at Nottingham, but was close up behind Spirit Of Applause and that represented some return to form.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Two AW wins for Scott Dixon this winter and he is just 1lb higher than for March's 5f success; finished last at Lingfield in April but that was a stiffer task than this.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win in ten races came on final run of last season in a 5f novice; beaten four times since a gelding operation, no closer than about 4l; cheekpieces replace the visor tried last time.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Lost her first ten races but the win had been coming and she stormed clear at Catterick (5f, good to soft; fine on faster); now in a higher grade on the back of a 9lb rise but something appears to have clicked.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Best run was his second in a novice last season but only three ran; opposable on his handicap form and blinkers did nothing last time.

RaceName: Betfred Follow Us On X Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who looks better for being gelded, last time gaining a hard-fought one-length win at Ffos Las (6f, good); penalised accordingly but Brodie Hampson is a big asset in these races.

Unexposed 3yo who appeared to take a big step forward when 66-1 second of four behind 1-3 favourite in Newmarket novice (1m2f, good) three weeks ago; it's tricky to weigh up what that form is worth, though, and he probably needs to improve again on this handicap debut.

Six-race maiden; faded into sixth of nine on seasonal debut at Lingfield (1m2f, good) three weeks ago but significant positives can be drawn from that outing and he might come on for the run; tries a new trip.

Stumbled soon after the start and did not get competitive when upped to 11.4f for handicap debut at Windsor (good to firm) in May but was made favourite for that race and probably still has potential.

A maiden after nine starts but close second three consecutive times (1m2f-11.5f) since upped to middle-distance trips in April; proven on fast ground and seems very likely to be in the shake-up again.

Left inauspicious seasonal/handicap debut (1m2f) behind when very close second (subsequently awarded race) at Goodwood (1m4f, good) last month, reportedly benefiting from combination of step up in trip and first-time hood; could easily have more improvement to come.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Well held when third of six at 1-3 odds at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) last month but made promising debut when placed behind the subsequent close Chesham third at Newbury (6f, good to firm) a fortnight earlier and is back on fast ground here; must be considered.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Armor; well down the field when 80-1 for debut at Ascot (5f, good) two months ago; considered only if much stronger in the betting.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 6f AW winner Tantomile (RPR 55); dam 7f-1m3f winner (84), half-sister to winners Afta Party (1m Flat/hurdle) and Line House (7f including 2yo); market may guide.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of an unraced half-sister to a Listed winner; slowly away but kept on from the rear for promising sixth of 13 in quite valuable Doncaster maiden (7f, good to firm) last month; should improve; likely contender.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when respectable fifth of nine at Kempton (7f, AW) last month; needs further progress on this turf return but still considered each-way.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of Irish 1,000 Guineas/Yorkshire Oaks winner Pleascach; looked in need of the experience and was never dangerous on last month's debut at Pontefract (6f, good) but made encouraging late headway and could be a different proposition over this longer trip and with that run in the bank.

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: With a good stable but was towards rear throughout and finished behind Minnal on recent debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm).

RaceName: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; third foal; half-sister to a Norwegian 7f 2yo winner; dam lightly raced half-sister to winners Nyaleti (1m Group 2), Sir Patrick Moore (Australian 6f Group 2) and Alsakib (1m6f Group 3); stable has only occasional first-time-out 2yo winners.

Didn't fire on Tapeta three weeks ago but began this campaign with three respectable runs and is now only 3lb higher than when winning easily by nearly 5l over C&D (good) last summer; dangerous to ignore.

Close third on stable debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) in May and didn't run badly when close eighth of ten (just behind Potomac River) in stronger race than this at Newmarket (7f, good) three weeks ago; no surprise if he features.

OwnerName: Tim Cottier, Clark, Spence And Fellowes
Spotlight: Has modest 1-17 strike-rate but he's pretty consistent and his win was gained over C&D on good to firm ground (just under a year ago); finished well for second at Leicester (6f, good) last month and this step back up in trip is an obvious move; high on the list.

Began year in good form on AW, losing out only by a head at Chelmsford (7f) on latest outing in February; still on a workable mark and should be fine back on turf; contender if tuned up after his break.

Won five times at Lingfield (7f-1m) during the last AW season and was still in good form there when last seen in April; has 0-12 strike-rate on turf, though, and others in this line-up look better handicapped.

Five-race maiden; struggled on soft ground on seasonal/handicap debut but shaped with significant promise before fading into seventh at Newmarket (7f, good) three weeks ago and will appreciate this ease in grade.
Has a C&D win (in 2021) on his CV but ended last year in poor form and made a low-key reappearance last month; needs to turn a corner.

Not the force of old but won off 2lb higher at Catterick (6f, good) in April and beat his group when fifth overall in 14-runner Ayr handicap (6f, soft) last month; also suited by fast ground; can make his presence felt.

OwnerName: B D Haynes, G L Moore, Alan Jamieson
Spotlight: Back in prime form at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month, coming from the rear to win cosily under a confident ride; quickly back up to career-high mark but still commands respect.

Has a point to prove after running poorly in recent Newbury race won by Rage Of Thunder but was in good form beforehand, most notably when winning at Windsor (6f, good to firm); contender if quickly back on song.

OwnerName: Peter Crate And Gallagher Bloodstock Ltd
Spotlight: Scored at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) in May and probably bettered that performance when very close second at Brighton (5.2f, good to firm) last month; recent Windsor run is best overlooked (saddle slipped); slightly out of the weights but the return to 6f won't be a problem; probably won't be far away.

OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who went close when dropped back to 6f at Windsor (6f, good to soft) last month and also ran well when fourth at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) on Saturday; might be better by a stiffer 6f than this but could have a say if aided by refitted cheekpieces.
Exploited reduced mark with clearcut win at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; evidently in good nick but went back up 6lb for that and this return to turf may not be ideal.
0-6 on AW for new stable since the autumn but took good step back in right direction when close fourth at Lingfield (5f) last month and will be suited by this return to 6f on turf; interesting.

Lightly raced 3yo who was evidently well suited by the step up in trip when winning readily at Bath (1m, good) last month; found one too good when odds-on to follow up there (firm) last week but was clear of the others and remains of strong interest; swaps blinkers for first-time visor.

Three good runs this season, the latest a second at Chepstow (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; competes off same mark and will be a tough nut to crack if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.

Returned to form with second in amateur riders' race at Brighton (1m, good to firm) last month and is still on a good mark but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon, and his habit of starting slowly is another worry.

Came good in first-time blinkers at Bath (1m, firm) in April, after a break, but managed only third in a small field there (1m2f) in May and was soundly beaten on his latest outing; needs to kick on again.

OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Consistent 4yo who won over C&D (good) last summer and came from off the pace to double his tally at Brighton (1m, good) last month; probably doesn't have much margin for error off new mark but ought to be on the premises.

Looked as good as ever when winning at Lingfield (1m, AW) on seasonal debut in April and again ran well over that C&D last month; didn't fire when back on turf recently (restless in stalls) but has form at this track and enters calculations.

Gained this season's win at Lingfield (7f, good), where she was allowed to dominate against the favoured nearside rail; also suited but this C&D but ran poorly on Polytrack ten days ago and would appeal more on slower ground.

0-5 on AW; got going too late when never-dangerous fourth from the rear at Lingfield (7f; first-time cheekpieces) last month but that was her first run since January and this longer trip might suit better on her turf debut; blinkers and a tongue-tie are tried this time.

Progressive for new stable this season and bids to complete a hat-trick after 1m wins at Bath (good) and Lingfield (AW); his tendency to race too freely remains a nagging concern but he could plausibly have more improvement to come over this new trip; obvious contender.
Scored at Bath (1m, firm) on seasonal debut in April and comes here after chasing home next-time-out winners on consecutive outings last month (1m1f/1m); major player if suited by this new trip.

Struggled in soft-ground maiden last month (7.6f) but displayed some promise when midfield on both AW starts in May (1m/7f), and his pedigree suggests he'll be suited by the new trip on this handicap debut.

Not beaten that far in three AW novice/maiden races (7f-1m) towards end of last year and remains unexposed but this handicap/turf debut comes after a 190-day absence; has showed a tendency to race too freely; hood removed after one use.
Showed no significant promise when a big-priced outsider for three novice races this spring (7.6f-1m2f); makes handicap debut from a basement mark but significant improvement is required.
Finished last on both 2yo starts but her big-odds fourth of seven at Goodwood (1m, good to soft) last month was much more encouraging and further progress is possible in handicaps.

TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: Unable to land a telling blow in three novice/maiden races this spring (1m-8.6f) but has more realistic chance to get competitive in this run-of-the-mill handicap; market may guide.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; sister to the trainer's Group 3-winning filly Red Letter (Group 1-placed in the Pretty Polly recently) and yard's maiden winner Res Ipsa; dam Listed-placed 6f AW 2yo winner; capable of making her presence felt first time out.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Mrs E Irwin & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-sister to eight winners, including Australian Group winner Adjusted, Old Glory (Group-placed as a juvenile) and Giuseppe Piazzi (Scandinavian Group 3s; 98); dam French 1m1f winner; merits respect.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: No Nay Never half-sister to Group 1 juvenile winner Puerto Rico; dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (102), sister to Group 1 winners Misty For Me and Ballydoyle; weak second favourite, looked raw on Cork debut in April (5f, soft); failed to show the progress that might have been expected at Navan (5f, yielding); up in trip now, premature to write off.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: E120,000 yearling; finished fourth in a 6f Naas barrier trial; can improve from a satisfactory fourth on her official debut at Cork,  form advertised by a Group 3 success for the winner Ballinea Star.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; by Dark Angel, dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Tarana (Listed and dam of 1m2f/1m4f Group 1 winner Tarnawa), Tarankali, and Tasalk; out of a 1m4f Listed winner; best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to winners Sheyya and Shelbiana; dam 7f winner, half-sister to smart 7f/1m winner Shelir; stable in form, same colours as Katiriya.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly, 115,000gns yearling; raced keenly and betrayed inexperience on Navan debut in late April; now looks the part on the strength of C&D third at the beginning of last month; form has been franked by the Aidan O'Brien-trained runner-up Alpha in winning easily at the Curragh

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: First foal; dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner, Oasis Dream half-sister to two winners, out of 1m4f winning half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Katiyra and 1m4f Group 3 winner Kataniya; good pedigree, sire may supply pace, stamina on dam's side.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: St Mark's Basilica filly; substantial improvement needed from her C&D debut five weeks ago, when slowly away and unable to land a blow; unlikely to reverse form with Margot Mae.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Towards the rear on debut at Cork; well held by fourth-placed Carafinn.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister by Sioux Nation to three winners, best of them Keeper Of Time, a Group 3 C&D scorer; dam Italian Listed-placed winner; in good hands.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Not from a usual source of juvenile winners; Soldier's Call filly is the second foal out of a winning daughter of Dandy Man.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Arizona filly; E5,000 yearling; half-sister to five winners; dam 7f AW winner; yard not known for juvenile maiden winners; 7lb claimer aboard.

Best two efforts in four maiden runs came over 7f at Dundalk last winter; not a bad run on handicap bow and seasonal return at Limerick (7f, soft) behind Zenford and Venetian Star; same mark here and Keane takes over now; ran well on good ground at the Curragh last term; interesting.
Gained a second career win when beating Zenford by a short head at the Curragh (7f, good) on penultimate; soundly beaten off 5lb higher mark back there on latest; may be on a tough mark for now.

Placed in a couple of maidens last season at 6f-1m on good ground; soundly beaten on seasonal return/handicap debut at Down Royal in May (10.5f, good) but improved effort dropped back to 1m at the Curragh last time; eased 1lb for that 4l defeat and this shorter trip should be fine; not dismissed.

Rewarded for a string of consistent efforts with a win at Limerick on latest (7f, soft) off 5lb lower; closely matched with Invincible Will on Curragh running in May; looks progressive and should go well again but majority of form on easier ground than this.

Sprang a 33-1 surprise in a C&D maiden (good) last July; last of six in Tipperary listed race the following month; weakened on soft ground upped to 1m on handicap debut here when last seen in October; gelded, 4lb lower now and worth a market check on return.

Promise in all three maidens earlier this season at 7f-1m on good and yielding ground; had Zenford 0.75l behind when runner up at Limerick (7f, yielding) in April off level weights and 7lb better off here; opening mark may be lenient and could go well in first handicap.

Won a 6f maiden at Naas (good) on third start last season; came up short in listed company on next two starts and disappointed on handicap debut at Naas on latest (6f, good); moves up in trip; new visor needs to revive.

Won a 7f maiden (yielding) on debut at the Galway festival last season; only seen twice since, well beaten in listed race over this C&D (gd-yld) in September and again in fillies' race at Killarney on latest; best watched on handicap bow with a return trip to Ballybrit likely on the horizon.

Off the mark on second handicap start at Fairyhouse (7f, good) eight days ago under Colin Keane; raised 5lb for that and moves up in grade but relatively unexposed so could be more to come and another top rider booked; not discounted.

Ten-race maiden was denied by 0.5l by Zenford at Limerick last time out (7f, soft) and just 2lb higher now; went close on good ground at Fairyhouse in May; in the mix again but needs to find a bit more to get his head in front.

RaceName: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Decent overall form since fourth in this race 12 months ago; gained first win at stakes level when taking a Listed fillies' event at Navan last month; seemed to appreciate the step up to 1m that day, but was found wanting in a deeper race at the Curragh on Irish Derby weekend.

RaceName: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: C&D winner on second of three starts at two; fine effort when fifth in the 30-runner Goffs Million; relatively unexposed and could be good enough to cope with her five older rivals.

RaceName: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won a 2yo maiden on debut for Jessica Harrington; ran some good races in defeat last year; joined Johnny Murtagh this term; stable in great form, but this 83-rated filly is not well treated by the race conditions.

RaceName: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: C&D Listed winner at two; third in this race 12 months ago, in front of Duckadilly who is a much better mare now; could feature if stepping up from her first run of the season at Naas in May; first time with blinkers.

RaceName: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Maiden winner over 7f at Cork last season and took third of eight in a C&D Group 3  good) next time; C&D handicap winner five weeks ago on second outing of the campaign; currently rated 3lb inferior to stablemate Fingerpaint.

RaceName: Xin Gin Irish EBF Brownstown Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden on debut last year and was a fine third in a Tipperary Group 3 next time after a 100-day break; didn't seem to handle heavy ground on final start last year; again below her best on return at Navan; will held by Duckadilly on that running.
Maiden whose best effort in handicaps came over 1m4f at the Curragh last season; this may not be enough of a stamina test.

Two C&D wins last season on good and heavy ground; yet to hit top gear this term but has slipped 4lb below his last success and hinted that he might be coming back to form at Ballinrobe on latest; not discounted.

3-17 on turf; low key start to this campaign but back on song on latest when a neck second over C&D behind Heliogabalus; hit with a 6lb rise for that fine effort and has never won off a mark this high but place claims nonetheless.

OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: 0-5; promise in maidens but hasn't made an impact in first two handicaps, here last October (1m, yld-sft) and at the Curragh when last seen in April (1m, sft); cheekpieces reached for and a bit to prove for now.

Signed off last season with back-to-back 7f AW wins for Ger Lyons; yet to hit form in two runs for this stable and remains a maiden on turf (0-11) but acts on good ground so may improve on his below par effort on soft at Down Royal last time.

Gained second win of career over C&D (good) on seasonal return last month, beating Zaraahmando by a neck; 8lb rise makes things tougher but Keane booked and he's well drawn so can't be totally discounted.

Won in fine style at Gowran (1m, gd-yld) in May but paid a price for that 4l success, going up 10lb; soundly beaten off revised rating back at Gowran (9.5f, yielding); eased 1lb and the return to 1m is a plus but needs a career best off this mark.

Four-time winner (three on turf) including twice here last season over 7f on good and soft ground; is now just 1lb above the latest of those victories and 1m fine but needs to leave this term's poor form behind.

Two-time AW winner is 0-13 on turf but has gone close in defeat; some of best efforts have come at Galway so likely to be heading to Ballybrit; however, not beaten far at Down Royal last time (7f, soft) and 1lb lower now so place shout, though could be drawn better.

OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Two-time AW winner; yet to score on turf but has run well in defeat, his best effort coming in a Killarney maiden last July (1m, yld-sft); okay run at Dundalk latest but might prefer a bit of an ease on return to the grass.
French winner has failed to fire since joining this stable; handicapper giving him a real chance now but weakened quickly at Ballinrobe last time and others arrive in better form.

Best run for this yard came at this venue last season (1m1f, soft); not as good in three subsequent outings and pulled up when last seen at Clonmel in September (blood at both nostrils); best watched on return.
Godolphin cast off has failed to fire in five runs for this yard; beaten 44l in first-time blinkers (discarded) at Naas on latest; hard to fancy on recent showings.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
OwnerName: Team Valor International LLC & Gary Barber
Spotlight: 3yo; Curragh maiden winner (7f, good) last term ran a fine race behind Tim Toe on his seasonal return at Listowel (1m, good) and that rival ran a cracker off 91 in the Ascot Stakes on his next start; this longer trip should suit and he's interesting on handicap debut.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Off the mark on turf at this venue when last sighted in April (1m2f, yld-sft); 5lb higher now and best turf runs have come on easier ground than this so could probably do with some rain.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Consistent 3yo; AW winner is 0-3 on turf but has yet to finish out of the first three; excellent effort in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, gd-fm) on latest, keeping on for a 1.5l third; just 3lb higher now and should stay this extra furlong; leading claims.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Won off 5lb lower at the Curragh last season (1m2f, yielding); not a bad run over that C&D on seasonal return but struggled upped to 1m4f there on latest; eased 1lb, cheekpieces go on and this shorter trip more suitable so not dismissed.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Shed the maiden tag at the fourth attempt in a Ballinrobe maiden 17 days ago (9.5f, yielding); previously beaten 9.25l on handicap debut over this C&D (soft) and is now 6lb higher; might prefer a bit of an ease in the ground.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Not the easiest to win with, as record of 1-24 on turf illustrates; however, is now 2lb below that sole success and not beaten far in fillies' handicaps over C&D on penultimate or at Limerick on latest; place chance.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Three-time winner including this race last season off 3lb higher; below best in two runs this term, including in race he won last year at the Curragh on his latest start; capable off this mark but needs to rediscover best.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Seven-time winner including Listed and Group 3 races here over 1m on good ground; not a bad effort in first handicap start since 2023 at the Curragh last time (denied a clear run) and eased 1lb for that; goes well here and firmly enters calculations upped in trip.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
OwnerName: Mark E Phelan & Paul W Phelan
Spotlight: AW and two-time turf winner whose last success came over C&D (good) last August off 9lb lower; may have needed latest run over 1m4f here after 105 days off so may take a step forward now dropped back in trip with that run under his belt.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: 3yo; off the mark in emphatic fashion at Down Royal (10.5f, good) in May; hiked up 15lb and came up short back there latest, although 1m5f on soft ground may not have been to his liking; drops back in trip on more suitable ground now and rider claims valuable 5lb; could bounce back.

RaceName: Double First Stables Irish EBF Nasrullah Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Sole success came in a C&D maiden on heavy last October; beaten a nose off 4lb lower over 7f here (soft) early last month; shifted right under pressure but kept on well for a 4.25l third of 13 in premier handicap at the Curragh last time (1m, good); this longer trip fine and should go well again.

Followed a poor effort at Cork with a 33-1 win at Killarney (1m, good) in May, holding on by a short head after making all; backed that up with a C&D third; no match for Yquem over C&D three weeks ago; could struggle to turn the tables on the in-foal winner.
Winner of two of his five starts since April; possibly unsuited by the 1m4f trip at Fairyhouse on latest; this trip is probably closer to his optimum.

Promise in a couple of AW runs for John O'Donoghue; weaker form in five runs on turf for that yard; stepped up from stable debut when beating Nibras Rainbow over C&D three weeks ago, justifying market confidence; reportedly in foal to Phoenix Of Spain; may continue to prosper.

Second in a 21-runner C&D contest last August when trained by Dermot Weld; ran his best race so far for this stable when third over C&D last month; fair chance if bouncing back from a below-par run at Roscommon last week.
1-41 on turf; struggled on the AW throughout winter but showed more when fifth at Roscommon in May; failed to repeat that effort at Gowran; four years since she recorded a 1m victory at this track.
Achieved his best placing when fourth at Down Royal last time; beaten 15l, so needs to improve.

Six wins to his name but on a losing run that stretches back to September 2022; not beaten far in two of four visits to Gowran in recent months; Limerick third offered renewed hope, confirmed by a C&D second that gives him a slight edge over William F Browne and Max Meridius.
Best handicap display so far when third over 7f at Down Royal in May; needs to find more

Ended last season with a respectable fifth on handicap debut in a 25-runner 1m2f Curragh race on heavy ground; fit from hurdling before beginning new Flat campaign with an encouraging fith at this venue, not far off Half Nutz then; first-time cheeekpieces.
21-race maiden, placed ten times, including five in a good spell between July and October last season; reported coughing at Down Royal on seasonal/stable debut; can do better.
Placed in a bumper at Perth in 2024; never in the first four in 13 Flat starts, fair sixth of 12 at Fairyhouse on latest, not far behind La Campanella and Famous Enough.

Maiden after 14 starts; one of his better runs last year when second over 7f at this venue; heavily supported in the betting when sixth of 14 at Roscommon (7f, yielding) on yard debut last month; this trip and ground may suit better.

Won Cork handicap (7f, soft) last September; failed to sustain that progress on her last three starts in 2025; improved from her seasonal debut when fifth at Gowran; not one of the more obvious contenders after unplaced Cork run.
Huge price for all four runs in maidens, some merit in her showing over 7f here on latest; hefty burden for handicap debut.
Won a handicap at Tipperary last summer; has failed to make an impact in four outings this season, needs to show signs of revival.
Has failed to distinguish herself in three starts since beating Nibras Rainbow at Bellewstown last August; towards the rear over 1m at this venue last month.

Showed next to nothing in maidens; in rear on handicap debut at Dundalk; vastly improved when fourth of 13 at 66-1 over 1m at Limerick last month; dam Crossing was a useful performer for this stable; may be on the upgrade.
Poor form as a juvenile, ran only twice last year; has returned to his original trainer; no apparent chance.
Showed promise at Fairyhouse on handicap debut, blotted his record with a poor Naas run; others have more convincing claims.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer Research Supported By Centra On July 24th (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner; 0-4 on the Flat and rated 74; well beaten on both previous runs over this C&D; looks to be up against it on these terms.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer Research Supported By Centra On July 24th (Q.R.) Race
Spotlight: Three-time point-to-point winner gained first success under Rules in a maiden hunter chase at Down Royal in May (2m7f, good); now makes Flat debut in what looks a tough race; probably best watched.

RaceName: Hurling For Cancer Research Supported By Centra On July 24th (Q.R.) Race
OwnerName: Mrs Sheila O'Ryan & John F Doyle & Grant Leon
Spotlight: Bumper, hurdles and Flat winner on good and soft ground; soundly beaten in one of these races at Bellewstown on latest; rated 78 and a fair bit to find on the figures here; cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Improved on her first two efforts when beaten a neck and a short head into third of ten over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago, but the winner did nothing for the form at Nottingham a week ago; cheekpieces given a go.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Nicely bred, but made little impression when sixth of ten on her Kempton debut (6f, AW; 12-1) in May; needs to step up.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Time Test; dam 1m winner (RPR 70), half-sister to winners Beshaayir (1m Group 2) and Kaeso (useful 6f-7.5f), out of 6f 2yo/1m Listed winner; market should indicate what is expected on debut.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Fourth of 11 on her Salisbury debut (6f, soft) last month, but has regressed in two starts since; may not come into her own until contesting nurseries.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Placed in all three starts, the latest when third of six at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in May (fourth has won since and fifth horse finished third in the Windsor Castle); tongue-tie now given a go; sets the standard.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Finished a tailed-off last of nine on her Wetherby debut (5,5f, good to firm) five weeks ago, but she had an excuse as she banged her head at the start; the market suggested better was expected so she's worth monitoring in the market again.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Bated Breath; half-sister to six winners including Chocoya (6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 102), Chiringuita (6f 2yo/US 7.5f; 93), Gressington (6f-7.4f including 2yo/AW; 91) and Nightsinwhitesatin (1m2f; 87); dam 7f 2yo/1m winner (91); stable doesn't have that many winning 2yo newcomers, but her pedigree makes her well worth monitoring in the market.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: February foal by Without Parole; half-sister to 5f AW winner Thecoffeepoddotco (RPR 78); dam 5.5f/7f winner (75), closely related to winners Dangerous Moonlite (5f 2yo) and Touch Paper (Greek 6f-1m); would be a rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Out of the frame in both starts, finishing just over 2l behind Global Success over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; sponsoring stable won a division of this last year, but that filly was a previous winner.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: March foal by Nando Parrado; 7,000euros yearling; closely related to 5f winner Messa Concertata (RPR 77), half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Nifty (including AW; 72); dam 1m1f winner (79), half-sister to 7f 2yo Listed winner Tigrilla, out of 1m4f winner; doesn't jump out on pedigree, but stable gets its share of winning 2yo newcomers and this doesn't look a strong race.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: 12-1 when beaten half a length into fourth of ten on her debut over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; the first three had already shown ability (including a previous winner) so she should be hard to beat if stepping up at all from that.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: 11-1 when fifth of nine on her Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW) last month, finishing a length behind Laylaty; improvement possible, but it will be needed.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Gradually got the hang of things when fourth of nine on her Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW; 22-1) last month (winner has followed up impressively since); dam's side of pedigree is all about stamina, but still a player in this field granted normal improvement.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: 14-1 when last of nine on last month's Sandown debut (5f, good); will need to step up a fair amount in order to figure.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
OwnerName: Gerard A Normand, Anna & Moa Sundstrom
Spotlight: Out of the frame in three starts, though her latest sixth of ten at Nottiingham (5f, good) caught the attention of the stewards; still looks more one for nurseries, though.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Comfortably held in her first two starts, the latest over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; nurseries may be more suitable after this.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: 9-1 when last of nine on her Bath debut (5.7f, firm) in May; hood worn then now dispensed with, but major improvement is required.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: April foal by Kameko; half-sister to six winners including Thammin (5f/6f including 2yo/AW/UAE dirt Listed; RPR 106), Ajax Tavern (6f/7f AW; 102) and A Taste Of Honey (7f AW including 2yo; 94); dam 5f-7f winner (including AW/Greece; 69); stable's 2yo newcomers often better for a run, but her pedigree makes her worth monitoring in the market.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: April foal by Caturra; half-sister to winners Ibn Aldar (6f/7f AW including 2yo; RPR 80) and Lieutenant Sir (6f; 59); dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (78), half-sister to Italian 1m Listed winner Key Master, out of 5f 2yo winner; worth a market check given the stable sponsors the race, but the yard has few winning 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: Win Races With Jonathan Portman EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (C/D) (Qual') (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Finished a very long way behind Sugar Yes Please when last of ten on her debut over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; needs to be a completely different proposition today.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Nicely bred, but failed to beat a rival on his Newmarket debut (6f, good; 16-1) in May; will need a transformation.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Took a long time to realise what was required on last month's Windsor debut (5f, good to firm), having blown the start and run green, but he stayed on in taking style, only just failing to grab third; should be wiser this time and the extra furlong shouldn't be a problem; much respected.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 28-1 when sixth of 11 on his Salisbury debut (6f, soft) last month; will need to improve to take this.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: February foal by Cotai Glory; 20,000euros yearling; 26,000gns breeze-up 2yo; brother to 5f-1m winner Chimgan (including 2yo/Bahrain; RPR 102), half-brother to 1m 2yo winner The Road Is Long (73); dam placed 5.7f turf/7f AW (74), sister to winners Lynn Britt Cabin (7f) and La La Land (8.6f 2yo); stable not noted for winning 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: April foal by Ardad; 13,000gns yearling, £23,000 2yo; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Walk Of Stars (UAE 9.5f Group 1) and Moon Shimmer (French 1m5f), out of Listed-placed 7f-1m4f winning half-sister to UAE 2m Group 3 winner Whispering Gallery; stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers, though did have one go in at 33-1 at Wolverhampton last month.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: March foal by Sergei Prokofiev; 3,000gns yearling; first foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Navajo Chief (1m Listed) and Imphal (1m5f-2m Flat and 3m-3m2f hurdle), out of unraced half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Mus-If; only of interest if attracting support.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off 4-1 and showed some ability when third of ten on last month's Wolverhampton debut (6f, AW); likely he will need a lot more in order to take this, though.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: January foal by Kodi Bear; 2,500gns yearling; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners First Folio (Listed-placed 6f), The Actor (5f 2yo) and Artistic Mission (German 6f-1m1f), out of 1m2f winner; stable does have winning 2yo newcomers and has been going well lately; would like to see market support before getting involved, though.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 8-1 when finishing a clear second of ten on his Windsor debut (5f, good) last month; the winner has since been well beaten in the Queen Mary, but the extra furlong ought to suit on breeding and he is high on the list.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: April foal by Calyx; 5,000gns breeze-up 2yo; dam 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 76), closely related to 1m2f Flat/2m hurdle winner Cleopatra's Needle, half-sister to useful winners Historic Find (1m 2yo) and Philosopher (7.5f-8.5f); stable has the occasional winning 2yo newcomer, but he's probably only of interest if attracting support.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: March foal by Lope Y Fernandez; half-brother to winners Dunkerron (6f 2yo; RPR 106), Outgun (1m4f AW; 80), Outperform (Japanese 6f including 2yo) and Parmenter (German 1m3f-12.5f); dam placed 7f-1m2f (71), half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Campo Catino; stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers, but his pedigree makes him worth a market check.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Nice pedigree, but made little impression when fifth of nine on last month's Chester debut (6f, good to soft; 14-1); may need more time.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: March foal by State Of Rest; 42,000euros yearling; half-brother to US 1m1f turf winner Centuria; dam French 1m4f winner, half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner Stunning Spirit, out of 1m4f winning sister to Fillies' Mile winner Rainbow View; stable looks to hold stronger claims with Desert Legend, but still worth a market check.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed good pace when third of 11 on his Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) ten days ago; any improvement on that will put him right in the mix; stable also runs the newcomer Old Oak.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: E Kelly, J Woods, N Gallagher & Partner
Spotlight: 25-1 when eighth of 11 on his Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) ten days ago, finishing over 4l behind Desert Legend; much more needed.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: January foal by Without Parole; 20,000gns yearling; half-brother to seven winners including King Cole (5f AW 2yo; RPR 86), Fifteenthamendment (1m2f; 81), Atomic Blonde (US 7.5f turf stakes) and Noble Miss (bumper); dam French 1m-10.5f winner (95); yard often gets them ready first time, but he's already gelded and stable looks to hold much stronger claims with Minster Boy.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: April foal by Persian Force; 20,000euros foal; 17,000euros yearling; £8,500 breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to four winners including Lorna Cole (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 77), Sergeant Mayer (5f/6f; 74) and Redshore City (6f; 71); dam 1m-2m4f maiden (57), sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Hatta Fort; already gelded and would be a surprise winner on debut.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big prices and well held in two starts over this trip at Wolverhampton (AW) and Salisbury (good to firm) last month; nurseries may be more suitable.

OwnerName: S Emmet And Miss R Emmet
Spotlight: 8yo whose losing run goes back 18 races to July 2024 but he's often run well in the meantime, including on his last two starts; each-way player.
Enjoyed good spell of form over 6f last summer and the drop back in trip may help, but he hasn't shaped this year as though a win is imminent.

Didn't run badly when 4l seventh of 13 at Windsor (5f, good to firm) ten days ago and she has another career-low mark this evening; however, she hasn't been threatening of late and others are preferred.

Bumped into smart prospect when 6l second at 150-1 in Kempton maiden (6f, AW) in May on third start for Jack Channon, but down the field in two handicaps since (6f, good/AW); may be best watched on stable debut; remains in same ownership.

3yo who returned to form when third in first-time blinkers at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month, a performance that can be marked up as he had a wide trip; also effective on turf and he's a major player if the blinkers maintain a positive effect.

3yo who has worked his way back into form this term and posted a good third at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) in May before winning there (6f, good to firm) last month from one who won next time out; also effective elsewhere; respected up 4lb.

He's on a reduced mark and his yard is going well; however, he had a patchy campaign last season and was soundly beaten in April on his sole run this year (pulled hard on that stable debut); others have less to prove.

Lightly raced 3yo who won two nurseries last year and is below his last winning mark; Windsor last month was a step back in the right direction but he needs another today if he's to be a serious force.

Hard to fancy on recent evidence whereas she arrived in good form prior to winning this last year (good to firm); however, she's dropped to a dangerous mark and can't be written off in her bid to make it 2-2 here.

Merely mid-division at Newmarket (6f, good) three weeks ago but prior to that he took a step back in the right direction when third on the Rowley Mile there (6f, good) and his stable is in fine form; not discounted.
Very well handicapped on last summer's exploits but he's been a long way below that level this year and a major turnaround is needed.

Inconsistent this season but he won three times last year and returned to form when third over C&D (good to firm) recently; another 1lb lower today and can be in the mix if backing up that latest performance.

RaceName: Pump Technology Engineered To Perform Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have come at Kempton (1m, AW), the latest a week ago; just 1lb wrong under his 5lb penalty and he remains unexposed, but fast ground is an unknown (best turf run on soft); stable also runs Distinct Spirit.

RaceName: Pump Technology Engineered To Perform Handicap
