Spotlight: Well bred and unexposed 4yo, who has gone on a winning run, successful on his last four starts, which includes two Listed events (one turf one AW) over half a furlong shorter; bit surprising he's been off for a couple of months but has won at this trip on soft ground and should be a player on first start in a Group race; stable won this race last year.

Comes into this in peak form having won a 1m2f Group 3 last time in San Siro on good ground; track no problem as he was third in this race 12 months ago (also sixth in 2024), but was a place behind Casapueblo last year, and again has to give 2lb to that rival (also behind the Godolphin gelding in March on the AW when giving even more weight away); always runs his race, though, and should be involved.

Reliable performer enjoying a good season with a tongue-tie added, winning his first two starts before narrowly beaten in a Longchamp Group 3 at this trip a month and a half ago; finished runner-up, ahead of Woodchuck, in the 2025 running of this when getting 2lb from that rival, so holds strong claims; Pierre-Charles Boudot rides for first time.

Finds it hard to win but nothing wrong with her latest third to the classy Aventure in a Longchamp Group 2 in May (1m2.5f, good to soft); need to back that up, though, and add more to it in order to record a first win since August 2023.

Often runs in good company but recorded an RPR of 73 two starts ago and 85 last time which, along with her overall profile (not passed the post in the first four since last August), suggests she has plenty on to be placed let alone win.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dubawi brother to 1m winner Blue Nazare (RPR 93); dam Listed-placed 6f winner (including 2yo; 96); the Charlie Appleby 2yos are in excellent form.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: This Ten Sovereigns colt cost 200,000gns at the breeze-ups and is a half-brother to winners UAE Prince (1m2f-1m4f; RPR 109) and Any Dream Will Do (1m; 86); in-form stable has a very healthy 2yo strike-rate this year, including a short-priced first-time-out winner in these silks at Nottingham last week; market confidence behind this one would look significant

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stepped up on his debut and shaped quite well when a closing third in a C&D novice (good to firm) a fortnight ago; looks capable of better again and the clear pick of those with experience.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 150,000euros yearling who is the first foal of a winning half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Shareta; gelded ahead of debut; the yard is going well in general but its 2yos have yet to really get going.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 16-1 when never better than midfield on his 7f Lingfield (AW) debut 17 days ago; needs to have come on a lot.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: American-bred colt who was green when quite a well-held fourth of ten on 7f Lingfield (AW) debut 17 days ago; more one for the longer term on that evidence.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: From a top stable but hasn't achieved near enough in his two starts (well-held fourth latterly) to think he can win a novice.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 550,000euros son of Sea The Stars out of a 1m4f AW winner (RPR 94); stable 10-38 with 2yos this season at the time of writing; his pedigree points to longer trips suiting in due course but he'd need considering if the betting signals are strong.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Always behind on both starts; big outsider.

RaceName: Doncaster Supports Autism In Racing EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Promise amidst inexperience in a useful Newbury maiden on debut and looked a useful prospect when easily taking a Ffos Las maiden (1m2f, good) under David Egan last month; surely more to come.

RaceName: Doncaster Supports Autism In Racing EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two AW starts last autumn, leaving his Kempton debut well behind when going down by only a neck at Southwell (1m); this is a slightly belated return but he should have more to offer for a leading stable going great guns; wears first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Doncaster Supports Autism In Racing EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: The Soldiers Of Fortune Iv & Partner
Spotlight: Fifth in two Flat maidens in Ireland (1m/1m4f) for Joseph O'Brien, showing fair form on the first occasion; no show in two recent hurdle starts since joining Olly Murphy and comes up against a couple of promising sorts back on the level.

RaceName: Doncaster Supports Autism In Racing EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Big prices and well held both starts.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Dark Angel colt who stepped up on turf debut when making all at Kempton (6f, AW) in May; freshened up since finishing a well held last of three in conditions race at Goodwood (6f, good to soft) later that month; blinkered first time now handicapping from a mark which isn't obviously generous.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Built on debut fourth when winning a 6f course novice (good to firm) 20 days ago; the form has been franked, including by the fourth making a winning nursery debut at Windsor on Monday; should be more to come.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Fourth to Inner City Blues (also next-time-out winners in second/third) on 6f York debut and built on that, despite failing to land short odds, when close second over 7f at Ayr 17 days ago (both good ground); cheekpieces are added now making a quick switch to handicaps from a mark which looks workable.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't lived up to market expectations on all three starts but has steadily advanced her RPRs; didn't really sustain her effort when second on 7f Kempton nursery debut three weeks ago so the slight drop back in trip may help.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held on first two starts but showed a bit more when third of five to a Godolphin odds-on shot over 7f at Yarmouth (good to firm) three weeks ago; the first-time hood worn on that occasion is left off now dropping back a little in distance for her nursery debut.
Gained a first win at the third attempt in 7f maiden at Southwell in April but has struggled in three handicaps since;

Three handicap wins this year, the latest at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in May; creditable efforts in defeat in a trio of handicaps over this minimum trip since; just as effective at 6f and enters calculations with the Ivan Furtado stable among the winners.

Hasn't matched his fairly useful debut RPR for the Quinn yard in two subsequent outings but he did make quite an encouraging return from a year off for his new stable when fourth in C&D novice (good) ten weeks ago; potential improver in handicaps.

Half-brother to a Group 3 winner; justified market support when overcoming inexperience to win a 6f maiden at Lingfield (AW) in January but well below that level in two subsequent turf outings, returning from a gelding operation to finish a remote third of six in Leicester novice (good to firm) in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) 19 days ago; needs to leave that well behind now moving into a handicap.

Struck at the second time of asking in handicaps when making all under Lewis Chalkley at Ripon (6f, good) 17 days ago; his three closest pursuers haven't done much for the form since but he was comfortably on top and his unexposed profile provides the hope for better again.

TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: 5f maiden winner at Goodwood (good to firm) last June; reached the frame for the third time in handicaps this year when fourth of eight at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but he'll need more to get his head back in front.

All races at 6f, taking a step forward for the switch to turf when well on top from two subsequent winners in 6f Windsor maiden (good to firm) in May; his opening handicap mark looks manageable, particularly as he has the potential for better again.

Raced at 7f, winning Kempton maiden (AW) in January on fourth start; has run well to make the frame in her three handicaps since, latterly third of ten to Accademia (won since) here (good to firm) three weeks ago; led until inside the final furlong on that occasion so the drop to 6f is worth exploring.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap
Spotlight: Has run a number of good in defeat races this season, including fourth over C&D last month; went down only to a progressive 3yo at Newbury (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago and the third and fourth have franked that form; bold show likely.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap
Spotlight: It took him 17 attempts to put his head in front but has now won two of his last three, finding plenty tackling 7f for the first time when seeing off a couple of strong challengers in handicap at Thirsk (good to firm) 22 days ago; respected up 3lb.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap
Spotlight: Went close over C&D (good to firm) last month and 1m seemed to stretch him back here since (all wins at 7f, including here); his last success came off this mark; likely to be on the premises under Rodriguez.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up twice in May (C&D on good to firm first occasion); caught too far back when fourth over 1m here last time; likely still in good form but needs things to drop right the way he's ridden.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho
Spotlight: Opened this year's account when making all in amateur riders' race at Carlisle (6f, good to soft) last month; creditable fourth over 6f here next time but below par back at Carlisle 19 days ago; former C&D winner but has yet to defy a mark this high.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Musselburgh (7f, good) off 10lb higher last year; has largely struggled since but latest Catterick fourth from well off the pace was a step back in the right direction and has obvious handicapping scope if able to build on that.

On a losing run but has reduced mark as a result and he was backed into joint favouritism at Pontefract last week only to blow the start; has a first-time tongue-tie added now; it'll be interesting to see whether his supporters are prepared to give him a second chance.

Lightly raced gelding who hasn't progressed from his 5f 2yo success, including in three outings between 7f and 1m for Ian Williams this year; this is a drop in grade but would need to see market support to consider.

Both wins off higher marks; has an inconsistent profile and hasn't built on April's Pontefract second in two subsequent outings but he might have just needed it at Brighton recently after three months off.

Latest Nottingham third in this headgear was a bit better and he'll be a threat to all if recapturing the form he showed when a close second over C&D (good to firm) off 2lb higher in April, particularly with Jack Callan taking an additional 3lb off.

Won a 7f handicap at Redcar (good to firm) last summer off 2lb lower and bounced back to that sort of form when third of ten to Farandaway (runs in previous race) over 7f at Thirsk (good to firm) three weeks ago; in a lower grade now and should have a big say with Ivan Furtado among the winners.

Only win in 26 runs was a 1m nursery at York in October 2023 for Ralph Beckett; badly out of form this season and cheekpieces made no difference last time; they are replaced by a first-time tongue-tie now.

Low-mileage 5yo who has form figures of 12531 since wearing cheekpieces, most recently seeing off nine rivals at Carlisle (7f) in June; has a likeable profile for this grade but the wins have been achieved on good to soft/soft and she needs to prove she's as effective on today's likely much faster ground.

OwnerName: MDP Racing And Mrs R Carr
Spotlight: Off the mark on first run over 1m at Leicester (good to firm) this month, despite not getting the best of runs; backed it up when running on from the rear for neck second over C&D (good to firm) last Saturday; out again before a 2lb rise for that kicks in.
Five-race maiden who showed his opening mark to be workable when 1l fourth over 1m2f at Windsor (good to firm) ten days ago, albeit it came in a steadily run race; first-time blinkers go on now.
Has failed to build on his 1m course handicap debut third in the spring in two subsequent outings, including stepped up to 1m2f at Ripon last time.

Struggled on her first two outings this year but back on track stepped up to 1m2f when third in 11-runner handicap at Newbury (good to firm) three weeks ago, staying on having had to switch to get a run; the first two from that race have run well since; considered from an unchanged mark.

Similar form in three qualifying runs over 7f/1m last autumn; gelded ahead of this handicap debut and reappearance over a trip which is bred to suit; would enter calculations if the betting vibes are strong.
Failed to better modest form in five outings as a juvenile, including a couple of handicaps; a watching brief is the percentage call after ten months off.

Front-running filly whose RPRs are moving in the right direction; dominated a small-field maiden at Ripon (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago and her pedigree points to this move up to 1m2f suiting now handicapping.

Churchill colt; 40,000euros yearling; half-brother to winners Spirit Of Saxony (7f AW; RPR 89), Coolmeen Vega (Spanish 7.5f-8.5f) and Pure Circle (Italian 6f); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Jessica's Dream; stable second-choice on debut in Killarney maiden 10 days ago, showing definite promise when beaten just over 3l, tiring late over today's trip; could well improve enough to play a role (holds big-race entries).

Dubawi colt cost 1,300,000gns as a yearling, dam a 7f-1m2f winner (inc AW/Group 1; RPR 120) and half-sister to Speak In Colours (6f Group 2 winner); stable third-choice but plenty of debut promise in Curragh maiden in late June, staying on well after racing keenly early on to finish third behind two stablemates (7f); extra furlong should suit and could prove hard to beat.

OwnerName: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
Spotlight: Camelot half-brother to 6f 2yo winner The Flying Seagull (RPR 85); dam Listed-placed 5f winner (97), half-sister to winners Shevchenko (useful 7f/1m) and Tigris River (1m6f Flat and smart 2m-2m4f hurdle), out of an Irish 1,000 Guineas winner.

Dark Angel colt; 3rd foal of a 7f winner (RPR 81), a sister to useful 7f-2m winner Duty Of Care, half-sister to Breeders' Cup Mile winner Expert Eye; family of 1,000 Guineas winner Special Duty; yard having a good season with it's 2yos so newcomer of definite interest, especially if strong in the market (although no big-race entries).

Inns Of Court gelding is first foal of a 1m/9.5f winner (inc AW; RPR 61), a half-sister to winners Fearless Angel (Listed-placed 5f 2yo), Go Vince Go (5f/6f) and Dark Oak (1m4f); debutant best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Naval Crown filly has put together series of good runs in defeat, including nose C&D defeat last month, most recently front-running clear third over C&D a week ago; will again run her race but remains vulnerable to above-average newcomers.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 65,000USD as a yearling, 300,000USD at Ocala in March; early speed before fading quite badly on Listowel debut in late May behind a stablemate; much more needed.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Soldier's Call filly; fourth foal; dam poor maiden half-sister to several winners, notably Fanaar (1m UAE Group 3); first 2yo runner of the season for the yard, seems best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Pinatubo filly is second foal; dam placed 1m/9.4f (RPR 71), half-sister to winners Eternal Silence (Group-placed 1m) and Chiara Luna (useful 6f/8.5f inc 2yo), out of 1m4f Group 2 winning half-sister to 1m6f Group 1 winner Royal Diamond; market well worth a check on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: First foal; dam placed 6f 2yo, half-sister to winners Oh Purple Reign (Listed-placed 6f-1m) and Warsaw Road (7f); dam placed 6f 2yo (70); shaped with some promise on Bellewstown debut early this month but this looks a stronger race.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: State Of Rest filly cost 34,000euros as a foal; half-sister to winners Loaded Gun (5f-1m2f inc AW/2yo/Qatar; RPR 81) and Another Bertie (5f/6f AW; 54); dam 7f 2yo winner (85), half-sister to 5f 2yo Listed winner Roxan; rare 2yo runner for the yard and likely all the better for the experience.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 300,000euros at the Arqana breeze-ups; half-sister to winners Golden Bugle (1m4f/13.5f; RPR 90) and Golden Love (1m; 59); dam 1m winner (inc Listed; 107), half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Footstepsinthesand and 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Pedro The Great; holds Lowther and Moyglare entries; obvious appeal from top yard.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Showcasing filly is first foal of a 1m AW winner (RPR 91), who is closely related to Group-placed 1m1f 2yo winner Green Storm; yard have a 20% strike rate with it's 2yos this season.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Bayside Boy filly cost 80,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Wonderful Times (1m2f inc AW/French Listed; RPR 101), Wondrous Words (1m2f; 89) and Megalithic (Qatari 7f); dam 6f/7f (Group 3) 2yo winner (105), sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Gustav Klimt; quite nicely-bred newcomer, worth a market check.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Showed up well in a barrier trial but failed to run to market expectations over C&D last month, having reportedly got upset in the stalls; improvement likely.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Earthlight filly cost 20,000euros; couple of ordinary efforts in 5f maidens, now upped markedly in trip; more likely one for a nursery.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Hello Youmzain filly cost 6,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to French 1m4f winner Imperious Man; dam French 8.5f AW winner, half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Sofast; yard had a 2yo winner at Down Royal last week.

OwnerName: Flaxman Stables, Mrs Magnier, M Tabor, D Smith
Spotlight: Sea The Stars filly out of the brilliant Alpha Centauri; debut second over C&D last month to Blonde Over Blue (soft) before bolting up over the same trip on quicker ground in Curragh maiden later in month, making all (second beaten odds-on favourite since, third has won since) to win under hands and heels; high-class filly in the making, major player.
Magna Grecia filly won a Roscommon maiden and most recently nicely improved to land Naas Listed over a mile, relishing stamina test; going the right way but this likely a much stiffer task.

OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: No Nay Never half-sister to Group 1 juvenile winner Puerto Rico; steady improvement in three maiden runs, most recently third over C&D a fortnight ago; that form looks a long way off what is likely required here and cheekpieces tried.

Lope De Vega filly cost 260,000gns as a foal and 400,000gns as a yearling; first foal; dam 1m1f-1m4f winner (inc AW/Italian Group 3; RPR 105); not especially strong in the market when making winning debut last month in C&D fillies' maiden, handy throughout off steady pace and getting first run on strong-finishing second Alpha; very interesting rematch with that rival who  has won impressively since.
Blue Point filly took a step in the right direction in Naas Listed early this month when staying on fifth (beaten 3.5l) behind Dancing Destiny over 1m; lots more required here.

By Prix de l'Abbaye winner Wooded and cost 41,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to French 6f-7.5f winner Viva La Skids (inc 2yo; RPR 103); dam maiden, is out of half-sister to US 1m2f Grade 1 winner Desert Blanc; has missed two engagements (coughing/off feed); eye-catching jockey booking for belated debut.

Finished third over C&D on debut and improved from that to take a Fairyhouse maiden over 7f; seemed to get outstayed over 1m in a Naas listed race last time and coming back to this trip can suit; looks the stable second-string but can't be ruled out.

Shaped with promise on debut at the Curragh over 6f and was much-improved to run away with a Gowran maiden over 7f since; the form of that race is solid and if this colt is as effective on this sounder surface then he should be a major player; looks the yard first-string.

Superbly bred colt was the second-string on debut when winning a Curragh maiden over this trip; his better fancied stablemate, Giant Sequoia, finished third and has since won a Curragh maiden; reared in the stalls and was withdrawn before the start of the Chesham Stakes when 11/4; a big player if there is no repeat of that behaviour; stable first-string.

An 80,000gns yearling; started 3/1 second fav' for a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and showed a good attitude to score, beating Supreme Lord into third by 1l; the fourth that day won at the Curragh last weekend and this colt should have improved since; seems stable second-string.

Cost 400,000gns as a yearling; started 5/2 fav' and ran a solid race on debut at Fairyhouse over 6f, beaten 1l by Nail House; and this colt should have improved since so there shouldn't be much between them today.

Third foal; half-brother to 6f turf/7f AW winner Ze Do Asfalto (RPR 84); dam 7f AW 2yo winner (78), sister to 5f/6f winner Awsaaf, half-sister to prolific 5f/6f winner Street Life; second runner for yard; decent pedigree but will have to be a smart sort to take this on debut.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have come at this track over 1m in varying ground conditions; cracking effort back here last time over that trip; up 3lb but the extra furlong is a question.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Won an AW maiden over this trip last winter; cracking efforts first two starts this term on turf, over 1m at Naas and 1m2f at Navan; not as good at the Curragh last time off this mark.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner for Ger Lyons ran his best race for this yard when fifth over 1m at this track last time; was staying on that day so this extra furlong should be a help; considered.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Opened his account when emphatically winning a Down Royal handicap over 1m2.5f in May; got a 15lb hike for that and has found life difficult twice since; down 2lb.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
OwnerName: Martin W Walsh & Tony Carey & Brian Murray & Mark Hopkins
Spotlight: Won a Dundalk maiden over 1m2.5f last November; best run since was when third in a 1m2f handicap here; never involved over 1m4f at the Curragh since; might find this trip a bit sharp.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark on 10th start when winning a Dundalk maiden over 10.5f last time; raised 3lb for that but has run well in defeat at this venue before so is one to consider.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Five-time winner up to 1m2.5f; last win came at the Curragh in 2025 off 2lb higher; has been a bit hit and miss since but has faced some stiff tasks too; beaten 6.5l in the Ulster Oaks last time off this mark; needs more.

RaceName: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a Killarney maiden over 1m recently; has run well over C&D before so should be fine on that score; the tongue-tie worn last time is retained; a player.

Some promise in both 2yo runs; improved from his seasonal debut here to win a Curragh maiden, both over 1m2f; did well on latter occasion as had to wait for room; takes a major step up in trip today but has prospects of staying.

OwnerName: Mrs Richard Henry & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Won Dundalk handicaps over 1m and 1m2.5f in the spring; fine efforts in defeat in 1m4f handicaps here and at the Curragh since  behind Darius Dark; up another 2lb but has prospects of staying and a player.
Showed improved form to win a Limerick handicap over 1m4f last time in first-time cheekpieces (retained); raised 12lb for that but shapes as if this trip is within reach so has to enter calculations.

Half-brother to a German 1000 Guineas winner from a speedy damline; made a winning debut over 1m at Dundalk in January and the runner-up is now rated 78; tongue-tie added now up markedly in trip after a break; still has to be respected.
Won twice at this track last year over 1m4f/1m5f; the best of three runs this term came back here last time over the longer trip; steps up in trip today and a big player if staying; raised 1lb.

Dual bumper and maiden hurdle winner; some decent Flat runs in six attempts including over C&D last time when he faced a difficult task against some quality rivals; can't be ruled out back in a handicap.
Three wins up to 2m; below form on the Flat and over hurdles the last twice and isn't easy to fancy at present despite a dropping mark.
Her only Flat win in 33 starts came in this race in 2023 on soft ground; best run this year was on soft at Down Royal; has to improve on latest two runs; ground concerns.
Hurdle winner has won twice on the Flat, the latest coming over 2m1f at Limerick in 2025; not bad runs lately including when not getting the cleanest of trips at Killarney last time; one to consider.
Won twice last term over approx' 1m6f at Sligo and the Curragh; didn't build on solid Navan seasonal bow when well beaten last time at the Curragh; down in grade today and can do better.
Has been poor in five hurdle starts and was well beaten in a Tramore Flat claimer lately so others preferred.
Got off the mark at Navan over 1m5f and good efforts since over just short of this trip at Bellewstown and Killarney; needs a bit more off this mark.
Dual-purpose maiden has been poor on last two starts (bled at Fairyhouse first time); opposed with a visor added.

RaceName: Follow BetVictor On Instagram Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Travelled strongly before asserting in pretty good style at Beverley (7.4f, good; third a recent winner) last month, his second start; the only runner from Karl Burke's North Yorkshire stable on this card; needs to be taken very seriously.

RaceName: Follow BetVictor On Instagram Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise and looked suited by the step up in trip when making all in Lingfield novice (7f, AW) this month; returns to turf for this nursery debut; likely contender again.

RaceName: Follow BetVictor On Instagram Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Swooped on the outside for comfortable success in Chester novice (6f, good to soft) last month, his second start, and seemed to cope with the much faster ground when respectable fourth at Salisbury (6f, good to firm; 1.5l behind Flying Pirate but now 3lb better off) on latest outing; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Follow BetVictor On Instagram Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Built upon promising debut when finishing well to collar a subsequent winner at Kempton (7f, AW) last month; did that quite cosily in the end and could easily have more improvement to come in nurseries back on turf.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; sister to Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner Publish (RPR 96); dam US 1m-1m1f turf winner (including Grade 2; 106), sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winners Arizona; with a top stable and looks the part on paper.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Out of a Group-placed 6f 2yo winner and made quite promising debut when sixth of 13 here (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely to play a significant role if able to build on that performance.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fourth foal; sister to 6f/7f 2yo winner Ellaria Sand (incuding Listed; RPR 97), half-sister to 5f AW 2yo winner Ba'Hoa (76); dam 6f AW winner (79), half-sister to useful winners Rekdhat (7f/1m including 2yo) and Ajaadat (7.4f/1m including 2yo); has the right type of pedigree for this race.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Not disgraced when seventh in good Newmarket maiden (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, her second run, but needs to improve again here.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Out of a very well-connected mare but was towards the rear throughout her debut at Kempton (7f, AW) six weeks ago and needs to take a big step forward here.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 5,000gns foal; first foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Divine Unicorn (Australian 1m3f Group 3) and Measuring Time (useful 7f 2yo), out of disqualified 1m 2yo winner/Oaks fourth; the other three newcomers look more interesting.

RaceName: Pump Technology Services Jung Training Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 86,000euros yearling; first foal; dam runner-up 7f/1m AW (RPR 68), half-sister to winners Emperor Claudius (1m Listed), Dark Lochnagar (1m1f 2yo/1m2f) and Dove Mountain (7f-1m2f), out of 1,000 Guineas winner Virginia Waters; market may guide.
Made good progress last year, collecting four 6f wins along the way, but made nothing better than a satisfactory reappearance in May and is still on a fairly tough mark for this first run since.

Made all off today's mark on seasonal debut at Bath (5.7f, firm) in April and will be fine over this slightly longer trip but doesn't always looks straightforward and needs to up her game after two below-par 5f runs.

Bettered disappointing seasonal debut when third of five at Nottingham (6f, good) last month and is now 1lb lower than when winning from off the pace at Haydock (6f, good) last summer; no surprise if she features.

Progressive 3yo who opened her account in five-runner Yarmouth handicap (6f, good to firm) last month, her fifth start; 5lb higher in a deeper race here but should still have more to offer; high on the list.

Scored on seasonall/handicap debut at Southwell (6f, AW) in April and made the frame three consecutive times on turf (5f-6f) afterwards; didn't fire last time but remains quite lightly raced; contender if back on song.
Still 4lb higher than when winning at Leicester (6f, good to firm) in May but has been pretty consistent since rejoining Tony Carroll in March and probably won't be far away.

Sightly disappointing after sluggish start at Newmarket this month but returned to turf with three good runs this spring, the most notable a win at Windsor (6f, good to firm) on second occasion; features prominently in calculations.
4-13 on AW but 0-11 on turf; had soft ground as an excuse last time, though, and has each-way claims at least if judged on her second at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May.

RaceName: Newbury Racecourse Resident DJ, Moonraker Disco Handicap
Spotlight: Clear second when upped to 11.6f for seasonal/handicap debut at Bath this month and won readily over 1m6f there (again on firm) last week; carries 6lb penalty (due to go up by that amount anyway) here but probably still has more improvement to come; cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Newbury Racecourse Resident DJ, Moonraker Disco Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive 8yo who has not been firing on all cylinders this season and was beaten over 14l when fourth of five at Lingfield (2m, good) last month; continues to slide down the weights but needs a revival.

RaceName: Newbury Racecourse Resident DJ, Moonraker Disco Handicap
Spotlight: Nothing like the force of old but won comfortably on seasonal debut at Ffos Las (2m, good; first win since 2021) last month, despite refusing to settle in early stages; only second when odds-on to follow up in four-runner race at Doncaster (1m6f, good to firm; again raced too freely) soon afterwards but at least we know he's in good nick.

Ex-Irish 4yo who started off for Richard Hughes with emphatic 1m4f turf wins at Brighton (good to firm) and Epsom (good) this summer; lost out narrowly when odds-on at Kempton (1m3f, AW) two weeks ago, having been forced to make his own running in a tactical race, but remains of strong interest.

Unexposed filly who made winning debut in AW in Ireland in January (10.6f) and posted best of three runs for new stable when third of seven on last month's handicap debut at Goodwood (1m4f, good), form recently well advertised by the winner.

Not seen on the Flat since signing off for Ed Walker with narrow success in first-time blinkers at Salisbury (1m2f, good) in October but won a recent handicap hurdle for new connections (no headgear) and is unexposed over this sort of trip in this sphere.

Progressive 4yo who scored on seasonal debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) and has gone close on last two appearances; drew nicely clear of the others with next-time-out winner at Goodwood (1m4f, good to soft) last month and is only 2lb higher here (due to go up another 2lb soon) but needs to prove himself on the faster ground.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
OwnerName: Ms Caroline Instone & J S Moore
Spotlight: Has much better strike-rate on AW but has performed well on fast turf here twice in recent weeks (1m3f/1m2f) and is still on a workable mark.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who was creditable third of 14 under Harry Rimell in stronger race than this at York (extended 1m2f, good) last month; good chance off same mark here, assuming he handles the faster ground.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent 6yo who was beaten under 1l when fourth of eight at Chester (extended 1m4f, good) 12 days ago and will be fine over this shorter trip; likely to be on the premises again.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Came good at ninth attempt, when back on turf at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) last month; nudged up only 2lb for that and remains unexposed over this trip; big player if aided by new tongue-tie and/or cheekpieces.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Gained his last four wins on heavy ground at Ffos Las (1m-1m2f); handles fast ground but is yet to strike form after three runs this season and might still be too high in the weights.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Went close at Wolverhampton (1m6f, AW) for Alan King in February but dropped out quite tamely on recent stable debut (2m, AW) and this shorter trip may not be ideal for him nowadays.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Began this year with three respectable 7f AW runs in blinkers (missing today) and can also be effective over 1m2f on turf but has fitness to prove after 145-day break and his last win came in summer 2024.

RaceName: Frasers Plus Designer Outlet Swindon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds when second of 22 under Chelsea Edwards at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in March and put some poor efforts behind him when third at Ffos Las (1m, good; refitted cheekpieces) last month but is not easy to predict and has stamina to prove over this new trip.

3yo who won his first three handicaps (6f, turf/AW) and bounced back from heavy Ascot defeat (6f, good) with respectable fourth at Kempton (6f, AW) latest; he has plenty of speed and this first crack at 5f is well worth a go.
Unplaced on last two starts but hasn't run badly and he's 4lb lower than when runner-up over C&D (good) in June; capable of having a big say.

6yo who is well handicapped on last season's best efforts for Michael Bell; however, it was a winless campaign and he failed to threaten at Yarmouth in April on his sole run this year; changed hands for 18,500gns last month and he needs to get back on track on this stable debut.

He won three times over 5f last August-October and is 8lb below his last winning mark; drops back in trip today but he's finished down the field on all five starts this season and has plenty to prove.

Merely sixth of eight at Goodwood last month but his two best performances have coincided with his two visits to Sandown, including a C&D win (good) in May; this lightly raced 3yo is firmly in calculations back here.

Hold-up performer who won two in a row in May (5.7f/6f, good to firm) before keeping on for fifth of 13 at Windsor (5f, good to firm), and he was back on the scoresheet at Bath (5.7f, firm) three weeks ago; the return to a bare 5f may not be ideal but the stiff track compensates; respected.

Won in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Windsor (5f, good to firm) in May and second at Bath (5f, firm) next time; the track may not have suited at Brighton last time and he could bounce back with a big run.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; Mehmas half-brother to 1m4f AW winner Rogue Impact (RPR 94); dam once-raced half-sister to winners Mukhadram (1m2f Group 1) and Woodland Aria (useful 7f/9.4f); with a leading stable; one to consider on debut.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has shown some ability on both starts, when seventh of ten at Ascot (6f, good) then fifth of nine at Lingfield (7f, AW; 16-1 each time); however, takes on some interesting newcomers and could again prove vulnerable.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; third foal; dam German 1m3f and 2m4f (Listed) winner (RPR 93), half-sister to French 1m4f Group 2 winner Now We Can, out of German 1m3f/1m4f winner; a market check is advised but this Ghaiyyath newcomer may come into his own over quite a bit further.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 160,000euros yearling; sixth foal; New Bay half-brother to winners Galiac (7f including 2yo; RPR 96), Gallic (1m 2yo/1m2f AW; 92), Galsworthy (1m4f AW; 82) and Galel (7f AW; 65); dam 1m3f/1m4f winner (including Listed; 106), out of 1m Group 1 winner Spinning Queen; may need this debut outing but is bred to be talented and is not ruled out.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 700,000gns yearling; third foal; dam Listed-placed 10.5f/1m4f winner, sister to 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Kingsbarns; it's likely his future lies over further but this Dubawi newcomer is nevertheless high on the list.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 160,000euros yearling; first foal; dam made the frame over 6.5f-1m3f in France, half-sister to French winners Muette (1m4f Listed) and Sans Voix (1m 2yo Listed); trainer is enjoying an excellent season with his 2yos and this Sea The Stars newcomer could have a big say.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late John Connolly
Spotlight: 80,000euros foal, 170,000gns yearling; seventh foal; Palace Pier half-brother to winners Treizieme (French 1m/8.5f including 2yo), Tik Tok Famous (US 7.5f/1m turf) and Goldis (Slovakian 1m2f); dam placed 1m1f in France, half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Elusive Kate; respected trainer yet to get going with his 2yos this season, but it will be no surprise to see a big run on debut.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £70,000 half-brother to four winners who is open to improvement on this second start; however, he was a well-beaten seventh of ten at 20-1 at Lingfield (7f, AW) this month and a sizeable step forward is needed.

RaceName: Martin Densham & Peter Deal Memorial British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 72,000euros yearling; tenth foal; closely related to 6f 2yo winner Bay Of Plenty (RPR 97), half-sister to five winners including Glesga Gal (7f AW; 100) and Vivianite (1m; 99); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner; potential in pedigree and still early days but has to leave debut run miles behind.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Won on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) last month then finished a close third of 14 against males in the Listed Chesham Stakes at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm; led); leading claims back against fellow fillies.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Went very close on debut at Doncaster (6.5f, good to firm) last month before easily making all at 4-9 at Newbury (7f, good to firm); this is a tougher test of her credentials but she could be up to the task.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Caught the eye when fifth to Aperoll on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) in June before keeping on for respectable eighth in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); runner-up in hot maiden at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last time and she might not be far away.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Improved upon her debut run to win at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) recently; had just a short head to spare and her best days are likely to be over further, but she's the type to keep on progressing and is not ruled out.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: 2-1, rallied to make winning debut in three-runner novice at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago and the third has won since; this 230,000gns yearling is in top hands and could have lots more to offer, especially now upped to 7f; possible player.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: She's shown ability in defeat across her three starts (7f, AW/good to firm) but not enough to suggest she'll be making an impact this afternoon.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: Built upon the promise of her debut third at Kempton (7f, AW) to win at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month; it was a small field last time and the return to a bare 7f isn't an obvious positive, but she's a likeable prospect for the stable that won this in 2019 and 2022.

RaceName: European Bloodstock News EBF Star Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)
Spotlight: 11-2 when promising third of six on debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; up in grade today but the Nottingham form has received a firm boost from the runner-up and this 140,000euros breeze-up buy is open to considerable improvement; one to watch in the betting.

Lightly raced and well-bred 5yo by Frankel; won a novice at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in November 2024 for Roger Varian and then absent until Newmarket (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago, when runner-up on his handicap and stable debut; could have a big say up in trip if avoiding the dreaded bounce.
Returned from a break with good third at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last month; his peak efforts have come on AW but he's lightly raced on turf, on which he's shown promise, and he could have a part to play.
Lightly raced 4yo who has failed to kick on since 2yo win for Andre Fabre in November 2024; well beaten at Yarmouth on last month's stable debut; others arrive with a lot less to prove.

Won at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in April and he produced one of his better turf runs when close fifth of eight at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last time; however, a record of 0-22 on grass doesn't inspire confidence.

Won on turf debut at Yarmouth (1m, good) in May before good second there (1m, good) seven days later, and she got up in the final strides at Salisbury (1m, good) last month; the step up in trip could be a positive for this lightly raced 4yo and there's lots to like.

Returned to form to win at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) this month and he's since been second at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm), albeit no match for the progressive winner; there's every chance he'll be in the mix.

Improved when upped in trip for handicap debut at Lingfield (11.6f, good to firm) eight days ago, coming from last of three to lead 2f out and win by 12l under Alexandra Egan; has 6lb penalty (due to go up another 1lb) but did it easily that day and has clear potential for this sort of trip.

Won two of his three handicaps (on good) and beaten a head in the other (good to firm); collared the odds-on front-runner close home when upped to 1m6f in eight-runner race at York last time; raised another 5lb but progressive and still promising.

All four races on good ground; two places before she got off the mark in a four-runner maiden at Pontefract (1m2f) in June; favourite when upped to 1m4f for handicap debut at Epsom four weeks later, coming from off the pace for a creditable third of ten off this mark despite persistently hanging left; 1m6f is plausible on that display and she may still have more to give.

Improved when second of ten in a handicap at Windsor (upped to 1m2f, good to firm) early last month; fair fourth of seven at Bath one month later over 11.6f which might have stretched her (made most); may have more to offer back at this trip but it is needed.

Sent handicapping for last three starts, comfortably on top at Bath (1m2f, good) on second occasion and making all in five-runner race at Salisbury (1m2f, good to firm) 12 days ago; hung on by a head last time and raised another 4lb today, which demands better but she has been on the upgrade.

Off 218 days when making her handicap debut in a first-time hood at Nottingham (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, coming from towards rear to emerge in second of eight to an impressive winner; has the same mark today, could have come on for the run and gave hope for 1m2f.

Ex-Irish; tailed off on her stable/handicap debut (1m4f, good to soft) early last month, but 33-1 winner at Chepstow (1m4f) next time and she followed up in four-runner race at same track (1m2f, again good to firm) eight days later; penalty makes her only another 2lb higher today and she's on a roll.

Won off 4lb lower at Epsom (1m2f, good) last August in her second handicap; runner-up on next two starts but much less impact since (despite being prominent in the betting on last two outings) and needs to turn things around with the first-time tongue-tie.
Close third of six at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) on debut in May, which she's not lived up to in her two starts since but these are early days and this is her handicap debut; needs a second look.

Sole win (ten races) was over 1m4f on the Kempton AW in April in first-time hood, which has been kept since; same mark today, having been out of form on last three outings (back to 1m2f for latest); others preferred.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Patchy campaign last season but he's 2lb lower than when winning at Newbury (1m, good) last May and reappeared with a good second at Brighton (1m, good to firm) last month; in the mix if backing that up.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
OwnerName: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner
Spotlight: Back on song when runner-up at Lingfield (7f, good) last month, but he's struggled on both runs since; very awkward at the start and soon tailed off when 40-1 over C&D (good) three weeks ago; risky.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up three times in a row on AW this April-June, but below-par sixth at Kempton (1m, AW) three weeks ago and he failed to shine when tackling turf last year; has his first outing on grass of 2026.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Went close at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) on reappearance and returned to form to win at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) recently; he likes that seaside venue and drops back in trip today, but he is capable of running well away from Brighton and at 1m, so he could be in the shake-up.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Bath (1m, good) in May on third start for new yard and completed the hat-trick at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; had just a neck to spare last time but he's just 3lb higher today and there can be optimism that this smooth-travelling 3yo still has more left in the tank.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Promise on both 2yo starts (7f, AW) and, following wind surgery, he kept on for a close second on last month's handicap debut at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) where he had to wait for a clear run; open to further improvement back up to 1m and this 3yo is on the shortlist.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: He's dropped down the weights and didn't run badly when third of seven at Brighton (7f, good to firm) recently, but he's 0-12 in handicaps and needs a bigger performance if he's to come out on top today.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Having dropped down the weights he returned to form when third at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; however, a lesser run followed at Ascot (7f, good to firm) and he's unproven at 1m.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Won on reappearance at Bath (1m, firm) in April in first-time blinkers (retained); some respectable efforts since but needs something extra if he's to return to winning ways today.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Returned to form when runner-up at Kempton (1m, AW) in May, but down the field at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) since and she's won just one of her 18 starts; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who hasn't progressed since making a promising start to her career last year; however, there have been hints that this first crack at 1m will suit, when keeping on for fifth at both Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in January and Leicester (6f, good to firm) this month; not discounted.

RaceName: Billy Ocean Live At Sandown Park 29 July Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner who won at Kempton (1m, AW) last October; however, this 8yo wasn't at the top of his game at Southwell (1m, AW) in January and he may improve for this first outing since.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Effective over C&D but his two wins this year have come over 1m on this track; has remained in form on turf since the latest of them in April and he shouldn't be far away.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Took his time about getting off the mark but he did so in good style on Lingfield AW (7f) ten days ago and, although back up 9lb, he went close off this mark at Ascot last September; also has form over this C&D (one attempt); solid claims.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Both AW wins at Newcastle (1m and 7f) but he lost out only narrowly over C&D in March; has had ups and downs since but he came from well back when fourth of ten to Gunfighter over C&D recently; place chance.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: All four AW wins on Polytrack, the latest more than four years ago, and he's likely to need more than a respectable sixth at Newcastle in May, when having a rare run on Tapeta, and also on his Chester form since; headgear returns for the first time since last July.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runs; all three wins at 7f, the latest on Newcastle AW last August; probably found the return to 1m was pushing it on Kempton AW 15 days ago but he ran well for a long way and this test will work better for him.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced; has shown enough on Polytrack to think he can find a race before long but he was well held in his first Tapeta handicap, over C&D recently, in first-time tongue-tie; will need more today.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Had 7f form in Ireland but that was two years ago and his course win came over 1m in April (made all) on second start for this yard; no advance on that form in two runs since but perhaps the return to this trip will improve his options.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden after 14 starts; very slowly away two starts ago but otherwise has possibilities, having run most of his best races on Tapeta and was hampered in his run over C&D last time; may well be involved.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Broke duck over 6f on Newcastle AW last November but he hasn't run to the same level at that trip or 7f this year; has it to prove at present.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Five AW wins include two on this course (at 6f; has won over 7f) but he's been going through a quieter spell of late; others more likely.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced since getting off the mark on Wolverhampton AW (about 1m1f) last June, dropping out there 16 days ago for another new yard; has plenty to prove in his first 7f handicap.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr
Spotlight: Two 6f wins on Tapeta in 2025 and he's had just three goes at this trip, all on turf; he didn't do badly when fourth on Carlisle's stiff track last time out so perhaps he's worth another shot at 7f, albeit his AW mark is 5lb higher than on turf.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came over 1m here in 2024; on a useful mark at present but has a question mark about current form, having dropped out on his final start for previous yard and on debut for this one, at Chester 13 days ago.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Night Of Thunder colt who cost 100,000gns as a yearling and 580,000euros at a breeze-up sale; half-brother to seven winners including Via Serendipity (7f-8.6f; RPR 111), Strong Chemistry (7f; 107) and Le Juge (1m-1m2f; 106); dam 7f/1m Listed winner (101); lots to like on paper and the market can guide as to expectations on debut.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Beaten three times but she sets the standard on her thirds at Carlisle (1m, soft) and Ffos Las (extended 7f, good); last time she was clear of the rest behind two promising horses.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: 155,000gns yearling by Too Darn Hot; 28-1, he showed promise behind a talented stablemate over 1m here a month ago (beaten a shade under 7l); can improve; tongue-tie goes on.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: 160,000gns yearling by Bated Breath; a weak 16-1 chance when finishing a remote sixth at Windsor (1m, good to soft); has to show more.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
OwnerName: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg
Spotlight: By Sea The Stars; first foal; dam German 1m3f winner (Group 3; RPR 106), half-sister to French 1m4f winner Waugh; bred to be above average and the market should be informative.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Beaten about 12l into midfield at Wolverhampton last month (7f) where he didn't get the clearest of passages; still makes limited appeal.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
OwnerName: Peter Onslow, FDC Holdings Ltd & NWIR Ltd
Spotlight: Ran okay when beaten 8.5l in a warm race at York (1m) but Newcastle (7f) was disappointing; not without hope if tapping back into the promise of that initial run.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Well beaten in two runs for James Owen and was sold on for 1,000gns.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Has performed to an ordinary level thus far and handicaps will be more like it.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: 4,000euros foal; fifth foal; half-brother to Bahraini 7f winner Yuan Prince; dam 7f winner (RPR 71), sister to 5f Group 1 winner Move In Time; gelded ahead of this debut and a hood is fitted; not that appealing.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Down the field in 1m/7f races at Newcastle, the latest in early May; no appeal.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div I)
Spotlight: Finished last on debut here and again at Thirsk, both times over 1m; no appeal.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Australian-bred filly by Frankel; had one run in these colours for George Boughey when beaten a little under 10l in a warm 1m novice for fillies at Newmarket just over a year ago; second run has been a long time coming but she has ability.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
OwnerName: A D G Oldrey & G C Hartigan
Spotlight: Gelded after a very quiet debut last November and duly showed lots more when just run out of it at Lingfield (extended 7f, soft) having been given every chance; that wasn't a strong race despite the winner following up in a handicap, but neither is this.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Well related; showed plenty more on his second visit to Kempton (7f) when only 2l behind a Ralph Beckett-trained winner; this colt raced prominently before weakening; solid chance on the back of that.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: They all finished in a bit of a heap when this filly was only 2.5l off the winner here 18 days ago; ran well for a 250-1 chance but probably needs more here.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Insufficient promise in her first two races to warrant a second look in this.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: High-class US pedigree and cost 250,000euros at a 2yo breeze-up sale; however, changed hands again for 6,000gns this April; a watching brief is best.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to five winners including Earls Rock (US 6.5f-8.5f; Grade 3; RPR 107), Lady La Fay (11.4f/1m4f; 94) and Cash Or Crypto (6f; 88); dam 7.4f/1m winner (97); trainer-owned newcomer; others preferred.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Trailed the winner by about 20l on 7f debut at Wolverhampton two weeks ago (250-1).

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Last of six on debut and a tailed-off last of nine last week at Wolverhampton (first-time hood).

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Half-brother to five winners including Free Love (5f; RPR 92), Lydia's Place (5f; 90), Lawless Louis (5f-6f; 81) and Dimitar (7f/1m; 76); dam 5f 2yo winner (74); gelded ahead of debut; one to watch more than likely.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
OwnerName: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells
Spotlight: Respectable runs at Chelmsford and here but hard to rate her form too highly and she's stepping up from 5f.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Half-brother to 5.7f winner Malham Tarn Cove (RPR 57); dam 5f/6f winner (68); kicks off at 7f despite his speedy pedigree; limited appeal.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App 'Confined' Maiden Stakes (No More Than Three Runs) (GBB) (Div II)
Spotlight: Half-brother to 6f/7f winner Deposer (RPR 112); this is a very belated debut at six and can only be watched.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: All four starts in Class 2 company, including when beaten a neck by the subsequent Lily Agnes winner Adonius at Musselburgh (5f, good to soft) in April and when third of 13 in the Woodcote at Epsom (6f, good to soft) last month; high draw one small negative, but he is in much calmer waters here and his four winning siblings and his dam were all successful on the AW; should be hard to beat.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Improved plenty from his debut effort when beaten just over a length into third of 18 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; half-brother and dam both won on the AW and any further improvement will make him a big player.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 25-1 when seventh of ten on his Ayr debut (7f, good) this month; improvement needed, though he is a half-brother to two AW winners and his sire has a good record around here.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
OwnerName: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha
Spotlight: Some ability in his first two starts, but failed to beat a rival at Bath (5.7f, firm) this month (reportedly hung violently right-handed); gelding operation will need to have made a big difference.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Nice pedigree but well held in 6f maidens at Windsor (good to firm) and Kempton (Polytrack) last month; nurseries beckon.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: April foal by Calyx; 25,000euros yearling; half-brother to six winners including Whispering Bell (1m; RPR 90), Stardayz (1m AW; 81), Unsung Hero (7f AW; 78) and Beauty Nation (6f AW 2yo; 78); dam placed 5f 2yo (72), half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Newfangled; sire has a good record here and stable does have winning 2yo newcomers; worth a market check.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Faced an impossible task on last month's York debut as things turned out, but did hint at ability when fifth of ten at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) 12 days later; not sure dropping back in trip is ideal, though, and nurseries over further may see him in a better light.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: February foal by Starspangledbanner; 20,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners La Ferveur (French 8.5f; RPR 88) and Impelling (Czech 6.5f); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (94), half-sister to Italian 5f Listed winner Gamgoom, out of half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Profitable; already gelded and would be a very rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Showed some promise when fourth of eight on last month's Carlisle debut (5f, good to soft), but the form hasn't worked out and he himself was well held at Pontefract (6f, good) 12 days later; has the outside stall and may be one for nurseries.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: 25-1 when last of nine on his Newcastle debut (7f, Tapeta) four weeks ago; look elsewhere.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Completely blew the start when last of nine on his debut in a Leicester seller (6f, good to firm; 11-1) this month; needs a sizeable step forward.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div I)
Spotlight: Held in her first two starts at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) and Ripon (6f, good), but showed a glimmer of ability on each occasion; out of a Listed winner, but nurseries may be a more suitable option after this.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Hasn't stepped up from his narrow defeat at Pontefract (5f, good) on his second start in April, albeit 7f may have stretched him at Ayr last time; has still shown enough to make the shortlist, though, with his half-brother and dam both successful on the AW.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Some ability when fourth of seven on her Musselburgh debut (5f, good) in May, but was completely out of her depth in the Woodcote at Epsom (6f, good to soft) last month; two of her siblings and her dam won on the AW, but nurseries may be a better fit after this.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Surrounded by subsequent winners when third of 11 on her Beverley debut (5f, good to soft) in May, but disappointed at Redcar (6f, good to firm) later in month; her dam won four times on the Fibresand here and she would have to be respected if building on that first effort.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 25-1 when finishing in midfield behind the subsequent Super Sprint winner Zigazig Ah on last month's Yarmouth debut (6f, good to firm); needs to take a step forward.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Missed the break but still showed plenty of promise when third of ten on her Yarmouth debut (6f, good to firm; 33-1) five weeks ago (fifth has won since); wouldn't want to lose too much ground from the inside stall here, but still a major player granted normal progress.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 50-1 when beaten 2l into fourth of nine on this month's Leicester debut (6f, good to firm); that was only a seller, though, and others are preferred even though the third has won since.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: March foal by Belardo; 2,000gns yearling; dam unraced half-sister to winners Day Of Conquest (useful 7f/1m 2yo), Day By Day (useful 5f/6f) and Alexander Ballet (5f; dam of 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Hearts of Fire); stable has few 2yos go in first time while the outside stall may prove tricky for a newcomer.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Had excuses for her Wetherby debut, but less so for her Newbury effort (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; best watched for now.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: Well held in novices at Windsor (5f, good to firm) and Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last month; one of his winning half-sisters and his dam were successful on the AW, but best watched for now.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: 40-1 when well beaten on this month's Thirsk debut (6f, good to firm); stable's newcomers are usually better for a run, but he needs plenty of improvement.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
TrainerName: Dr Richard Newland & Jamie Insole right
Spotlight: 16-1 when beating only one home on his Leicester debut (5f, good to firm) in May; hard to recommend.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race) (Div II)
Spotlight: April foal by Dream Ahead; half-sister to winners Miss Mai Tai (6f-1m including 2yo/France/Czechia; RPR 89), Miss Woo Woo (6f-7.5f including 2yo/AW/France/Belgium; 76) and Sands Of Seve (5f AW; 57); dam once-raced (52) half-sister to Swedish 5f-1m winner Sweet Loreen; would be a very rare winning 2yo newcomer from the yard.

Sole win (13 races) came over 1m4f in a classified on Wolverhampton Tapeta in March; third in classifieds on three of her four starts since, with recent form not looking quite good enough to win this handicap but she raced wide last time and peak efforts give her a shout.

12-race maiden; third off this career-low mark over about 1m4f at Windsor and Brighton in her two starts for new yard, which puts her in each-way calculations even though she tailed off (2m in December) in her only start on Tapeta.

OwnerName: W Enticknap, B Ralph And Partner
Spotlight: Edging down the weights and this six-race maiden has taken minor honours in his three handicaps (two 1m6f and one at 1m2f); first of those was on Wolverhampton Tapeta; considered.

Often a front-runner and gained the last six of his seven wins on this Southwell AW, with the latest win in March; Elle-May Croot knows him especially well, he's back to his last winning mark and return to Southwell (latest run here was five starts ago) might spark something.

Gained all three of his wins over hurdles at Ludlow (in May 2022, 2023 and 2025); twice second there before falling on latest start, seven weeks ago; lightly raced on Flat, without registering any solid form but they were all with either very different trip and/or surface to today's.

Won a 1m4f AW classified at Wolverhampton in March and so nearly won another at Lingfield 15 days later; pulled up over hurdles in May on his only start since but a return to form can't be ruled out, so neither can he.

Maiden hurdle winner in first-time blinkers; 0-11 on the Flat, which sees him continue down the weights but he's been soundly beaten in Polytrack handicaps (unraced on Tapeta) and Flat record over the last year has been uninspiring; visored first time (has tried cheekpieces as well as the blinkers).

Ridden by Finlay Bassett on last eight outings; sole win from 17 starts came on her handicap debut at Lingfield (1m5f, AW) in December; runner-up on three of her next four starts, including here, but not so good in recent races and needs to perk up again.

OwnerName: A Quirke & Mrs G B Walford
