Spotlight: Dam failed to complete in four points, out of German 1m winner; fell at the fourth in her sole point-to-point and that came over a year and a half ago.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At Raceday-Ready.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Filly by Harry Angel; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Simmering (6f/7f 2yo including Group 2; RPR 108) and Estate (5f; 84); dam 7f 2yo winner (82), closely related to 5f-7.4f winner Muatadel, out of 6f Group 3 winner; interesting newcomer.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At Raceday-Ready.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50,000euros foal, £78,000 breeze-up buy; Blackbeard colt; second foal; dam 5f/6f winner (including AW; RPR 81), half-sister to winners A Momentofmadness (useful 5f/6f including 2yo) and Arc Royal (7f 2yo), out of 6f 2yo winner, is granddaughter of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner; has a speedy pedigree and he's one to be interested in on his debut.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At Raceday-Ready.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
Spotlight: Well beaten when sent off favourite on his debut in May but took a big step forward over this C&D last week (good to firm), making all in a first-time hood (retained); carries a penalty but he's the one to beat.

RaceName: Free Digital Racecard At Raceday-Ready.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Tongue-tied for two previous starts but not today; pulled too hard when fourth of 13 on his debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and again took a firm grip before fading into eighth at Doncaster (6f, good to firm); this drop in trip could help him settle better.

Five of his six wins have been on the AW and the other came here over 7f last May (good to soft); well beaten on his last three starts, including at Newmarket last time on his first start for ten months, and is now tried in first-time cheekpieces.

Sole win from 14 starts came at Chester (7f, good; first-time hood) on her stable debut last July and she's posted some good efforts since, including at Brighton (1m) on her last two starts (carried head awkwardly latest); solid contender.

Lightly raced since making a winning debut at Salisbury (7f, good) in 2024 but ran creditably when ridden by Ebrahim Nader at Newbury (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; that was his first outing for nine months and he may well come on for it; claims.

Sole win from 14 starts came in a Lingfield maiden (1m, AW) in September on his final start for George Boughey; runner-up twice on the AW at the beginning of the year, and he may have needed his first start since February at Epsom (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago.

Seven-time winner when trained by Rae Guest and posted respectable efforts on the AW over 1m2f in two of his three outings for Edward Smyth-Osbourne; has been off since January and drops back in trip on his first start for this yard.

All six wins have been on the AW, the most recent coming at Southwell (1m, AW) in February; he was in fair form when last seen four months ago but has failed to beat a rival home in each of his three starts on turf.

RaceName: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins from four starts for Karl Burke (6f/7f; AW); ran well when third at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) on last month's stable and turf debut, but she was well held at Newmarket two weeks ago (hung left); needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap
Spotlight: Won 6f maiden and novice events as a 2yo; has posted three good efforts since being gelded, the most recent when narrowly denied in a three-runner handicap at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago; contender.

RaceName: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Frank Barry & Mrs Luke Barry
Spotlight: Made a winning stable debut in a Southwell novice (6f, AW) in January and took another step forward when sixth of eight in a Listed event at Lingfield (7f, AW) next time; now makes her handicap debut having been off since failing to beat a rival in a Goodwood Listed event in May and still needs to prove herself on turf.

RaceName: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap
Spotlight: All six starts have been on the AW; won at Lingfield (7f) in April before a good second of 13 at Kempton next time, and ran respectably in a 0-105 at Newcastle (7f) last month; drops in grade and has strong claims if coping with the surface on his turf debut.

Without a win since his debut in 2024 (posted an RPR of 89) but he was placed in each of his three starts for Jack Jones, and went close over C&D on his stable debut four weeks ago; he's on a handy mark and has to be respected.
Won on the AW over 7f at Chelmsford in January on his stable debut but he's been below his best on turf in recent starts, including when last of six over 1m here last month; visor now applied.

Came home nicely to win at Chelmsford (7f, AW; first start for 95 days) in January and was returning from a 50-day break when winning over 1m here (good to firm) three weeks ago; goes up in grade off a 3lb higher mark and will need them to go a solid gallop over this shorter trip.

Three of his four wins have been on the AW and the other came over this C&D in May off a 3lb lower mark than today's; ran respectably over 1m here four weeks ago and holds solid claims back down in trip.

Gained his sixth success when winning at Kempton (7f, AW) in March on his reappearance but he's been below that level in both starts since, including at Newbury three weeks ago; drops in grade but others have stronger claims.

Won twice at around 1m in June 2024; never dangerous when eighth of 12 in a 0-100 at York (6f, good) last month and she possibly wasn't helped by racing in a small group of three at Newbury (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; claims in first-time blinkers.

Well held in three novice/maiden events in April/May and he was beaten 20l on his handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last month; steps up to 1m4f with headgear discarded.

Off the mark at the sixth attempt when winning at Thirsk (1m4f, good) in May off 5lb lower, then seemed stretched by 1m6f on soft at Nottingham; ran well when close second of three at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) last night and she will have to be respected if running today.

OwnerName: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar
Spotlight: Won twice last August, at Brighton (1m2f, good) and Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm); below her best on her next three outings and she was brought down at Brighton last month; unproven over this trip.

Completed a hat-trick when winning at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last June but he mostly hasn't been at his best since; respectable effort at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) last time but he still needs to prove his stamina for this far.

Unexposed filly who ran to a similar level in three starts last year, but she was tailed off in a three-runner event at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) on her handicap debut four weeks ago; steps up in trip and she may yet do better.

Best effort in three novice/maiden events when fifth of ten at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; didn't look suited by the drop to 5f on her handicap debut back there last time (tongue-tied for the first time) and now steps back up in trip.

Off the mark when winning in first-time blinkers over C&D last month (soft) and shaped as if still in good form when fourth of 12 at Windsor (5f, good to firm) one month ago, leaving the impression he'll be well suited to stepping back up in trip; contender.
11-race maiden but she ran her best race when second of eight at Newbury (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago on her second start for this stable; steps back up in trip with claims.

12-race maiden; went close in a handicap at Nottingham (5f, soft) last month but he raced freely in a classified event over this trip at Lingfield (good) a week later; has the hood back on and needs to settle better.

Sole win from 14 starts came at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last May off a 5lb higher mark than today's; below her best when last seen 287 days ago and makes her stable debut having left Julia & Shelley Birkett (bought for 5,000gns).
11-race maiden but she has been placed on three occasions, including when second of four at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) last month; has cheekpieces back on and makes the shortlist.
Dual 6f AW winner for Martin Dunne, latterly at Wolverhampton last July; mostly struggled since and now makes his stable debut/reappearance having been secured for 14,000gns.

Solid fourth on his handicap debut at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month and built on that when winning at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; steps up in grade off this 3lb higher mark but he could have more to offer after just five starts.
Posted an improved effort when winning on his handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW) two weeks ago, pulling 3l clear with the runner-up; now 5lb higher but he's open to further progress; contender.
Off the mark when winning over this C&D in April off 4lb lower; raced too freely over 1m2f at Newmarket in May and he was well held on the July Course last month; return to this track may help.
Won twice on the AW at Kempton in October (1m/7f) but he's struggled in three starts this year; all starts on turf have been on ground slower than good, and he has a bit to prove.

OwnerName: Noir Et Or Elevage S.A & Ecurie Skymarc Farm

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 11-1 and apparent second string when she finished an eye-catching fourth of 11 to a stablemate at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Speed Of Sound third) a fortnight ago; that was an encouraging first go and she commands plenty of respect with a fair chunk of improvement on the cards.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £70,000 yearling who was lively in the market when a close third of 11 at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Sorrengail fourth) on her debut a fortnight ago; should improve and she's a leading candidate.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 325,000gns yearling by man-of-the-moment Starspangledbanner; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Maria Branwell (5f 2yo including Listed; RPR 99), Lucky Queen (1m; 70) and Elegant Queen (Scandinavian 7f/8.6f); dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Samminder (6f/7f) and Queen's Pearl (6f); leading yard is yet to fire on the juvenile front but will no doubt click into gear soon enough; market check essential.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Blue Point filly who beat odds-on Godolphin runner by a head to win Yarmouth maiden (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; open to progress and she's a player even with 7lb penalty.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 260,000gns yearling who didn't achieve a great deal when 9-2 and third of five at Goodwood (5f, good) five weeks ago; still very early days and that initial experience is unlikely to have been lost on her; step forward likely.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten about 5l in a turf novice (6f) and 7f maiden (AW) this month; a bit more is required and she might be one for nurseries.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 240,000euros yearling who overcame inexperience to score on her debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely capable of better despite the penalty; firm contender.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Modest form in two starts and she'll be of more interest once handicapped.

Scored at Thirsk (7f, good) on his second start in May and, after finding trouble in the Windsor Castle here, he was just behind Silver Dominion when back to 7f and fifth in Newmarket Group 2 a fortnight ago; might not be much between them again and he's respected.

Narrowly won on his debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) and he was far from discredited when fourth in a Group 2 at Newmarket (7f, good to firm; Alfred Wallace fifth) a fortnight ago; holds a future Group 1 entry and he just about sets the standard.

OwnerName: Eric Griffiths, Mrs T Burns & Partner
Spotlight: Belied market weakness and 40-1 odds when he made a winning debut at Bath (5.5f, firm) in April; highly tried subsequently, including when a not-disgraced fourth of five in Curragh Group 3 (6.5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; that form was a little dented on Saturday, though.

The door opened on his third start when comfortably landing Leicester maiden last month and he defied a market drift to make a winning nursery debut at Chester (again 7f, good) a fortnight ago; this is a different test altogether but he's likely capable of better again.

Came home well when he registered a winning introduction at Kempton (6f, AW) towards the end of last month; that form hasn't worked out yet but this extra furlong looks likely to suit on his turf debut.

Looked the business when taking six-runner Windsor novice (6f, good to firm) on her debut in May and was then runner-up to a good colt on softer ground 18 days later; had subsequent winners finish around her when 14th of 25 in the Albany last time and now tackles 7f; the sole filly but she can't be ruled out.

All three starts at 6f; he posted a promising debut at Nottingham in May and his midfield finish in the Coventry here, when drawn on the wrong side, was better than it looks on paper; stuck to his task well when landing a Salisbury novice (good to firm) at the end of last month, suggesting 7f is worth exploring; by no means out of this.

100,000euros breeze-up 2yo who was sent off favourite when showing a good attitude to land 6f Salisbury maiden (good) on his debut six weeks ago; shaped that day as though this extra furlong will be no issue and his yard has won this event with two of its last three representatives; likeable and has to be considered.

22-1 and he did well to overcome evident inexperience to make a winning debut at Sandown (7f, good) six weeks ago; that race is yet to produce a subsequent winner but it's traditionally a good maiden and he's an interesting candidate for respected yard.

He was beaten only 1l when third on his debut in May and made no mistake when scoring by 7l at Musselburgh (7f, good; favourite again) next time; 20-1 when he finished down the field in last month's Chesham over C&D but he has a Group 1 entry and it's way too soon to write him off.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who was upped to 2m on his third start for this yard when a fine second of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m, AW; Synergism third) four weeks ago; 2lb nudge could have been worse and he's unexposed over staying trips; big player.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Career-best form this term includes a win on her reappearance at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) in April; handicapper might have her pegged now, so this new trip will need to unlock more; still not ruled out.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Elb Bloodstock Ltd And R L Banks
Spotlight: Won the Shergar Cup Stayers handicap over C&D last August and he was back to that level when second over 1m6f here (good to firm) a fortnight ago; remains on a competitive mark and needs respect.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive sort who won four times last year and has kicked on again this term, landing a four-runner handicap at Lingfield (1m6f, good) in May and third of 20 under 5lb penalty in the Northumberland Plate (2m, AW; Kirchner second) four weeks ago; effectively on the same mark as last time; good chance.

Has improved for the fitting of blinkers and it was an excellent second of 19 in the King George V handicap over C&D last month; mark took a bit of a knock for that but the form has been working out and he might have an even bigger effort in him; much respected.

Wide-margin maiden winner in October; proved a little underwhelming when third on his handicap debut/reappearance at Newmarket (again 1m2f; first-time cheekpieces) in May and disappointed over an extended 1m6f at Doncaster (again favourite) seven weeks ago; no headgear today, which may help, and maybe this trip will be his sweet spot but there are questions to answer.

Ex-Polish filly who was an unlucky second in Windsor handicap (1m2f, good to firm) on her stable/seasonal debut in May; near that form when fourth of nine in Pontefract Listed event (1m4f, good) one month ago; not hard to envisage another good effort.

In the veteran stage now but his two runs at York this term prove he still retains ability, latterly when sticking on into midfield in valuable 10.5f event a fortnight ago; his sole start at 1m4f (in December 2024) returned his best RPR and this second attempt is well worth another go.

Course winner over 1m6f (also has two wins at 1m4f) but he hasn't scored since August 2024; posted a couple of mighty seconds in big handicaps on AW and turf last term but he's yet to get going in two starts this year; dangerous mark if he can stage a revival and the market might be revealing.

Performed respectably in three starts over C&D for Roger Varian and he made a winning stable debut at Meydan (1m4f, good) in January; lesser show at Abu Dhabi followed and he once again raced freely when beaten 17l in the Duke Of Edinburgh over C&D at last month's Royal meeting; hood makes a reappearance, which can be viewed positively.

A gelding operation saw him improve to win a pair of 1m3f handicaps in the spring, and following a blip he was back in form when third at Ripon (1m4f, good) on Saturday; that may suggest he's plateaued for now but he can't be readily dismissed.

He was attempting to win a 1m2f Sandown handicap for the second successive year when fourth (Theory Of Tides second) three weeks ago; will need more on this second attempt at 1m4f (finished fifth on AW three years ago).

1m2f/11.5f novice winner who was purchased out of the Gosden stable for 58,000gns in the autumn; encouraging stable debut when second over 1m2f at Sandown three weeks ago, when he dropped some strong hints the step back up to this trip would see him in even better light; interesting.

11-race maiden but he's normally reliable and has been placed on six occasions, including in two 7f Class 5 handicaps in May; bombed out on AW later that month and subsequently absent, while this is a notch above his usual hunting ground.

He recorded the last of his three victories back in August 2024 but his mark had reflected that when very good neck second of 17 over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; up 3lb but another good show can be expected.
Dual AW winner for Andrew Balding, latterly last June, who hasn't truly threatened on his last four turf starts for this yard; cannot be completely dismissed from this declining mark, though.

OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
Spotlight: Won twice last summer (1m/7f, good to firm) and it was an encouraging reappearance when third here (6f) in May; saw little daylight at Goodwood a fortnight later but he weakened when last of 11 at Doncaster (again 7f) seven weeks ago; hard to predict what he'll come up with this time.

Three wins at this trip and he was down to his previous winning mark when popping up at 25-1 in 11-runner handicap over 1m at York (good to firm) a fortnight ago; that was a comfortable career best and he might need to better it back down to 7f from 6lb higher; still respected.

Made the breakthrough when scrambling home in Catterick maiden in May and he broke his handicap duck with another neck success at Leicester (also 7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; up 4lb but he might be capable of better.

Eight-time winner (7f/1m) at a lower level, including when he comfortably made all at Lingfield (7f, good) at the start of last month; 50-1 when he made no impact in this grade at Sandown three weeks ago, however.

He had been getting his act together this term and his penultimate fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good) last month suggested his turn was nearing; it didn't come in the Bunbury Cup a fortnight ago but that can be forgiven and he's not without interest back in calmer waters.

Eight-time winner in Ireland (7f/1m) who has yet to sparkle in two 6f starts for this yard, including when beaten 12l to finish last of eight at Windsor (good to firm) on Monday; this trip is more suitable so heed any market signals.

All starts at 7f; showed ability in the last two of his three runs for Andrew Balding but was beaten 20l on his handicap/stable debut in May; subsequently rested and has been gelded in the interim; unexposed and he's worth a market check.

Likes to get on with it and he registered the latest of his six wins when making all in five-runner Brighton handicap (7f, good to firm) last month; went off too quickly next time but his third at Chester was a solid effort two weeks ago; same mark and this is tougher, though.

Made all in a fillies' maiden at Sandown (5f, good) 12 months ago; not at her best in her two runs this year but she's slipped down the weights and Oisin Murphy is booked; stable won this with a 3yo in 2023; revival could be imminent.

OwnerName: Moulton Racing And Mrs A Jordan
Spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth of seven at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; this first crack at 5f needs to spark improvement.

Solid efforts to finish fourth in each of her last three starts (6f, good or faster), running to a similar level on each occasion; Billy Loughnane takes over in the saddle and cheekpieces are now given a go; she'll need a good pace back at 5f if she is to come out on top.

On the up since blinkers were added, following her 6f maiden win at Windsor with a 5f handicap win at Nottingham five weeks ago; that form looks solid enough and she could have more to offer; up 4lb but should make a bold bid for last year's winning stable.

Won her first two starts but she was a beaten favourite in this race last year (handicap debut) and has been beaten a further ten times since; inconsistent in 2026 and the change of headgear isn't enough to tempt.
Solid fourth over 6f at Leicester three weeks ago was the latest in a series of good runs; whether she is ahead of her mark remains a moot point though.

2-2 as a 2yo, winning a 5f maiden at Yarmouth and defying a penalty in a Windsor novice ten days later; down the field in two handicaps this season; dropping down the weights but others look more solid.
Not at her best in a Class 3 at Windsor last month but that was 6f and this drop back in trip should help; wouldn't look to have much wiggle room off this mark though.
Progressive last season and she reappeared with a promising third at Kempton (6f) in April; not so good since but she is on a favourable mark again now and dropping back to 5f can help; contender.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed some ability on last month's Nottingham debut (5f, good), but has gone backwards in two starts since including over C&D (good to soft); bred to be better than that and interesting to see how she fares in the market on nursery debut compared to stablemate Sovereign Beach.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Out of the frame in three novices on turf/AW, though there has been a glimmer of ability; not dismissed on nursery debut if the cheekpieces bring about some improvement.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Little to get excited about in her first three starts and failed to beat a rival at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last time; may improve for the switch to a nursery but will need to; hood removed after one use.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in all three starts, finishing behind three of today's rivals in the process; lots more needed now switched to a nursery.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't figured in three starts over 6f/7f on turf/AW; bred to be better than he has shown and wouldn't be a big surprise to see improvement now switched to a nursery.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in a Kempton novice (6f, AW) 16 days ago, but had shown ability in two starts on turf last month including when chasing home a nice prospect on her debut over C&D (good to soft; third has won since); this may not take much winning on nursery debut and she's high on the list.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Not without support when beaten just over 2l into fifth of 11 on this month's Bath debut (5.7f, firm); shortlisted if coming on from that run.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Beaten a length into second of 12 on her second start over C&D in May (good to soft), but did too much early when fourth of ten at Lingfield (6f, AW) last month; one for the shortlist provided she settles better and copes with the quicker surface.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Sent off 33-1 but hinted at ability when beaten less than 4l into fifth of eight on last month's Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm); open to progress but it will be needed.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Has shown ability in his last two starts and did well to finish third of seven here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago given his jockey rode most of the race with a broken rein; major contender.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: No show in her first two starts, but not disgraced when fifth of nine at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 125-1) 11 days ago; nurseries are still likely to provide a better option, though.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Improved from last month's AW debut when second of five at Ffos Las (5f, soft) 13 days later; that form has worked out quite well and a player if she can repeat it back up a furlong on constrasting ground.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: March foal by Twlight Son; 2,500gns yearling; dam unplaced 7f/1m (RPR 64), half-sister to 1m winner Mumtaaz, out of unraced half-sister to winners Izzi Top (1m2f Group 1), Jazzi Top (1m2f Group 2) and Emaraaty (smart 7f-8.5f); stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
OwnerName: M Reddy, J Mallon, N J Clayton & Partner
Spotlight: March foal by Showcasing; brother to Italian 9.5f-11.5f winner Navajo Scout (including AW), half-brother to winners Ayr Harbour (7f/1m AW; RPR 105) and Desert Lion (1m-1m2f including AW/KSA; 104); dam 7f and 7.5f (Italian Listed) 2yo winner (103); already gelded and stable (also responsible for Napps Way) has few 2yos go in first time.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: April foal by Perfect Power; 13,000gns yearling; dam placed 7f 2yo/1m3f (RPR 73), sister to winners Alhebayeb (6f 2yo Group 2), Azmaam (useful 7f 2yo/1m) and Silver Mission (6f-10.5f), half-sister to 5f Listed winner Humidor; stable not a noted source of winning 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: March foal by Ubettabelieveit; 5,000gns yearling; dam 7f AW winner (RPR 63), closely related to 7f/1m winner Finbar's Lad, half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Pleaseletmewin, out of 7f winning half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Rainbow Peak; wouldn't look an obvious winner on debut.
Placed several times over further in Ireland, but twice out of the frame since returning for this yard last month and is now 0-17; little appeal.

Has been flying since joining this yard (231211), her last two wins coming in this headgear combination with Mason Paetel aboard; races off a 5lb lower mark than when landing a Newmarket apprentice handicap (7f, good to firm) a week ago (9lb well in) and should take all the beating.
Consistent in recent months, but was having his 25th outing when off the mark at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) ten days ago; 3lb wrong under his 5lb penalty and likely to find one or two too strong.

12lb lower than when winning a three-runner affair over C&D (good to firm) for Alice Haynes just over a year ago, but hasn't been threatening to take advantage of her sliding mark including in three starts for this yard; look elsewhere.

Doubled his winning tally when beating four rivals (including Too Much Trevor) over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; only 2lb higher and may be the one to capitalise if Prefer The Sister runs below form.
Both wins on the AW, the latest at Lingfield (7f) in April; twice well held since despite just a 2lb rise and others make greater appeal.

Just 2-34, though both wins have come here since the start of last month; 2lb wrong under a 5lb penalty for his narrow C&D success (good to firm) eight days ago, though is just 4lb higher; each-way claims given his liking for the track.

RaceName: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Was back off her last winning mark when beaten a neck at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) ten days ago, doing very well to go so close following a poor start; should be bang there granted a cleaner break this time; stable also runs Nammos.

RaceName: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Fast-ground specialist who completed a hat-trick around this time last year and was back off his last winning mark when making all over C&D (good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) eight days ago; 2lb wrong under a 5lb penalty, but still respected now that he is back in the groove.

RaceName: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Three wins over 1m/1m2f on turf/AW in the spring and has only gone down narrowly in her last two starts, the latest at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) eight days ago; already due to go up another 3lb for that and holds leading claims.

RaceName: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: 3lb higher than when winning this race last year, but is off the same mark as when following up at Salisbury (1m, good to soft) next time; looked unlucky not to go even closer when third of eight at Epsom (8.5f, good to firm) 15 days ago and is respected.

RaceName: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Beaten just over a length into third of six behind Kodi Fire over C&D (good to firm) eight days ago; didn't enjoy a clear run there and now 5lb better off, but her modest strike-rate is a concern.

RaceName: LSL Racing Horse Sales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Dual winner over 7f at this track, the latest (good to soft) in May; has one good run against his name over this far, but on balance shorter trips seem to suit him best and he may also prefer slower ground.
0-21, but on the plus side he has gone close in his last two starts and is the only one in the field with an official mark of 50; should run his race again.

First six wins came on the AW, but he gained his first success on turf in a 0-55 handicap over C&D (soft) under Zoe Lewis (who knows him well) last month; drops to this level for the first time, but fast ground is a big question mark.
Placed in three of her nine starts, as when a staying-on third of eight dropped to this level at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) last time; frame possibilities again.
0-17 since winning twice over 1m in the summer of 2024, but he has run well in his last two visits in handicaps here (7f); each-way claims down in grade.
Out of the frame in all 13 starts including when dropped to this level at Lingfield (1m, AW) 11 days ago; best watched until showing some spark; stable also runs Lady Margaret.
Some ability on her debut over C&D a year ago, but didn't build on it including in two starts on the AW for this yard; worth a market check back from six months off.
Both wins have come on the AW and she had no apparent excuses when midfield in a similar contest at Bath (1m, firm) last time; first-time hood replaces the usual cheekpieces.
Two wins in September 2024 included one here (7f, good), but losing run now up to 14; drops to this level for the first time, which offers one ray of hope.
Beaten miles in two bumpers and three starts over 1m2f on the Flat, including two here; tongue-tie given a go but only market support would make him of any interest.

Made a successful handicap debut in a 0-60 contest at Bath (1m, firm) for Joe Ponting in May last year, but not built on it and her two efforts since returning this May have been poor; needs the change of stable and drop in class to make a big difference; yard also runs Judge Frank.

Losing run up to 16, but often placed and has finished runner-up in his last three starts off this mark, the latest a neck defeat at Beverley (5f, good to firm) on Monday; no reason why he shouldn't run his race again.
Well handicapped on some of last season's form, but failed to beat a rival on stable debut after nine months off here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago; others preferred.

Took advantage of a drop in the weights when making all to record his second C&D success in an apprentice handicap (good to firm) eight days ago, beating stable-companion Savannah Smiles by 2l; races off the same mark (6lb well in) and a big chance of following up.

Five-race maiden who missed the whole of last year; not beaten far when last of four behind So Smart and Savannah Smiles over C&D (good to firm) eight days ago and 1lb better off with the pair, but he still needs to find a bit more.

Placed in five of his first six starts, but not so good in his last two outings including on stable debut after a lengthy absence at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 33-1) last month; down in grade but best watched for now.

Three-time winner over 5f/6f here; finished 2l behind stablemate So Smart over C&D eight days ago and meets him on the same terms, but she lost ground at the start when the blindfold was removed late so she may get closer.
2lb lower than for the latest of three wins last year, but this season's form has been patchy and the suitability of ground faster than good is still to be established.

Losing run up to 14, but now 22lb below his last winning mark and showed a bit more when fourth of nine at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last time; that form is working out quite well and one to be interested in.

In good form on the AW lately, getting off the mark at the seventh attempt at Wolverhampton (8.6f) this month; 4lb rise is fair enough, but she ran poorly in her only start on turf at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May which does leave her with questions to answer.
3-27 on the AW and 1-22 on turf; 18lb below last winning mark, but offered little encouragement when beating one home over C&D (good to soft) last month.
Out of the frame in all seven starts and cheekpieces have made no difference; look elsewhere.

Well held in his first three starts, but was only beaten a neck and a nose into third of eight on handicap debut here (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago (fourth has won since); should stay this far and this unexposed sort is high on the list.
Knows more about this game than most with this being her 80th start, but she hasn't been running like a winner waiting to happen and hasn't scored on turf since September 2023.
Didn't run badly when fourth of nine in an apprentice handicap at Newbury (1m3f, good to firm) on his penultimate start, but is just 1-26 and most of his best form has come on the AW.
First and second in two nurseries at Bath (1m, soft) last October, but not much otherwise and finished tailed off on her reappearance over that C&D (good) last month; best watched for now.
Hasn't shown much under either code and refused to race at Ffos Las ten days ago; easily overlooked.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Placed in three sprint maidens including over 6f at this track; took his form to a new level when a close third in a Naas Listed race over 5f last time; will be difficult to beat with a repeat of that effort.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam unplaced 7f (inc 2yo/AW; RPR 59), half-sister to French 1m2f/1m4f winner Motadarrek, out of useful 1m1f/1m2f winner; Eur8,000 yearling was a 10,000gns vendor buyback as a 2yo; yard is having a fine season so could run well on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fifth of 10 in a Naas barrier trial and ran respectably in a strong 6f Curragh maiden on debut; should have improved from that and be more involved today.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise on debut in a Curragh maiden but swerved and unseated rider early on next time; best watched for now.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to winners Last Crusader (6f 2yo/5f Listed; RPR 106), Cool Azul (6f; 85) and Game Breaker (6f inc 2yo; 82); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (98); Eur50,000 yearling is by a young sire who is doing well; respected yard so check the market.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to Italian 6f winner Rumba Club, half-sister to winners La Discoteca (Listed-placed 5f/5.5f 2yo; RPR 86) and Tees Aggregates (5f inc 2yo; 78); dam unraced; Eur6,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; decent pedigree and could run well on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Started at 80/1 and beaten 11l on debut at Naas so has to find lots of improvement.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam French 1m5f winner, half-sister to useful winners Show Me (1m1f-1m4f) and Honeymoon Cocktail (6.5f-1m4f), out of Listed-placed 5.5f/1m1f 2yo winner; Eur26,000 yearling is by a Phoenix Stakes winner and could run well on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Beaten approx' 12l in 5f maidens at Dundalk and Naas so will have to find significant improvement; hood and tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Slight improvement from Naas debut to Navan next time but needs major progress to take this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Was well beaten on debut when trained by Archie Watson but much better for this yard when landing a Bellewstown maiden over this trip; this demands more but could be capable of delivering it.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden over this trip in heavy ground on second start; posted a solid effort in a 6f Group 3 next time but has been below his best twice since; can be keen so the drop back in trip should be fine but needs his best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Beat subsequent Listed winner Carry The Flag on debut in a Curragh maiden over this trip on soft; didn't progress at Naas next time before disappointing in the Norfolk Stakes; might be better on easier ground.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Showed improved form to get off the mark in a Curragh maiden over this trip five days ago; has a habit of starting slowly but makes up for it by finishing well; faces a tougher task today giving away weight but is still a player.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in two maidens over 6f and will have to find plenty of improvement.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Solid on first two maiden runs over C&D (sft) and the Curragh (6f; gd); the winner of latter contest won the Railway Stakes last weekend; off the mark in a 6f York novice since but seems to have the speed for this trip too; big player.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Was just denied over C&D on debut (soft) but has been below that level twice since, albeit in Listed company last time; has to resume her progress.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
OwnerName: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell
Spotlight: Best effort in five starts when third in a Dundalk maiden over this trip; has to improve plenty on recent efforts even getting weight from most of her rivals.

OwnerName: Stonestreet Stables, LLC & AMO Racing Limited
Spotlight: Speedy filly won twice in Listed company last year; has found life tougher this term but some solid handicap efforts including at Royal Ascot; found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh las weekend but has a shout here.

Won this race in 2022 when trained by Paddy Twomey; only one win since but has run with credit several times this season, notably behind Kendall Roy over C&D last month; not as good behind Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap.

OwnerName: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power
Spotlight: His seven wins include this race in 2024; added a valuable handicap in Bahrain over the winter; bounced back to form after a break when winning a C&D Listed race last month but found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh last weekend; this is easier despite his hefty weight.
Won a C&D maiden last year and scored for the third time when taking a Bellewstown handicap recently; solid effort at Dundalk since off this mark but needs a bit more.

OwnerName: Mary B Hogan & Michael M O'Brien
Spotlight: Has been in career-best form this season, winning over C&D and at Down Royal before just failing to catch Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap at the Curragh; up another 5lb but can be a player; beaten 6l in Listed contest over 6f at Naas on Wednesday.

Has been in the form of his life this season, winning the Rockingham handicap despite being 3lb out of the weights; ran a belter from the front in the Scurry handicap last weekend but didn't see out that longer trip; solid chance off the same mark if bouncing out of that race.
Won a 6f Dundalk maiden in April and a C&D handicap in May on soft; just denied in a Curragh handicap next time but disappointing at York since; has a chance if rebounding.

OwnerName: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit
Spotlight: Maiden winner over 6f last year has mostly faced stakes company since and run well in defeat at times; drops to this trip for the first time with cheekpieces added; the drop in grade is a help.
Won a Dundalk maiden over this trip last December and several good runs in defeat since including second to Sarahmae over C&D; needs more from 3lb out of the handicap and seems yard's second-string.
Second runner for yard; all four wins have come on AW but front-runner was second in this race last year off 2lb lower; just denied at Dundalk last time and 2lb lower on turf, so should go well.
Won for the third time when taking a Navan handicap in May; a decent effort in a Naas conditions race two starts ago but was disappointing in a Dundalk handicap 12 days ago when reported coughing.
Improved plenty from low-key debut to be beaten 2.5l into third by Xerling in Cork maiden (5f, gd) 40 days ago; each-way claims if building on that back up in trip.

Half-sister to four winners, inc Irish Territory (US 1m turf; RPR 105); dam Listed-placed 1m2f winner (91), half-sister to Ghaiyyath; promising debut when beaten a head by more experienced rival at the Curragh (7f, g-f) six days ago; drop in trip should be no problem and she can go close again.

OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Hasn't finished outside the first four in four maiden starts; improved again to go close at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago, beaten two noses into third, front three pulling nicely clear; improving sort who should be in the mix; cheekpieces go on.

OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Well-bred filly; promising debut when fourth in strong Naas maiden (three ahead have won since) over 1m on good; step backwards when beaten 7.5l into sixth as 5-4 favourite at Limerick over 7f 35 days ago (had winner behind her on debut); soft ground a possible excuse that day; definite player if reproducing debut run down in trip.

Palace Pier filly, half-sister to Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; shaped with lots of promise on debut at Sligo (6f, sft) when running out of road late on to reel in Baiana, beaten a neck having been poorly placed (dwelt at the start); greenness got her beat so she should improve a lot and is a leading player.

OwnerName: R Scahill, S Begley, J & C Bourke
Spotlight: Best maiden run when second at Cork in May over 7f on soft-heavy ground; solid run again when fourth on good at Fairyhouse; respectable runs in handicaps since but vulnerable in maiden company; drops in trip.
No impact on sole run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel 304 days ago.

120,000euros 2yo breeze-up purchase by Havana Grey; dam 1m/1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 82), half-sister to winners Tatsumaki (useful 6f/7f inc 2yo) and Ascot Adventure (5f-7f inc 2yo), out of 1m Listed winner; tongue-tie on; debuts for small yard.
Well-bred 220,000euros yearling; very green when beaten 15l into fourth on debut 16 days ago; should know more now but needs plenty of improvement to threaten here; drops in trip for in-form stable.
Half-brother to yard's smart performer Indigo Five; looked like he'd improve for experience when seventh on debut at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago; likely one for longer-term.

9,500euros yearling by Profitable; half-brother to winners Goblet Of Fire (1m1f-2m Flat inc AW, RPR 96; 2m hurdle) and Across Earth (1m6f Flat, 85; 2m hurdle); dam 6f-8.6f maiden (64), sister to useful 7f 2yo winner Cherokee Trail; wears blinkers and tongue-tie on debut.
15,000euros yearling by Profitable; dam 5f/6f winner (RPR 94), half-sister to US Graded stakes-placed 1m1f winner Excelerina, out of Listed-placed 5f winner; yard can get maiden winners.
Far Above gelding; dam multiple 5f winner (inc AW; RPR 97), half-sister to useful 7f/1m winner Punch Your Weight, out of Group-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner Sun Slash; bred to be sharp; market can guide.

19-race maiden but is starting to find some consistency having finished runner-up the last twice at Fairyhouse (6f, gd) and Limerick (7f, gd); looked a winner in waiting last time 13 days ago beaten 0.75l by Rappell, pulling clear of Whatswrongnow and I'm Spartacus behind; should go close off 5lb higher back in trip.
Three-time winner (6f, yielding and good) who hasn't threatened in three starts this term; beaten 7.5l at Fairyhouse 42 days ago when well-backed; dropped 2lb; each-way claims.
Best runs came when placed in 5f and 6f handicaps on AW this year; hasn't proven the same force on turf yet, albeit not beaten far in big fields last twice; up in trip.
Won nursery over 5f on yielding at Down Royal in September off 15lb higher; struggled since and no real encouragement she's ready to win again based on last four starts.

Gained first turf win in big-field 5f race at Naas last month; beaten 3.5l into fifth off 5lb higher at Bellewstown 21 days ago; wide trip that day and looked ready for 6f again; can continue to give good account.

OwnerName: Syndicates Racing/W Jones/N O'Hare/Kabin Racing Syndicate
Spotlight: Little to shout about in first four starts but improved to be beaten 2.75l into fourth at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago; 5lb out of the handicap that day so could be well treated.
Went close over 6f on AW in February; first turf run of note when third at Fairyhouse behind I'm Spartacus last month; below that last twice and needs more.

Six-time AW winner; turf breakthrough in June when scoring at Fairyhouse (6f, gd) by 2.5l off 6lb lower; below-par effort at same track since; bit better 13 days ago at Limerick, beaten 6.5l into fourth over 7f; probably in the grip of the handicapper at present.

Four-time winner, including when springing a 22-1 surprise in this race last year off 1lb lower; good second at Bellewstown in August over 1m; gone completely off the boil since but drop back in trip a positive at least.
No impact in three maidens and needs to step forward plenty from handicap and stable debut 13 days ago.
Found great consistency on AW last year, landing a 6f handicap in October and placing four times since; poor runs on turf last twice however.

33-race maiden who has been consistent this year from 5f to 7f but has climbed 9lb in the handicap without winning; beaten 1.75l into fifth over 5f at Down Royal seven days ago; should be thereabouts again.

OwnerName: One Eight Seven Four Syndicate/Paul J Cahill
Spotlight: Modest efforts in four maidens from 5f-7f, beaten 28l over 7f 16 days ago; hard to assess on handicap debut.
Not much impact in maidens and ran poorly on handicap debut 21 days ago; not an obvious candidate.
Failed to make an impact in six runs for this yard, particularly on last two turf starts; difficult to make a case for.
13-race maiden wasn't beaten far when eighth at Bellewstown (1m, gd) earlier this month after missing break; never got involved on AW 12 days ago; needs improvement down in trip.
Soundly beaten in three deep maidens from 6f-1m2f; makes handicap debut.
12-race maiden, shaped well over 5f on good when fifth at Naas in June; two lesser runs since and needs step up in trip to have positive effect.

OwnerName: Rob Egan/Kilmichael Racing Syndicate/Kieran P Cotter
Spotlight: Moderate form in six starts but did go well for a long way until short of room and fading at Roscommon 24 days ago in first-time blinkers; dropped 4lb and can play a part down in trip.

RaceName: Buy Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Median Auction Race
Spotlight: Promising colt, excellent second to very useful stablemate Perisher on debut at Gowran Park (1m, soft) in April; off the mark over same trip on good ground at Killarney 73 days ago, beating subsequent winner Res Ipsa by 0.5l, pulling clear of subsequent maiden winner in third; likely to improve further and can't be opposed for in-form stable that has won this last two years.

RaceName: Buy Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Median Auction Race
Spotlight: Half-brother to 1m winner (RPR 65); dam 6f turf 2yo/7f AW winner (91); showed hints of promise on debut when beaten 10.5l into fifth at Killarney over 1m nine days ago, bumped and green; will come on for that but unlikely enough to trouble Alphonsus Ligouri.

RaceName: Buy Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Median Auction Race
OwnerName: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell
Spotlight: Best effort came on debut on the AW over 7f when 0.5l second to River Of Life; hasn't reached that level in five turf starts since and ran disappointingly on AW 12 days ago; up against it.

RaceName: Buy Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Median Auction Race
Spotlight: Showed next to nothing when tailed off last on debut at Gowran Park 42 days ago.

RaceName: Buy Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Median Auction Race
Spotlight: Beat one home on debut at Ballinrobe 32 days ago having dwelt at the start; needs significant improvement down in trip.
Hasn't landed much of a blow in two handicaps; needs cheekpieces and stable switch to spark something.

OwnerName: N J Hitchins & Mrs John M Weld
Spotlight: Been improving steadily in handicaps the last three runs and relished the step up to 1m3f at Gowran Park 20 days ago when running the progressive Rodeo Blues to within half a length; had Point Cartwright half a length behind and meets that rival on same terms now.

Had shown little prior to second start in handicaps when beaten 4.25l into third at Down Royal (1m5f, gd) seven days ago; drop in trip doesn't seem ideal based on that but a player nonetheless; wears first-time cheekpieces; one of two for trainer.

Has been knocking on the door of late having placed for a third time running at Killarney (1m3f, gd) 11 days ago, beaten 3.25l into third by Chicago Moon; takes a while to get going so this extra furlong and cheekpieces could help; should be thereabouts.
Reversed form with Point Cartwright when 2.5l second to Chicago Moon at Killarney, sticking on well having set a good gallop; raised 2lb and should give a bold bid again.

Stayed on to good effect to finish fifth at Killarney over 1m and went like the best horse for a long way over 1m5f four days ago at Ballinrobe before being left behind by 50-1 shot; should go well dropped slightly in trip for in-form stable.
Not far off some of these rivals based on recent runs at Naas and Killarney; needs to find improvement from somewhere to reverse form; hopes pinned on extra furlong.

No impact in testing ground on first two starts but improved on yielding at Limerick (1m4f) 90 days ago when beaten 15l into fourth by Chablis Rock; ran in snatches in rear that day so needs to be sharper on handicap debut.

Couple of decent runs early on in a maiden and claimer; well-held in handicaps since; ran to form in claimer at Fairyhouse (1m2f, gd) when 6l second to Pass The Buck; needs improvement up in trip to defy mark.

Put in best effort in handicaps when beaten 4l into fourth (0.75l behind Point Cartwright) at Killarney 11 days ago, shaping well from the rear; extra trip a positive but needs a sound pace to aim at.
Debut sixth at Gowran Park (7f, soft) not devoid of promise but soundly beaten since and never a factor over 1m at Killarney 10 days ago; up in trip.
Three-figure odds and ran like it three times in maidens; steps up in trip on handicap debut.

OwnerName: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate
Spotlight: Now 0-11 over hurdles but twice placed in Bellewstown maidens, including early this month after forcing much of pace; has his chance in what appears a weak maiden.

Closely related to bumper winner Miss Mini Bee; dam French 1m4f AQPS Flat and 2m1f chase/2m2f hurdle winner; ran okay in an academy hurdle on testing ground at Navan in December, market likely best guide on return.

70-rated Flat maiden with Donnacha O'Brien last year; couple of underwhelming runs in maiden hurdles for current yard, latest after 7 months' absence at Downpatrick 10 days ago; may come on for that comeback run.

Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas (1m, good), well held in Curragh handicap last month (off 76) on latest; previous three runs over hurdles didn't offer that much, albeit carried out early on final occasion; may need more time to make his mark hurdling and has to concede weight all-round.

Rated 63 after three Flat runs for the Hartys; surpassed market expectations on hurdles debut when second to a long odds-on winner at Bellewstown, not quite at same level when fourth at Cork a fortnight ago on quicker ground; encouraging jockey booking (claimer-ridden both starts) and should go well off a light weight.

Some promise in Flat maidens last year but has been disappointing in handicaps this term; recent hurdles debut was a bit more encouraging when third (Pebble Island 4.5l away fourth) in 2m2f Sligo maiden, despite some novicey jumping; more likely needed.

First foal; dam US 2m1f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners, notably talented chaser Allmankind; dropped away quickly two out on Navan hurdles debut in December on testing ground; much quicker conditions here.
Pulled up in his point-to-point and modest efforts in maiden hurdles at Killarney and Cork; hard to make a case for.

Modest Flat maiden but has shown a bit more hurdling, notably staying on fourth in 2m1f Bellewstown novice early this month (good), raced handier at Sligo latest but didn't seem to get home when fourth (4.5l off third-placed Bobby Kirova) in 2m2f maiden; more needed.
Soldier Of Fortune gelding; half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Harty Cup; dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful 2m1f/2m3f chase winner Sraid Padraig; market best guide on debut.
Huge odds and ran accordingly in 3yo hurdles last autumn at Cork and Fairyhouse; best watched on return unless market speaks.
Pick of three maiden runs when rallying fourth over 2m6f at Downpatrick, well held after racing handier at Limerick (2m4f) on latest; back in trip now.
Saddex gelding is half-brother to Czech 7f winner Coolishaak; dam 7f winner (RPR 76), closely related to useful 1m-1m4f winner Havanna Belle; market best guide on debut.
Order Of St George filly dropped away quickly at halfway on recent debut in Cork bumper; switches to hurdles.
Court Cave gelding was never sighted on last month's debut in Clonmel maiden; best watched for now.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed some improvement when upped in trip, notably staying on late to chase home a hot favourite at Tramore (2m6f, good); didn't seem to stay over slightly longer trip here a week ago when fourth in a stronger maiden than this; back in trip and major claims.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed on debut in Naas bumper last year for Tom Mullins; decent placed efforts on first two hurdling attempts for current yard in C&D maidens in May; more needed to play a leading role but has to be on the shortlist.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper winner at Thurles last October (good-to-yielding) and promising hurdles debut second (third has won since) at Ballinrobe in late May (good); dropped away disappointingly in first-time cheekpieces at Bellewstown early this month however; headgear now left off and could be the one to beat if reproducing Ballinrobe run.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: John Henry & William Bates & Paul Hillis
Spotlight: Brother to an Italian Grade 2 2m1f hurdle winner; ran okay in bumpers last year when with Ronald O'Leary; mildly encouraging hurdles debut for new yard at Downpatrick last month, good bit more likely needed here.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Cost 55,000GBP as a 2yo; half-brother to four winners inc French hurdle winners Norathir and Louvetot; dam Listed-placed French 1m3f/1m4f winner; 40-1, dropped away soon after halfway on Roscommon debut early this month; probably best watched for now.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: British point-to-point form nothing to shout about, nor his run in an Aintree bumper; tailed off last of 9 on yard/hurdles debut at Downpatrick 10 days ago; can only be watched.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to eight winners inc Hang In There (smart 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Logical Song (useful 2m1f-3m4f hurdle/chase); dam French 2m1f hurdle winner; never sighted when well held on last month's debut at Downpatrick; may need more time.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Never counted when last of 9 on debut in good-class Leopardstown bumper over Christmas; switches to hurdles on return.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Blue Bresil half-brother to winners Celestial Park (2m4f hurdle) and Global Fortune (point); dam unraced sister to useful 2m5f-3m2f hurdler/chaser Warden Hill; point-to-point form doesn't amount to much but yard going well so worth a market check on rules debut.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Big odds and soundly beaten in May, in Killarney bumper and pulled up in Limerick mares maiden hurdle; visor now fitted.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 150-1, tailed off when fell last on belated debut for Tom Dreaper in Fairyhouse maiden in January 2025; hooded here on yard debut and market should be informative.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Affinisea mare is second foal; dam unraced half-sister to point winner Elusive Classic; limited appeal on breeding, debutante likely best watched.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weakened into midfield on debut in Thurles bumper in December and far too keen (also made respiratory noise) following month before pulled up in Clonmel maiden hurdle; has had a break since and reappears on much better ground but hard to fancy.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to a 2m hurdle winner; dam unraced sister to bumper/useful hurdler winner Grangeclare Lark; had a foal in 2024, pulled up after always trailing on belated debut in recent Cork maiden hurdle.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers, only glimpses of form on the AW and pulled up after poor round of jumping on hurdles debut at Limerick in May for Eoin Griffin; yard debut.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Progressive Flat handicapper in 2024, winning three times on good/yielding; three maiden hurdle runs haven't revealed much but potential improver entering handicaps and worth a market check.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Very ordinary form in maidens and no real improvement in handicaps; 11th of 13 in first-time cheekpieces at Wexford (2m1f, good) last time.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner has finished fifth in both starts for Gordon Elliott; just 6.25l behind the winner at Wexford (2m1f, good) but further back at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last time; probably best suited by softer.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: 1-24 over hurdles with the victory coming on heavy ground at Clonmel in December (2m1f, heavy) off 2lb higher; beaten 34l over fences at Roscommon in June (2m6f, yielding to soft) and 23l over hurdles at Sligo last time (2m5f, good).

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Appears to have gotten the hang of things in his last two outings over 2m4f at Limerick; still in the fight when carried out at the second last in May (soft); confirmed that was no fluke when a 0.5l runner-up last time; if capable of reproducing that form away from Limerick then he has a big chance.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Showed progression in handicap hurdles late last year, finishing the year off with a 2l second at Limerick off 87 (2m, heavy); Flat return at Roscommon was not encouraging but may do better back over hurdles, although may prefer softer; new headgear tried.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in August (2m, good to yielding) off 94; midfield finishes since then; well behind on the Flat at Naas last month; cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Beaten 20l on handicap debut at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding, 40-1) in May and his mark looks high for what he achieved in maiden hurdles.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough in some style at Punchestown in May (2m, good to yielding) off 86; respectable efforts over fences twice following that; disappointing reversion to hurdles at Roscommon (2m, good) last time when beaten 16l; capable of better.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole win from 45 starts came in a Tramore handicap hurdle off 3lb lower in August (2m1f, good); midfield finish over hurdles at Tramore in May, but tailed off on the Flat there last time.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Added a second hurdles win at Kilbeggan last summer (2m, good) off this mark; beaten 30l+ in all four runs this season (two over fences); drop into 0-100 category for the first time since his win is the one smidgen of hope.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: AW winner in 2022, scored over hurdles at Down Royal in 2023 off 90; well beaten on the Flat when last seen in September; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner for James Nash, the latest in April last year at Down Royal (2m4f, good) off 2lb higher; signed off with a moderate effort in a Clonmel claiming hurdle for his former stable in May; stable debut for new yard on Flat at Bellewstown was nothing to shout about either.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Has a knack for finishing second (runner-up in four of last six starts); filled the second spot again on his return at Wexford in May (2m1f, good to yielding); just fourth at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last time when outpaced before keeping on; should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Modest enough form in maidens; pulled up in first handicap at Downpatrick last time; new hood needs to transform.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo has been soundly beaten in four starts, including Clonmel handicap in April last time; visor goes on now but others preferred.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-7 and yet to place; well beaten in both runs at Limerick this season, although on the second occasion she was sent off just 13-2; has never encountered ground better than yielding.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
OwnerName: Gerard Mullins & Ms Mary Mullins & Ms Margaret Mullins
Spotlight: Okay run in opening academy hurdle last year when fifth behind the useful Quinta Do Lago at Cork (2m2f, good); heavy ground was a possible excuse at Punchestown next time; got loose before the start in maiden company at Downpatrick in May when tailed off; may do better now in handicaps.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Fared better in second handicap start at Wexford (3m, good to yielding) in May following the application of cheekpieces when a 15l fourth; in the lead turning for home here last time over 3m1f before fading into fourth; drop in trip should suit and can go well.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner is yet to score from six runs over hurdles; third at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding) in May was his best placing; okay efforts over fences and on the Flat since then; chance.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-11; pulled up on stable debut at Wexford in May but ran one of her best races at Clonmel last month (2m1f, good) when a 4l fifth; hampered on two separate occasions when fourth over further at Limerick last time (2m7f, good); this trip is on the short side for her, but she appears to have found some form.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Sligo in May (2m2f, good) off 84; soundly beaten in two runs following that but her runner-up finish here last time (2m3f, good) is evidence that she could yet add to her victory.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Well beaten in three runs this season, two of them in handicaps; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Beaten +40l in both handicap starts, the latest of which came on seasonal return at Clonmel last month (2m7f, good); in good hands but hard to recommend on form.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Unseated in both point-to-points; not much to go on in his three maidens, where he was well beaten; best watched unless the market speaks on his handicap bow.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Tailed off in opening two maiden hurdles and would have been the same story at Sligo only for she ran out at the last; hard to fancy now entering handicaps.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner is 0-27 over hurdles; pulled up when last seen in this sphere at Sligo in May (found to be lame post-race); positive efforts on the Flat since, second at Tramore over 2m last time; strike-rate is off-putting but he has a place chance if bringing his best back over obstacles.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 1-25 over hurdles, the win coming over 3m on heavy ground at Clonmel in 2023; is now 13lb lower and he showed promise at Clonmel in May when a 4.75l third of ten (2m4f, good to yielding); hasn't matched that performance in three runs since.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Got to within 19l of the winner at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) last time, which was the closest he has gotten in five handicaps; weakened late on, so drop back in trip looks the right move but others make more appeal.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Handicap debutant; didn't show a whole lot in five maidens at 2m-2m6f on varying ground; others preferred.

Lost his form after gaining a first win at Naas in April last year off 107 (2m3f, good to yielding); switch of stable brought some mild promise at Clonmel last time when shaping as though that first run back could bring him forward.
C&D winner off 2lb lower last year (yielding); form since then has not been anything to get excited about and she reverts to hurdles after two moderate chase efforts; cheekpieces go on now.

Won a handicap chase at Kelso (2m4f, good) in April 2025, his first win since scoring over hurdles at Downpatrick (2m3f, good) in March 2022; heavy defeats in two runs over fences since return from a break so a revival is needed.

Finally made the breakthrough in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle in June (2m3f, good) at the 35th attempt, having placed on numerous occasions; didn't bring that momentum to a beginners' chase at Wexford last time when pulled up after he made a bad mistake at the first and lost his action; overall record is off-putting.

OwnerName: T Leopold, P Smith, D P Connolly & C Connolly
Spotlight: 0-13 and has failed to complete three of his last four runs; pulled up over C&D in April and unseated at the second at Clonmel last time; others more likely.

OwnerName: Mrs P Crampton & Oliver Crampton & DJCC Investments Limited
Spotlight: Put a line through his handicap debut in February when he was pulled up, having sweated before the off; ran his best race in a Bellewstown maiden hurdle in April when a 5.5l third (2m1f, yielding); didn't improve back there last time when weakened into fourth (2m1f, good); could go well on second handicap start.

Slight ability in bumpers; won his third maiden hurdle over 2m here in June (good to yielding) despite racing keenly; tailed off in his first handicap at Limerick earlier this month (2m1f, good); a tongue tie is added to the previously worn hood; he's capable of more.
Won at Limerick (2m3f, good) off 5lb higher last year; consistent sort has finished third in both runs for new yard; this is a higher grade compared to those outings but he's shortlisted.

Has shown his best form at Clonmel but was pulled up there last month (2m1f, good); on the retreat when falling at the last at Ballinrobe last time (2m2f, good); blinkers go on now but recent form just moderate and this comes quick enough after his fall.

Showed promise in the second of her maidens for Gavin Cromwell at Ballinrobe (2m2f, good) but well beaten in three subsequent outings; ran one of her best races on stable debut back from a break at Cork (2m4f, good) when keeping on steadily for fourth; not ruled out

Useful level of ability in four hurdle starts over a variety of trips and ground, twice over 2m7f; clear second on chase debut at Limerick (2m7f, good) in May, having stumbled on landing after the last fence; sets the standard back hurdling.

0-8 over hurdles but chased home a 15l winner in 2m4f Wexford maiden in May and faded into third after last in 2m5f Bellewstown handicap early this month; retreating third when fell last in 2m5f handicap here a week ago; has it to do back in maiden company and not sure this return to a longer trip will suit.
Placed in four points, though the form did not amount to much; Tramore maiden hurdle third (2m6f, good) her best effort under rules, recent remote third at Bellewstown below that level; place claims.

Shaped with definite promise in a couple of bumpers here and again on hurdles debut at Downpatrick 10 days ago, staying on into third over 2m6f (good) after not fluent at last; more likely required here but could go well.
Point-to-point winner in 2024, also runner-up last year; sole previous racourse outing came when midfield in 2m7f Limerick hunters chase in late 2024; best watched on hurdles debut for new yard.

Placed in both point-to-points and runner-up over hurdles in the spring at both Tramore and over 2m3f at Downpatrick; didn't appear to stay 3m at Punchestown on latest however, although was involved in scrimmaging after two out so could be worth this second chance at the trip.
Placed in three bumpers, moderate Tramore third the best of three attempts in maiden hurdles; of limited appeal.
Recent Tramore comeback fourth (2m6f, good) his best effort yet, shaping as if this longer trip will suit; could go well.
Well held in bumpers at Limerick and Downpatrick; probably best watched now switched to hurdles.

Dual-winning hurdler is yet to place from four runs over fences; beaten 25l on handicap chase debut at Limerick in May (2m4f, good to yielding); beaten same distance over hurdles at Sligo last time when fourth; others preferred.

Three wins over hurdles, 1-15 over fences; second twice over fences on decent ground at Musselburgh in January and his third at Wexford when last seen over fences earlier this month (2m4f, good) was positive, keeping on; fourth over hurdles here last time (2m4f, good); can go well.

Won off 5lb lower at Cork in January (2m4f, yielding to soft); excellent effort over C&D in May when 0.5l behind the winner (good); took fourth in a deeper contest here last time (2m4f, yielding); cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie and he's in the mix.

Won his maiden hurdle here by 17l in May last year (2m3f, good); made a positive chase debut at Tramore (2m, good) when a distant third, jumping left throughout; improved at Wexford next time when a 2.5l runner-up behind Garnacho in a novice chase (2m4f, good); 4lb better off with the winner now; big chance.
Won a listed novice handicap chase at Navan last year off 114 but has lost his way; tailed off at Roscommon last month (3m1f, yielding to soft); unlikely.

Three runs earlier this year weren't great but he won three times last year, twice off breaks of 100+ days; his record when fresh provides hope that he could get involved here but he is perhaps best on softer, although he has won on good/yielding.

Three-time winning chaser has a losing streak under rules stretching back to 2023; won a first point-to-point at Ballysteen in April but his runs in a hunter chase at Killarney and a handicap at Ballinrobe since then were just okay.

Six-time winner (four over fences) is now 31lb lower than his last chase win in 2023; good effort when third of 13 at Ballinrobe in May (2m4f, good); 2m2f over hurdles last time at Sligo was on the short side for him; place chance.

Hurdles winner made a positive seasonal return at Listowel in May when second (2m5f, good to yielding) and that run set him up nicely to win his chasing debut at Wexford in a novice contest (2m4f, good), jumping soundly to repel Costacurta by 2.5l; turnaround at the weights with that rival should bring them closer.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser, though last win came in 2023; 0-9 chasing, standout run when second in 2m5f Down Royal handicap in January off 97; none too fluent and met trouble in running on yard debut here in May; best form is on softer ground; drops in grade.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win came for Adrian Murray in 2m3f Downpatrick handicap hurdle a year ago (good), couple of decent runs afterwards in beginners chases; two comeback runs over hurdles should have her straight and not one to rule out.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Chase win came in 2m6f Tramore handicap last year, more recently has been hurdling, notably 3m1f handicap win here; held off 5lb higher in similar contest a fortnight ago but interesting back chasing here off 3lb lower mark.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole hurdles win came in 2m5f Wexford handicap last summer, pick of six attempts chasing when second in 3m Downpatrick handicap in May (good); tame Wexford effort early this month but has to be respected on overall profile (cheekpieces worn recently now ditched).

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden under all disciplines, best hurdles form when second in 2m5f Punchestown maiden; sole chase effort came on penultimate when never sighted in Limerick handicap in March on soft; inadequate trip back hurdling last time; high enough mark still.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Last year's win (good-to-yielding) in this came off 87 and later scored over hurdles at Limerick on heavy; twice runner-up in handicap chases last winter on heavy, below best of late on better ground; ground concerns again here.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Quite lightly raced mare is 0-8 hurdling, safely held of late in handicaps; half-sister won over fences so could improve for this switch to chasing.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Heavily-raced mare belatedly opened her account in 3m1f handicap hurdle here early this month (good); week later ran well off lower chase mark when third at Killarney (2m7f); not sure if this drop in trip will suit but each-way claims off handy mark again.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win came in 2m3f handicap hurdle here two years ago; 0-5 chasing, most recent Wexford handicap fifth only mildly encouraging.
